19.title: How to Use Fleet Spawn
19.body:
Paste your fleet into the [1E87FF]Blue Fleet List[-] or [DA1917]Red Fleet List[-] and make sure your player colour matches. Then click the button on the UI lableled "Spawn Fleet"

The fomat used can be either basic 

Faction: UCM

1 X Johannesburg
+Rear Admiral
2 X Toulon
1 X New Orleans

or you can use a New Recruit Text Export:
United Colonies of Mankind - Example Export - [355pts]

# ++ Fleet ++ [355pts]
## Configuration
Game Size: Battle

## Admirals [50pts]
Rear Admiral [50pts]

## Heavy Groups [190pts]
Johannesburg Battlecruiser [190pts]: UF-6400 Mass Driver Twin Turrets, UF-4200 Mass Driver Turrets, Fighters & Bombers

## Light Groups [115pts]
New Orleans Strike Carriers [45pts]:
• 1x New Orleans Strike Carrier [45pts]: UF-2200 Mass Driver Turret, Dropships
Toulon Frigates [70pts]:
• 2x Toulon Frigate [35pts]: UF-2200 Mass Driver Turret Triad

20.title: How to Save your list
20.body:
Place the Ship cards on the table and Click the Blue "Save List" button

A card will spawn in the center of the board with the card contents of the table

21.title: Dice Rollers
21.body:
Place the die of your choice onto the gray die icon in the center of the roller. Do not lock it in place.

Click the +/- buttons to adjust the amount of dice to roll and click the bottom number to roll. Results will print in chat as long as "Print On" is left on.

Clearing is not necessary to roll again.

23.title: Place a map
23.body:
1) Press the [DA1917]CLEAR TABLE[-] button to delete the current table (if one is loaded).

2) Drop a SET bag onto [1E87FF]DROP BAGS HERE[-] to generate a premade map. There are some introductory map bags in the containers next to the stage.

3) After making your own map, press the [30B22A]SAVE TABLE[-] button to save it. A new SET bag will appear above Stage

ObjectStates.Name: Custom_Token
ObjectStates.Description:
This tool, when left unlocked directly on the table surface, will disable the projection of grid lines onto the table itself.

Grid lines will project normally onto any object that you enable grid projection on.

Another dumb tool from MrStump
ObjectStates.LuaScript:
function onCollisionEnter(collision_info)
    if tableEntity == nil then
        if collision_info.collision_object.tag == "Surface" then
            tableEntity = collision_info.collision_object
            tableEntity.grid_projection = false
        end
    end
end

ObjectStates.Description: - v.171223a -  Place a Set Bag (SET_SetName) or table art (SBx_ArtName) onto this Stage.
ObjectStates.LuaScript:
cb = "imCopy"  ss = ""  sb = ""  bb = nil  prs = ""  sid = nil  sod = {}  zz = 0  z2 = 0  uls = ""

function onLoad()
    self.setColorTint({0.803, 0.752, 0.678})
    local btn = {}  btn.function_owner = self
    btn.click_function = "btnBag"
    btn.position = {1.62, -0.05, 0.67}  btn.rotation = {0, 0, 0}
    btn.width = 285  btn.height = 370

    btn.click_function = "btnTrash"

    self.createButton(btn)

    self.createButton(btn)
    btn.click_function = "btnUnlock"
    btn.position = {0, -0.05, 0.95}  btn.rotation = {0, 0, 0}
    btn.width = 300  btn.height = 300
    self.createButton(btn)
    Global.setVar("hld", 0)  benDare()
end

function update()  if cb then self.call(cb)  end  end

function benDare()
    local aoj = {}  aoj = getAllObjects()  local g = aoj[1]  local n = 1  local p
    while g do
        p = g.getPosition()
        if math.modf(p[1]) == 0 and math.modf(p[3]) == 0 and string.sub(g.getName(), 1, 4) == "SBx_" then  g.interactable = false  sid = g.getGUID() end
        if g.getName() == "tras_h" then bb = g.getGUID() end
        if g.getName() == "Ignore Me" then Global.setVar("im", g.getGUID()) end
        n = n+1  g = aoj[n]
    end
end

function imCopy()
    if zz > 5 then  cb = nil
        if self.guid != "2d647a" then
            broadcastToAll("Stage Copies will not work. Save the original Directly to your TTS Saved Objects Chest!", {0.943, 0.745, 0.14})
            self.destruct()
        end
    end  zz = zz+1
end

function btnBag()
    if cb or Global.getVar("hld") != 0 then broadcastToAll("The Current Set is Busy...", {0.943, 0.745, 0.14})  do return  end  end
    local n = 1  ss = ""  prs = ""  local f  local p  local u = "@649822@059864@3761d8@ff9bc3@2deca3@"
    if not getObjectFromGUID(Global.getVar("im")) then benDare() end
    local l = ""  if getObjectFromGUID(Global.getVar("im")) then l = getObjectFromGUID(Global.getVar("im")).getLuaScript() end
    Global.setVar("hld", 1)  local v = "FogOfWarTrigger@ScriptingTrigger@3DText"
    local aoj = {}  aoj = getAllObjects()  local g = aoj[1]  local a = string.char(13)..string.char(10)  local k = string.char(44)
    while g do
        p = g.getPosition()  f = g.getGUID()
        if math.abs(p[3]) < 26 and math.abs(p[1]) < 44 and math.abs(p[2]) < 26 then
            if string.find(u, f) then Global.setVar("hld", 0)  do return  end  end
            if not string.find(v, g.name) and not string.find(l, g.guid) then
                local r = g.getRotation()  ss = ss..f  prs = prs.."--"..f..k..p[1]..k..p[2]..k..p[3]..k..r[1]..k..r[2]..k..r[3]..a
            end
        end
        n = n+1  g = aoj[n]
    end
    if ss != "" then
        local op = {} op.type = "Bag" op.callback_owner = self
        op.callback = "cbBag" op.position = {70, 67, 70}  local obj = spawnObject(op)
        if bb then getObjectFromGUID(bb).destruct()  bb = nil end
    else Global.setVar("hld", 0) end
end

function cbBag(o)
    o.setLuaScript(prs)  o.setName("SET_")
    if sid then
        if getObjectFromGUID(sid) then
            getObjectFromGUID(sid).setScale({0.3, 0.3, 0.3})
            getObjectFromGUID(sid).tooltip = true  getObjectFromGUID(sid).interactable = true
            o.setName("SET_"..string.sub(getObjectFromGUID(sid).getName(), 5))
        end sid = nil
    end
    o.lock()  o.setScale({15, 1, 15})  o.setRotation({0, 0, 0})  o.setPosition({70, 98, 70})  sb = o.getGUID()
    zz = 2  z2 = 0  prs = ""  cb = "cbStowAway"
end

function hmBag()
    local s = self.getScale()  s = s[1]*2+1.5
    local r = self.getRotation()  r[2] = r[2]+270  if r[2] > 360 then r[2] = r[2]-360 end
    local x = math.sin(math.rad(r[2]))*s  local y = x/math.tan(math.rad(r[2]))
    getObjectFromGUID(sb).setRotation({0, r[2], 0})  getObjectFromGUID(sb).setScale({1, 1, 1})
    local p = self.getPosition()  getObjectFromGUID(sb).setPosition({p[1]-y, 0.823, p[3]+x})
    getObjectFromGUID(sb).unlock()  sb = ""
end

function cbStowAway()
    local g  zz = zz+1
    if zz > 1 then zz = 0
        g = string.sub(ss, 1, 6)  ss = string.sub(ss, 7)  prs = prs..g
        if getObjectFromGUID(g) then
            --getObjectFromGUID(g).unlock()  --getObjectFromGUID(g).interactable = true
            local s = getObjectFromGUID(g).getScale()  getObjectFromGUID(g).setScale({0.1, 0.2, 0.3})  getObjectFromGUID(g).setScale(s)
            getObjectFromGUID(g).setPosition({70, 100+z2*0, 70})
            getObjectFromGUID(sb).putObject(getObjectFromGUID(g))
            --getObjectFromGUID(g).setRotation({z2*40, z2*40, z2*40})
            --getObjectFromGUID(g).setPositionSmooth({70, 99.7+z2*0, 70}, false)
        end
        if ss == "" then  z2 = z2+1  if z2 > 3 and z2 < 9 then broadcastToAll("Pass "..z2-2, {0.943, 0.745, 0.14}) end
            if z2 > 8 then cb = nil  broadcastToAll("Manually add "..(string.len(prs)/6).." objects to Bag.", {0.943, 0.745, 0.14})
                for zz = 1, string.len(prs), 6 do
                    g = string.sub(prs, zz, zz+5)
                    getObjectFromGUID(g).setPosition({0, 2+zz/3, 0})  getObjectFromGUID(g).setPositionSmooth({0, 2.3+zz/3, 0})
                end  prs = ""  Global.setVar("hld", 0)  --hmBag()
                getObjectFromGUID(sb).setScale({1, 1, 1})  getObjectFromGUID(sb).setPosition({0, 0.823, 0})  getObjectFromGUID(sb).unlock()  sb = ""
            else zz = 0  cb = "endStowAway"
            end
        end
    end
end

function endStowAway()
    zz = zz+1  if zz > 48 then  ss = prs  prs = ""  cb = "cbStowAway"  do return  end  end
    local i
    for i = 1, string.len(prs), 6 do
        if not getObjectFromGUID(string.sub(prs, i, i+5)) then prs = string.sub(prs, 1, i-1)..string.sub(prs, i+6) end
    end
    if prs == "" then cb = nill  Global.setVar("hld", 0)  hmBag()  end
end

function btnTrash()
    if cb or Global.getVar("hld") != 0 then broadcastToAll("The Current Set is Busy...", {0.943, 0.745, 0.14})  do return  end  end
    if bb then
        local p  local s = getObjectFromGUID(bb).getLuaScript()
        if string.sub(s, string.len(s)-1) != string.char(13)..string.char(10) then s = s..string.char(13)..string.char(10) end
        while s != "" do
            if getObjectFromGUID(string.sub(s, 3, 8)) then
                p = getObjectFromGUID(string.sub(s, 3, 8)).getPosition()
                if math.abs(p[3]) < 26 and math.abs(p[1]) < 44 and math.abs(p[2]) < 15 then
                    if getObjectFromGUID("649822") then getObjectFromGUID("649822").call("noSMX", {string.sub(s, 3, 8)}) end
                    getObjectFromGUID(string.sub(s, 3, 8)).destruct()  end
            end
            s = string.sub(s, string.find(s, string.char(13)..string.char(10))+2)
        end
        getObjectFromGUID(bb).destruct()  bb = nil  btnGetSod()
    end
end

function onCollisionEnter(c)
    if cb == "imCopy" then do return  end  end
    if cb or Global.getVar("hld") != 0 then broadcastToAll("The Current Set is Busy...", {0.943, 0.745, 0.14})  do return  end  end
    if  string.sub(c.collision_object.getName(), 1, 4) == "SET_" and c.collision_object.name == "Bag" then
        local v = {}  v = c.collision_object.getObjects()
        local x  local y  local z  local ct = 1  local n  local p  ss = ""
        if getObjectFromGUID("649822") then getObjectFromGUID("649822").setVar("ulk", nil) end
        prs = c.collision_object.getLuaScript()  btnTrash()  btnGetSod()  Global.setVar("hld", 1)  p = self.getPosition()
        while v[ct] do
            if getObjectFromGUID(v[ct].guid) and zz != 0.02 then  zz = 0.02  Global.setVar("hld", 0)
                c.collision_object.setPosition({p[1], p[2]+0.6, p[3]})  c.collision_object.setPositionSmooth({p[1], p[2]+0.3, p[3]})
                do return  end
            end  ct = ct+1
        end  ct = 1
        while v[ct] do
            if getObjectFromGUID(v[ct].guid) then 	broadcastToAll("Duplicate Object: "..v[ct].guid, {0.943, 0.745, 0.14})
                Global.setVar("hld", 0)  upWeGo(v[ct].guid)
                do return  end
            end  ct = ct+1
        end  ct = 1  zz = 0
        bb = c.collision_object.getGUID()  c.collision_object.lock()  c.collision_object.setName("tras_h")
        c.collision_object.setScale({0, 0, 0})  c.collision_object.setPosition({90, 90, 90})
        prs = string.gsub(prs, string.char(13)..string.char(10), string.char(44))
        if string.sub(prs, string.len(prs)) != "," then prs = prs.."," end
        while v[ct] do
            local t = {}  t.guid = v[ct].guid  t.position = {0, ct*2, 0}
            n = string.find(prs, "-"..v[ct].guid)
            if n then  n = n+8  zz = zz+1
                x, n = snipIt({n})  y, n = snipIt({n})  z, n = snipIt({n})  t.position = {x-70, y+70, z-70}
                x, n = snipIt({n})  y, n = snipIt({n})  z, n = snipIt({n})  t.rotation = {x, y, z}
                t.callback = "setStage"  t.callback_owner = self
            end  t.smooth = false  c.collision_object.takeObject(t)  ct = ct+1
        end
    elseif string.sub(c.collision_object.getName(), 1, 4) == "SBx_" and c.collision_object.name == "Custom_Token" then
        if sid == c.collision_object.guid then do return  end  end
        btnGetSod()  c.collision_object.lock()  sid = c.collision_object.getGUID()
        c.collision_object.tooltip = false  c.collision_object.interactable = false  sod = c.collision_object.getRotation()
        sod = {math.modf(sod[1]/180+0.5)*180, math.modf(sod[2]/180+0.5)*180, math.modf(sod[3]/180+0.5)*180}
        c.collision_object.setPosition(sod)  c.collision_object.setScale({18.07, 1, 18.07})
        zz = 0  cb = "setSod"
    end
end

function snipIt(a)
    local e = string.find(prs, string.char(44), a[1])
    return string.sub(prs, a[1], e-1), e+1
end

function setSod()
    if getObjectFromGUID(sid) then
        local p = getObjectFromGUID(sid).getPosition()  local r = getObjectFromGUID(sid).getRotation()
        getObjectFromGUID(sid).setPosition({0, 0.91, 0})  getObjectFromGUID(sid).setRotation(sod)
        if math.abs(p[1]) < 0.0005 and math.abs(p[2]-0.91) < 0.0005 and math.abs(p[3]) < 0.0005 and math.abs(sod[1]-r[1]) < 0.0005
        and math.abs(sod[2]-r[2]) < 0.0005 and math.abs(sod[3]-r[3]) < 0.0005 and getObjectFromGUID(sid).resting then
            cb = nil  else zz = zz+1  if zz > 20 then cb = nil  print("Failed Alignment.")  end
        end
    else sid = nil  cb = nil  end
end

function setStage(a)
    a.resting = true  a.lock()  local n = string.find(prs, "-"..a.guid)+8  zz = zz-1
    y, n = snipIt({n})  z, n = snipIt({n})  x, n = snipIt({n})  a.setPosition({y, z, x})
    y, n = snipIt({n})  z, n = snipIt({n})  x, n = snipIt({n})  a.setRotation({y, z, x})
    if string.sub(a.getName(), 1, 4) == "SBx_" then a.setScale({18.07, 1, 18.07})
        sid = a.getGUID()  sod = {y, z, x}  a.tooltip = false  a.interactable = false  end
    ss = ss..(a.guid)  if zz == 0 then cb = "popSetQ" end
end

function popSetQ()
    zz = zz+1
    if zz > 5 then zz = 0  z2 = 0  uls = ""  cb = "popSet"  end
end

function popSet()
    if ss == "" then cb = nil  popSetZ()  do return  end  end
    local x  local y  local z  local a  local b  local c  local n  local g  local p  local r
    g = string.sub(ss, 1, 6)  n = string.find(prs, "-"..g)+8
    if not getObjectFromGUID(g) then ss = string.sub(ss, 7)
        	broadcastToAll("Missing Object: "..g, {0.943, 0.745, 0.14})  do return  end  end
    y, n = snipIt({n})  z, n = snipIt({n})  x, n = snipIt({n})  p = getObjectFromGUID(g).getPosition()
    a, n = snipIt({n})  b, n = snipIt({n})  c, n = snipIt({n})  r = getObjectFromGUID(g).getRotation()
    if getObjectFromGUID(g).resting then
        if math.abs(p[1]-y) < 0.0005 and math.abs(p[2]-z) < 0.0005 and math.abs(p[3]-x) < 0.0005 and
            math.abs(r[1]-a) < 0.0005 and math.abs(r[2]-b) < 0.0005 and math.abs(r[3]-c) < 0.0005 then
            z2 = z2+1  if z2 > 9 then zz = 0 end
        else zz = zz+1
            getObjectFromGUID(g).setRotation({a, b, c})  getObjectFromGUID(g).setPosition({y, z, x})  getObjectFromGUID(g).resting = true
        end
    else getObjectFromGUID(g).resting = true  zz = zz+1
    end
    if zz > 99 then print("Failed Alignment.")  zz = 0  end
    if zz == 0 then ss = string.sub(ss, 7)  z2 = 0
        if getObjectFromGUID(g).getName() != "" and string.sub(getObjectFromGUID(g).getName(), 1, 4) != "SBx_" then uls = uls..g  end
    end
end

function popSetZ()
    if getObjectFromGUID("649822") then
        local p = getObjectFromGUID("649822").getPosition()
        if math.abs(p[3]) < 28 and math.abs(p[1]) < 46 then getObjectFromGUID("649822").setPosition({p[1], p[2]+5, p[3]})  end
        --if math.abs(p[3]) < 28 and math.abs(p[1]) < 46 then getObjectFromGUID("649822").call("isFrame")  end
    end  Global.setVar("hld", 0)  	broadcastToAll("Done...", {0.943, 0.745, 0.14})
end

function btnGetSod()
    if sid then
        if getObjectFromGUID(sid) then
            local s = self.getScale()  s = s[1]*2+2
            local p = self.getPosition()  local r = self.getRotation()  if r[2] == 0 then r[2] = 360 end
            local x = math.sin(math.rad(r[2]))*s  local y = x/math.tan(math.rad(r[2]))  r[2] = r[2]+90
            getObjectFromGUID(sid).setScale({0.3, 0.3, 0.3})
            getObjectFromGUID(sid).setRotation({0, r[2], 0})
            getObjectFromGUID(sid).tooltip = true  getObjectFromGUID(sid).interactable = true  getObjectFromGUID(sid).unlock()
            getObjectFromGUID(sid).setPosition({p[1]-y, 2.2, p[3]+x})
            getObjectFromGUID(sid).setPositionSmooth({p[1]-y, 2.5, p[3]+x})
        end
        sid = nil
    end
end

function btnUnlock()
    if cb or Global.getVar("hld") != 0 then broadcastToAll("The Current Set is Busy...", {0.943, 0.745, 0.14})  do return  end  end
    local g  local i  print("Unlocking Named Set Objects...")
    if getObjectFromGUID("649822") then
        getObjectFromGUID("649822").setVar("ulk", 1)
        local p = getObjectFromGUID("649822").getPosition()
        if math.abs(p[3]) <= 28 and math.abs(p[1]) <= 46 then do return end  end
    end
    for i = 1, string.len(uls), 6 do
        g = string.sub(uls, i, i+5)
        if getObjectFromGUID(g) then getObjectFromGUID(g).unlock() end
    end
end

function upWeGo(a)
    local p = getObjectFromGUID(a).getPosition()
    getObjectFromGUID(a).setPositionSmooth({p[1], p[2]+3, p[3]})
end

ObjectStates.LuaScript:
MIN_VALUE = 0
MAX_VALUE = 99

function onload(saved_data)
    light_mode = false
    tooltip_show = false
    val = 0

    if saved_data ~= "" then
        local loaded_data = JSON.decode(saved_data)
        light_mode = loaded_data[1]
        val = loaded_data[2]
        tooltip_show = loaded_data[3]
    end

    createAll()
end

function updateSave()
    local data_to_save = {light_mode, val, tooltip_show}
    saved_data = JSON.encode(data_to_save)
    self.script_state = saved_data
end

function createAll()
    s_color = {0.85, 0.44, 0.43, 100}

    if light_mode then
        f_color = {0.85,0.1,0.1,95}
    else
        f_color = {0.1,0.1,0.1,100}
    end

    if tooltip_show then
        ttText = "     " .. val .. "\n" .. self.getName()
    else
        ttText = self.getName()
    end

    self.createButton({
      label=tostring(val),
      click_function="add_subtract",
      tooltip=ttText,
      function_owner=self,
      position={0,0.05,0.2},
      height=600,
      width=1000,
      alignment = 3,
      scale={x=1.5, y=1.5, z=1.5},
      font_size=900,
      font_color=s_color,
      color={0,0,0,0}
      })

    setTooltips()
end

function removeAll()
    self.removeInput(0)
    self.removeButton(0)
    self.removeButton(1)
    self.removeButton(2)
    self.removeButton(3)
end

function reloadAll()
    removeAll()
    createAll()
    setTooltips()
    updateSave()
end

function swap_fcolor(_obj, _color, alt_click)
    light_mode = not light_mode
    reloadAll()
end

function swap_align(_obj, _color, alt_click)
    center_mode = not center_mode
    reloadAll()
end

function swap_tooltip(_obj, _color, alt_click)
    tooltip_show = not tooltip_show
    reloadAll()
    setTooltips()
end

function editName(_obj, _string, value) 
    self.setName(value)
    setTooltips()
end

function add_subtract(_obj, _color, alt_click)
    mod = alt_click and -1 or 1
    new_value = math.min(math.max(val + mod, MIN_VALUE), MAX_VALUE)
    if val ~= new_value then
        val = new_value
        updateVal()
        updateSave()
    end
end

function updateVal()
    if tooltip_show then
        ttText = "     " .. val .. "\n" .. self.getName()
    else
        ttText = self.getName()
    end

    self.editButton({
        index = 0,
        label = tostring(val),
        tooltip = ttText
        })
end

function reset_val()
    val = 0
    updateVal()
    updateSave()
end

function setTooltips()
    if tooltip_show then
        ttText = "     " .. val .. "\n" .. self.getName()
    else
        ttText = self.getName()
    end

    self.editButton({
        index = 0,
        value = tostring(val),
        tooltip = ttText
        })
end

function null()
end

function keepSample(_obj, _string, value) 
    reloadAll()
end

    local data_to_save = {light_mode, val, tooltip_show}
    saved_data = JSON.encode(data_to_save)
    self.script_state = saved_data
end

function createAll()
    s_color = {0.5, 0.73, 1, 100}

    if light_mode then
        f_color = {0.85,0.1,0.1,95}
    else
        f_color = {0.1,0.1,0.1,100}
    end

    if tooltip_show then
        ttText = "     " .. val .. "\n" .. self.getName()
    else
        ttText = self.getName()
    end

    self.createButton({
      label=tostring(val),
      click_function="add_subtract",
      tooltip=ttText,
      function_owner=self,
      position={0,0.05,0.2},
      height=600,
      width=1000,
      alignment = 3,
      scale={x=1.5, y=1.5, z=1.5},
      font_size=900,
      font_color=s_color,
      color={0,0,0,0}
      })

    setTooltips()
end

function removeAll()
    self.removeInput(0)
    self.removeButton(0)
    self.removeButton(1)
    self.removeButton(2)
    self.removeButton(3)
end

function reloadAll()
    removeAll()
    createAll()
    setTooltips()
    updateSave()
end

function swap_fcolor(_obj, _color, alt_click)
    light_mode = not light_mode
    reloadAll()
end

function swap_align(_obj, _color, alt_click)
    center_mode = not center_mode
    reloadAll()
end

function swap_tooltip(_obj, _color, alt_click)
    tooltip_show = not tooltip_show
    reloadAll()
    setTooltips()
end

function editName(_obj, _string, value) 
    self.setName(value)
    setTooltips()
end

function add_subtract(_obj, _color, alt_click)
    mod = alt_click and -1 or 1
    new_value = math.min(math.max(val + mod, MIN_VALUE), MAX_VALUE)
    if val ~= new_value then
        val = new_value
        updateVal()
        updateSave()
    end
end

function updateVal()
    if tooltip_show then
        ttText = "     " .. val .. "\n" .. self.getName()
    else
        ttText = self.getName()
    end

    self.editButton({
        index = 0,
        label = tostring(val),
        tooltip = ttText
        })
end

function reset_val()
    val = 0
    updateVal()
    updateSave()
end

function setTooltips()
    if tooltip_show then
        ttText = "     " .. val .. "\n" .. self.getName()
    else
        ttText = self.getName()
    end

    self.editButton({
        index = 0,
        value = tostring(val),
        tooltip = ttText
        })
end

function null()
end

function keepSample(_obj, _string, value) 
    reloadAll()
end

ContainedObjects.LuaScript:
-- 40mm SHIP SCRIPT V2.0 06/10/2024

RSS_Class = 'Model';

------ CLASS VARIABLES ----------------------

local ChildObjs = {
    aura_obj = nil
};
-- Declare global variables at the beginning
local Shiphealth = 15       -- health variable
local ShipbaseSize = 40      -- base size variable
local Shipcost = 195       -- cost variable

local Signature = 6                 -- Ship Signature Variable
local SignatureStorage = 35  -- Used for keeping track of signature
local cloaked = 0                        -- Tracker for Silent running 

local MenuManager = nil
local MenuManagerGUID = "15fc7f"  -- Replace this with the actual GUID of your Move Manager

local originalData = nil;
local state = {
    conditions = {
        Navigation_Offline = 0, Orbital_Decay = 0, Fire = 0, Weapons_Offline = 0,
        Scanners_Offline = 0, Defence_Systems_Offline = 0, Spikes = 0, Aura = 0, Activated = 0, Mode = 0, Atmosphere = 0, Clockwise = 0, CounterClockwise = 0, Silent_Running = 0
    },
    tokens = {},
    health = { current = Shiphealth, max = Shiphealth },
    base = { size = ShipbaseSize, color = {r = 255, g = 255, b = 255} },
    imageScale = 1.5,
    moveHistory = {},
	sigAuraShown = false,
	sig = Signature,
    referenceCard = { GUID = '', obj = nil }
};

local UIStatus = {
    Blue = { rotation = -2 },
    Red = { rotation = -2 },
    Black = { rotation = -2 },
    Grey = { rotation = -2 }
};

------ LIFE CYCLE EVENTS --------------------

function onLoad(save)
    -- Decode save data
    local data = JSON.decode(save) or {}

    -- Restore state
    recoverState(data)

    -- Retrieve MenuManager
    MenuManager = getObjectFromGUID(MenuManagerGUID)

    -- Ensure Move Manager registration
    if MenuManager then
        MenuManager.call("RegisterToken", { obj = self, guid = self.getGUID() })
    else
        print("Error: Could not find Move Manager object.")
    end

    -- Initialize SignatureStorage with the value from the card
    SignatureStorage = state.sig or Signature

    -- Rebuild UI and assets
    rebuildAssets()
    self.UI.setXml(ui())

    -- Additional setup
    RefreshModelShape()
    showAura()
end

function onClick(player_color)
    -- Call StartControlledMove for both tokens
    MoveManager.call("StartControlledMove", {
        color = player_color,   -- The color of the player controlling the token
        obj = self              -- The token (self refers to this object)
    })
end

function onDestroy()
    if (ChildObjs.aura_obj ~= nil) then ChildObjs.aura_obj.destruct() end
    if (ChildObjs.sig_aura_obj ~= nil) then ChildObjs.sig_aura_obj.destruct() end
end

function onSave()
    local data = {}
    data.state = state;
    data.originalData = originalData ~= nil and originalData or state;
    return JSON.encode(data)
end

function onUpdate()
    for _, player in ipairs(Player.getPlayers()) do
        if IsPlayerSuscribed(player.color) then
            HUDLookAtPlayer(player);
        end
    end
end

function recoverState(save)
    if save.state ~= nil then
        state = save.state
    else
        state = {}
        originalData = save.originalData or {}
        state.health = originalData.health or { current = Shiphealth, max = Shiphealth }
        state.base = originalData.base or { size = ShipbaseSize, color = {r = 1, g = 1, b = 1} }
        state.imageScale = originalData.imageScale or 1.5
		state.sig = originalData.sig or 20
    end

    state.conditions = state.conditions or {}
    state.conditions.Mode = state.conditions.Mode or 0

    -- Initialize all conditions to 0 if nil
    local conditionNames = {
        "Navigation_Offline", "Orbital_Decay", "Fire", "Weapons_Offline",
        "Scanners_Offline", "Defence_Systems_Offline", "Spikes", "Aura",
        "Activated", "Mode", "Atmosphere", "Silent_Running", "Clockwise","CounterClockwise"
    }

    for _, condName in ipairs(conditionNames) do
        state.conditions[condName] = state.conditions[condName] or 0
    end

    -- Ensure state.base.color is properly set and valid
    state.base.color = state.base.color or {r = 1, g = 1, b = 1}
end

------ STATE ACTIONS ------------------------

function SetInitialState(newState) -- To be called from the reference card
    state.state = newState.state;
    state.health = newState.health;
    state.base = newState.base;
    state.imageScale = newState.imageScale;
    state.referenceCard = newState.referenceCard;
    state.sig = newState.sig;
    SignatureStorage = newState.sig; -- Set SignatureStorage to the initial sig value
    state.Shipcost = newState.shipcost;
    RecalculateSignature() -- Recalculate signature to account for any initial spikes
end

function ModifyHealth(params)
    state.health.current = math.max(0, math.min(state.health.max, state.health.current + params.amount));
    SyncHealth()
end

function ModifyAura(params)
    -- print("ModifyAura called with amount:", params.amount)
    state.conditions.Aura = math.max(0, math.floor((state.conditions.Aura or 0) + params.amount))
    -- print("New Aura value:", state.conditions.Aura)
    showAura()
    SyncCondition("Aura")
end

function ModifyBaseSignature(amount)
    SignatureStorage = math.max(0, SignatureStorage + amount)
    -- print("Base signature modified. New base value:", SignatureStorage)
    RecalculateSignature()
end

function RecalculateSignature()
    local baseSignature = cloaked == 1 and 0 or SignatureStorage
    local spikeBonus = (state.conditions.Spikes or 0) * 3
    local newSig = baseSignature + spikeBonus
    
    -- Ensure sig doesn't go below 0
    newSig = math.max(0, newSig)
    
    if newSig ~= state.sig then
        state.sig = newSig
        -- print("Signature recalculated. Base sig:", baseSignature, "Spike bonus:", spikeBonus, "Total sig:", state.sig)
        
        -- Turn off sig aura if it was shown
        TurnOffSigAura()
    end
end

function ShowSig()
    state.sigAuraShown = not state.sigAuraShown
    if state.sigAuraShown then
        state.conditions.SigAura = state.sig
        state.conditions.TargetSig = 1  -- Light up the button
        print("Showing Ship Signature and Spikes. Value:", state.sig," Inches")
    else
        state.conditions.SigAura = 0
        state.conditions.TargetSig = 0  -- Turn off the button
        -- print("Signature aura hidden")
    end
    showSigAura()
    SyncCondition("SigAura")
    SyncCondition("TargetSig")
end

function TurnOffSigAura()
    if state.sigAuraShown then
        state.sigAuraShown = false
        state.conditions.SigAura = 0
        state.conditions.TargetSig = 0
        showSigAura()
        SyncCondition("SigAura")
        SyncCondition("TargetSig")
        print("Signature aura turned off due to Silent Running or Spike changes")
    end
end

function ModifyCondition(params)
    local previousValue = state.conditions[params.name] or 0  -- Default to 0 if nil
    if params.amount == 0 then -- toggle
        state.conditions[params.name] = math.max(0, 1 - previousValue)
    else
        if Conditions[params.name].loop ~= nil then
            state.conditions[params.name] = math.max(0, (previousValue + params.amount + Conditions[params.name].loop) % Conditions[params.name].loop)
        else
            state.conditions[params.name] = math.max(0, previousValue + params.amount)
        end
    end
    if params.name == 'Mode' then
        Sync()
    else
        print(self.getData().Nickname .. [[: ']] .. params.name .. [[' ]] .. previousValue .. [[->]] .. state.conditions[params.name])
        SyncCondition(params.name)
    end
end

function ModifyMoveRange(params)
    state.move.moveRange = math.max(0, state.move.moveRange + params.amount);
end

------ MODEL MANIPULATION -------------------

function AuraFollowObject(params)
    if ChildObjs.aura_obj ~= nil then
        ChildObjs.aura_obj.setVar('parent', params.obj);
    end
end

function AuraResetFollow()
    if ChildObjs.aura_obj ~= nil then
        ChildObjs.aura_obj.setVar('parent', self);
    end
end

function RefreshModelShape()
    local attachments = self.getAttachments()
    for key, value in pairs(attachments) do
        local modelElement = self.removeAttachment(0)
        if modelElement then
            modelElement.setCustomObject({
                image_scalar = tonumber(state.imageScale * 1)
            });
            self.addAttachment(modelElement)
        end
    end
    RefreshBaseColor()
end

function adjustTransparency(baseColor, newAlpha)
    if type(baseColor) == "table" and baseColor.r and baseColor.g and baseColor.b then
        self.setColorTint({
            r = baseColor.r,
            g = baseColor.g,
            b = baseColor.b,
            a = newAlpha / 255  -- Normalize alpha value
        })
    else
        print("Error: baseColor is not in the expected format or missing r, g, b")
    end
end

function RefreshBaseColor()
    -- Temporarily force specific values
    state.base.color = {r = 1, g = 1, b = 1}
    
    local baseColor = state.base.color

    if type(baseColor) == "table" and baseColor.r and baseColor.g and baseColor.b then
        if state.conditions.Activated == 0 then
            adjustTransparency(baseColor, 255)  -- Fully opaque
        else
            adjustTransparency(baseColor, 135)  -- Slight transparency
        end
    else
        print("Error: baseColor is not properly set in RefreshBaseColor")
    end
end

------ UI GENERATION ------------------------

function calculatePlayerRotation()
    for _, player in ipairs(Player.getPlayers()) do
        UIStatus[player.color].rotation = player.getPointerRotation() - self.getRotation().y + 180;
    end
end

function Sync()
    self.UI.setXml(ui())
end

function SyncCondition(name)
    local secondary = Conditions[name] and Conditions[name].secondary
    local imageName = (secondary == nil and name or (state.conditions[name] > 1 and name or secondary))

    for k, color in pairs({'Red', 'Blue', 'Grey', 'Black'}) do
        local conditionData = Conditions[imageName]
        local colorValue = conditionData and conditionData.color or "#FFFFFF" -- Default to white if nil
        local colorBlock = colorValue .. ((state.conditions[name] or 0) > 0 and 'ff' or '22')

        self.UI.setAttributes(color .. "_ConditionImage_" .. name, {
            color = colorBlock,
            image = imageName,
        })
        self.UI.setAttributes(color .. "_ConditionText_" .. name, {
            active = (Conditions[name] and Conditions[name].stacks and state.conditions[name] > 0 and 'true' or 'false'),
            text = state.conditions[name]
        })
    end

    if name == "Activated" then
        RefreshBaseColor()
    end
end

function SyncHealth()
    for k, color in pairs({'Red', 'Blue', 'Grey', 'Black'}) do
        self.UI.setAttributes(color .. "_HealthBar_Text", {
            text = state.health.current .. [[/]] .. state.health.max
        });
        self.UI.setAttributes(color .. "_HealthBar", {
            percentage = (state.health.current / state.health.max * 100)
        });
    end
end

function IsPlayerSuscribed(color)
    return UIStatus[color] ~= nil;
end

function HUDLookAtPlayer(player)
    local playerRotation = player.getPointerRotation();
    if playerRotation == nil then playerRotation = 0 end;
    local pointerRotation = playerRotation - self.getRotation().y + 180;
    pointerRotation = math.floor((pointerRotation + 15) / 30)
    if pointerRotation ~= UIStatus[player.color].rotation then
        self.UI.setAttribute(player.color .. '_PlayerHUDPivot', 'rotation', '0 0 ' .. -30 * pointerRotation)
        UIStatus[player.color].rotation = pointerRotation;
    end
end

function ui()
    local panelContent = ""
    for _, color in ipairs({'Blue', 'Red', 'Grey', 'Black'}) do
        local pivot = PlayerHUDPivot(color)
        if pivot then
            panelContent = panelContent .. pivot
        end
    end
    local result = [[
        <Panel color="#FFFFFFff" height="0" width="0" rectAlignment="MiddleCenter" childForceExpandWidth="true" >]] 
        .. panelContent .. 
        [[</Panel>
    ]]
    return result
end

function rebuildAssets()
    local assets = {};
    for conditionName, value in pairs(Conditions) do
        assets[#assets + 1] = { name = conditionName, url = value.url };
    end

    self.UI.setCustomAssets(assets)
end

function PlayerHUDPivot(color)
    if not UIStatus[color] then 
        return "" 
    end
    local rotation = UIStatus[color].rotation or 0
    local mode = (state.conditions and state.conditions.Mode) or 0
    local content = mode == 0 and PlayerHUDContainer(color) or Compact_PlayerHUD(color)
    if not content then 
        return "" 
    end
    local result = string.format([[
        <Panel id='%s_PlayerHUDPivot' visibility='%s' height="260" width="100" position='0 0 -340' rotation='0 0 %s' rectAlignment="MiddleCenter" childForceExpandWidth="false">
        %s
        </Panel>
    ]], color, color, tostring(-rotation), content)
    return result
end

function Compact_PlayerHUD(color)
    if not state.health then return "" end
    local healthCurrent = state.health.current or 0
    local healthMax = state.health.max or 1
    local percentage = (healthCurrent / healthMax * 100) or 0
    local conditions = Compact_HUDConditions(color) or ""
    return string.format([[

function HUDSingleCondition(color, name, x, y, size)

function HUDSingleConditionBody(color, name, size)

    local isActive = (Conditions[name] and Conditions[name].stacks and conditionValue > 0) and 'true' or 'false'

end

function showAura()
    local auraSize = state.conditions.Aura or 0

    -- Scale is directly the aura size (in inches)
    local scale = auraSize

    if ChildObjs.aura_obj then
        ChildObjs.aura_obj.setScale({scale, 1, scale})
        ChildObjs.aura_obj.setPosition(self.getPosition())
        ChildObjs.aura_obj.setRotation(self.getRotation())
    else
        local clr = self.getColorTint()
        ChildObjs.aura_obj = spawnObject({
            type = 'custom_model',
            position = self.getPosition(),
            rotation = self.getRotation(),
            scale = {scale, 1, scale},
            mass = 0,
            use_gravity = false,
            sound = false,
            snap_to_grid = false,
            callback_function = function(b)
                b.setColorTint(clr)
                b.setVar('parent', self)
                b.setLuaScript([[
                    function onUpdate()
                        if parent and parent.getPosition then
                            self.setPosition(parent.getPosition())
                            self.setRotation(parent.getRotation())
                        end
                    end
                ]])
                b.getComponent('MeshRenderer').set('receiveShadows', false)
            end
        })
        ChildObjs.aura_obj.setCustomObject({
            mesh = 'https://steamusercontent-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/2450611726223935325/77C02DD7AC66A61A2F30452D73585D02DFE0D72D/',
            collider = 'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/RobMayer/TTSLibrary/master/utility/null_COL.obj',
            material = 3,
            specularIntensity = 0,
            cast_shadows = false
        })
    end

    if auraSize == 0 and ChildObjs.aura_obj then
        ChildObjs.aura_obj.setScale({0, 0, 0})
    else
        ChildObjs.aura_obj.setScale({scale, 1, scale})
    end
end

function showSigAura()
    local auraSize = state.conditions.SigAura or 0

    -- Scale is directly the aura size (in inches)
    local scale = auraSize

    if ChildObjs.sig_aura_obj then
        if scale == 0 then
            -- Hide the aura object
            ChildObjs.sig_aura_obj.setScale({0, 0, 0})
        else
            -- Show and update the aura object
            ChildObjs.sig_aura_obj.setScale({scale, 1, scale})
            ChildObjs.sig_aura_obj.setPosition(self.getPosition())
            ChildObjs.sig_aura_obj.setRotation(self.getRotation())
        end
    else
        -- Only create the aura object if it should be visible
        if scale > 0 then
            local clr = {r=1, g=0, b=0}  -- Set color to red
            ChildObjs.sig_aura_obj = spawnObject({
                type = 'custom_model',
                position = self.getPosition(),
                rotation = self.getRotation(),
                scale = {scale, 1, scale},
                mass = 0,
                use_gravity = false,
                sound = false,
                snap_to_grid = false,
                callback_function = function(b)
                    b.setColorTint(clr)  -- Set the color to red
                    b.setVar('parent', self)
                    b.setLuaScript([[
                        function onUpdate()
                            if parent and parent.getPosition then
                                self.setPosition(parent.getPosition())
                                self.setRotation(parent.getRotation())
                            end
                        end
                    ]])
                    b.getComponent('MeshRenderer').set('receiveShadows', false)
                end
            })
            ChildObjs.sig_aura_obj.setCustomObject({
                mesh = 'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/RobMayer/TTSLibrary/master/components/arcs/round0.obj',
                collider = 'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/RobMayer/TTSLibrary/master/utility/null_COL.obj',
                material = 3,
                specularIntensity = 0,
                cast_shadows = false
            })
        end
    end

    if auraSize == 0 and ChildObjs.sig_aura_obj then
        ChildObjs.sig_aura_obj.setScale({0, 0, 0})
    elseif ChildObjs.sig_aura_obj then
        ChildObjs.sig_aura_obj.setScale({scale, 1, scale})
    end
end

function rotate_model(obj, color, alt_click)
    if (alt_click) then
        rotate_right()
    else
        rotate_left()
    end
end

function rotate_left()
    self.rotate({x=0, y=-5, z=0})
end

function rotate_right()
    self.rotate({x=0, y=5, z=0})
end

-- 50mm SHIP SCRIPT V2.0 06/10/2024

RSS_Class = 'Model';

------ CLASS VARIABLES ----------------------

local ChildObjs = {

-- Declare global variables at the beginning
local Shiphealth = 25       -- health variable

local Signature = 8 		-- Ship Signature Variable
local SignatureStorage = 35  -- Used for keeping track of signature
local cloaked = 0			-- Tracker for Silent running



local MenuManager = nil
local MenuManagerGUID = "15fc7f"  -- Replace this with the actual GUID of your Move Manager

local originalData = nil;
local state = {
    conditions = {
        Navigation_Offline = 0, Orbital_Decay = 0, Fire = 0, Weapons_Offline = 0,
        Scanners_Offline = 0, Defence_Systems_Offline = 0, Spikes = 0, Aura = 0, Activated = 0, Mode = 0, Atmosphere = 0, Clockwise = 0, CounterClockwise = 0, Silent_Running = 0
    },
    tokens = {},
    health = { current = Shiphealth, max = Shiphealth },
    base = { size = ShipbaseSize, color = {r = 255, g = 255, b = 255} },
    imageScale = 1.5,
    moveHistory = {},
	sigAuraShown = false,
	sig = Signature,
    referenceCard = { GUID = '', obj = nil }
};

local UIStatus = {
    Blue = { rotation = -2 },
    Red = { rotation = -2 },
    Black = { rotation = -2 },
    Grey = { rotation = -2 }
};

------ LIFE CYCLE EVENTS --------------------

function onLoad(save)
    -- Decode save data
    local data = JSON.decode(save) or {}

    -- Restore state
    recoverState(data)

    -- Retrieve MenuManager
    MenuManager = getObjectFromGUID(MenuManagerGUID)

    -- Ensure Move Manager registration
    if MenuManager then
        MenuManager.call("RegisterToken", { obj = self, guid = self.getGUID() })
    else
        print("Error: Could not find Move Manager object.")
    end

    -- Initialize SignatureStorage with the value from the card
    SignatureStorage = state.sig or Signature

    -- Rebuild UI and assets
    rebuildAssets()
    self.UI.setXml(ui())

    -- Additional setup
    RefreshModelShape()
    showAura()
end

function onClick(player_color)
    -- Call StartControlledMove for both tokens
    MoveManager.call("StartControlledMove", {
        color = player_color,   -- The color of the player controlling the token
        obj = self              -- The token (self refers to this object)
    })
end

function onDestroy()
    if (ChildObjs.aura_obj ~= nil) then ChildObjs.aura_obj.destruct() end
    if (ChildObjs.sig_aura_obj ~= nil) then ChildObjs.sig_aura_obj.destruct() end
end

function onSave()
    local data = {}
    data.state = state;
    data.originalData = originalData ~= nil and originalData or state;
    return JSON.encode(data)
end

function onUpdate()
    for _, player in ipairs(Player.getPlayers()) do
        if IsPlayerSuscribed(player.color) then
            HUDLookAtPlayer(player);
        end
    end
end

function recoverState(save)
    if save.state ~= nil then
        state = save.state
    else
        state = {}
        originalData = save.originalData or {}
        state.health = originalData.health or { current = Shiphealth, max = Shiphealth }
        state.base = originalData.base or { size = ShipbaseSize, color = {r = 1, g = 1, b = 1} }
        state.imageScale = originalData.imageScale or 1.5
		state.sig = originalData.sig or 20
    end

    state.conditions = state.conditions or {}
    state.conditions.Mode = state.conditions.Mode or 0

    -- Initialize all conditions to 0 if nil
    local conditionNames = {
        "Navigation_Offline", "Orbital_Decay", "Fire", "Weapons_Offline",
        "Scanners_Offline", "Defence_Systems_Offline", "Spikes", "Aura",
        "Activated", "Mode", "Atmosphere", "Silent_Running", "Clockwise","CounterClockwise"
    }

    for _, condName in ipairs(conditionNames) do
        state.conditions[condName] = state.conditions[condName] or 0
    end

    -- Ensure state.base.color is properly set and valid
    state.base.color = state.base.color or {r = 1, g = 1, b = 1}
end

------ STATE ACTIONS ------------------------

function SetInitialState(newState) -- To be called from the reference card
    state.state = newState.state;
    state.health = newState.health;
    state.base = newState.base;
    state.imageScale = newState.imageScale;
    state.referenceCard = newState.referenceCard;
    state.sig = newState.sig;
    SignatureStorage = newState.sig; -- Set SignatureStorage to the initial sig value
    state.Shipcost = newState.shipcost;
    RecalculateSignature() -- Recalculate signature to account for any initial spikes
end

function ModifyHealth(params)
    state.health.current = math.max(0, math.min(state.health.max, state.health.current + params.amount));
    SyncHealth()
end

function ModifyAura(params)
    -- print("ModifyAura called with amount:", params.amount)
    state.conditions.Aura = math.max(0, math.floor((state.conditions.Aura or 0) + params.amount))
    -- print("New Aura value:", state.conditions.Aura)
    showAura()
    SyncCondition("Aura")
end

function ModifyBaseSignature(amount)
    SignatureStorage = math.max(0, SignatureStorage + amount)
    -- print("Base signature modified. New base value:", SignatureStorage)
    RecalculateSignature()
end

function RecalculateSignature()
    local baseSignature = cloaked == 1 and 0 or SignatureStorage
    local spikeBonus = (state.conditions.Spikes or 0) * 3
    local newSig = baseSignature + spikeBonus
    
    -- Ensure sig doesn't go below 0
    newSig = math.max(0, newSig)
    
    if newSig ~= state.sig then
        state.sig = newSig
        -- print("Signature recalculated. Base sig:", baseSignature, "Spike bonus:", spikeBonus, "Total sig:", state.sig)
        
        -- Turn off sig aura if it was shown
        TurnOffSigAura()
    end
end

function ShowSig()
    state.sigAuraShown = not state.sigAuraShown
    if state.sigAuraShown then
        state.conditions.SigAura = state.sig
        state.conditions.TargetSig = 1  -- Light up the button
        print("Showing Ship Signature and Spikes. Value:", state.sig," Inches")
    else
        state.conditions.SigAura = 0
        state.conditions.TargetSig = 0  -- Turn off the button
        -- print("Signature aura hidden")
    end
    showSigAura()
    SyncCondition("SigAura")
    SyncCondition("TargetSig")
end

function TurnOffSigAura()
    if state.sigAuraShown then
        state.sigAuraShown = false
        state.conditions.SigAura = 0
        state.conditions.TargetSig = 0
        showSigAura()
        SyncCondition("SigAura")
        SyncCondition("TargetSig")
        print("Signature aura turned off due to Silent Running or Spike changes")
    end
end

function ModifyCondition(params)
    local previousValue = state.conditions[params.name] or 0  -- Default to 0 if nil
    if params.amount == 0 then -- toggle
        state.conditions[params.name] = math.max(0, 1 - previousValue)
    else
        if Conditions[params.name].loop ~= nil then
            state.conditions[params.name] = math.max(0, (previousValue + params.amount + Conditions[params.name].loop) % Conditions[params.name].loop)
        else
            state.conditions[params.name] = math.max(0, previousValue + params.amount)
        end
    end
    if params.name == 'Mode' then
        Sync()
    else
        print(self.getData().Nickname .. [[: ']] .. params.name .. [[' ]] .. previousValue .. [[->]] .. state.conditions[params.name])
        SyncCondition(params.name)
    end
end

function ModifyMoveRange(params)
    state.move.moveRange = math.max(0, state.move.moveRange + params.amount);
end

------ MODEL MANIPULATION -------------------

function AuraFollowObject(params)
    if ChildObjs.aura_obj ~= nil then
        ChildObjs.aura_obj.setVar('parent', params.obj);
    end
end

function AuraResetFollow()
    if ChildObjs.aura_obj ~= nil then
        ChildObjs.aura_obj.setVar('parent', self);
    end
end

function RefreshModelShape()
    local attachments = self.getAttachments()
    for key, value in pairs(attachments) do
        local modelElement = self.removeAttachment(0)
        if modelElement then
            modelElement.setCustomObject({
                image_scalar = tonumber(state.imageScale * 1)
            });
            self.addAttachment(modelElement)
        end
    end
    RefreshBaseColor()
end

function adjustTransparency(baseColor, newAlpha)
    if type(baseColor) == "table" and baseColor.r and baseColor.g and baseColor.b then
        self.setColorTint({
            r = baseColor.r,
            g = baseColor.g,
            b = baseColor.b,
            a = newAlpha / 255  -- Normalize alpha value
        })
    else
        print("Error: baseColor is not in the expected format or missing r, g, b")
    end
end

function RefreshBaseColor()
    -- Temporarily force specific values
    state.base.color = {r = 1, g = 1, b = 1}
    
    local baseColor = state.base.color

    if type(baseColor) == "table" and baseColor.r and baseColor.g and baseColor.b then
        if state.conditions.Activated == 0 then
            adjustTransparency(baseColor, 255)  -- Fully opaque
        else
            adjustTransparency(baseColor, 135)  -- Slight transparency
        end
    else
        print("Error: baseColor is not properly set in RefreshBaseColor")
    end
end

------ UI GENERATION ------------------------

function calculatePlayerRotation()
    for _, player in ipairs(Player.getPlayers()) do
        UIStatus[player.color].rotation = player.getPointerRotation() - self.getRotation().y + 180;
    end
end

function Sync()
    self.UI.setXml(ui())
end

function SyncCondition(name)
    local secondary = Conditions[name] and Conditions[name].secondary
    local imageName = (secondary == nil and name or (state.conditions[name] > 1 and name or secondary))

    for k, color in pairs({'Red', 'Blue', 'Grey', 'Black'}) do
        local conditionData = Conditions[imageName]
        local colorValue = conditionData and conditionData.color or "#FFFFFF" -- Default to white if nil
        local colorBlock = colorValue .. ((state.conditions[name] or 0) > 0 and 'ff' or '22')

        self.UI.setAttributes(color .. "_ConditionImage_" .. name, {
            color = colorBlock,
            image = imageName,
        })
        self.UI.setAttributes(color .. "_ConditionText_" .. name, {
            active = (Conditions[name] and Conditions[name].stacks and state.conditions[name] > 0 and 'true' or 'false'),
            text = state.conditions[name]
        })
    end

    if name == "Activated" then
        RefreshBaseColor()
    end
end

function SyncHealth()
    for k, color in pairs({'Red', 'Blue', 'Grey', 'Black'}) do
        self.UI.setAttributes(color .. "_HealthBar_Text", {
            text = state.health.current .. [[/]] .. state.health.max
        });
        self.UI.setAttributes(color .. "_HealthBar", {
            percentage = (state.health.current / state.health.max * 100)
        });
    end
end

function IsPlayerSuscribed(color)
    return UIStatus[color] ~= nil;
end

function HUDLookAtPlayer(player)
    local playerRotation = player.getPointerRotation();
    if playerRotation == nil then playerRotation = 0 end;
    local pointerRotation = playerRotation - self.getRotation().y + 180;
    pointerRotation = math.floor((pointerRotation + 15) / 30)
    if pointerRotation ~= UIStatus[player.color].rotation then
        self.UI.setAttribute(player.color .. '_PlayerHUDPivot', 'rotation', '0 0 ' .. -30 * pointerRotation)
        UIStatus[player.color].rotation = pointerRotation;
    end
end

function ui()
    local panelContent = ""
    for _, color in ipairs({'Blue', 'Red', 'Grey', 'Black'}) do
        local pivot = PlayerHUDPivot(color)
        if pivot then
            panelContent = panelContent .. pivot
        end
    end
    local result = [[
        <Panel color="#FFFFFFff" height="0" width="0" rectAlignment="MiddleCenter" childForceExpandWidth="true" >]] 
        .. panelContent .. 
        [[</Panel>
    ]]
    return result
end

function rebuildAssets()
    local assets = {};
    for conditionName, value in pairs(Conditions) do
        assets[#assets + 1] = { name = conditionName, url = value.url };
    end

    self.UI.setCustomAssets(assets)
end

function PlayerHUDPivot(color)
    if not UIStatus[color] then 
        return "" 
    end
    local rotation = UIStatus[color].rotation or 0
    local mode = (state.conditions and state.conditions.Mode) or 0
    local content = mode == 0 and PlayerHUDContainer(color) or Compact_PlayerHUD(color)
    if not content then 
        return "" 
    end
    local result = string.format([[
        <Panel id='%s_PlayerHUDPivot' visibility='%s' height="260" width="100" position='0 0 -340' rotation='0 0 %s' rectAlignment="MiddleCenter" childForceExpandWidth="false">
        %s
        </Panel>
    ]], color, color, tostring(-rotation), content)
    return result
end

function Compact_PlayerHUD(color)
    if not state.health then return "" end
    local healthCurrent = state.health.current or 0
    local healthMax = state.health.max or 1
    local percentage = (healthCurrent / healthMax * 100) or 0
    local conditions = Compact_HUDConditions(color) or ""
    return string.format([[
        <Panel id='PlayerHUD_Container' active='true' height="180" width="60" rectAlignment="MiddleCenter" rotation='-35 0 0' position='0 0 -1080' childForceExpandWidth="false">%s
        <ProgressBar width="100%%" height="20" id="%s_HealthBar" color='#00000080' fillImageColor="#44AA22FF" percentage="%s" textColor="#00000000"/>  
        <Text id='%s_HealthBar_Text' fontSize='18' height="20" onClick='UI_ModifyHealth' text='%s/%s' color='#ffffff' fontStyle='Bold' outline='#000000' outlineSize='1 1' />
        </Panel>
    ]], conditions, color, percentage, color, healthCurrent, healthMax)
end

function PlayerHUDContainer(color)
    if not state.health then return "" end
    local healthCurrent = state.health.current or 0
    local healthMax = state.health.max or 1
    local percentage = (healthCurrent / healthMax * 100) or 0
    local conditions = HUDConditions(color) or ""
    return string.format([[
        <Panel id='PlayerHUD_Container' active='true' height="180" width="128" rectAlignment="MiddleCenter" rotation='-35 0 0' position='0 50 -1100' childForceExpandWidth="false">%s
        <ProgressBar width="200%%" height="60" id="%s_HealthBar" color='#00000080' fillImageColor="#44AA22FF" percentage="%s" textColor="#00000000"/>  
        <Text id='%s_HealthBar_Text' fontSize='25' height="30" onClick='UI_ModifyHealth' text='%s/%s' color='#ffffff' fontStyle='Bold' outline='#000000' outlineSize='1 1' />
        </Panel>
    ]], conditions, color, percentage, color, healthCurrent, healthMax)
end

    if cloaked == 1 then
       cloaked = 0
       -- print("Ship is no Longer Silent Running")
    else
       cloaked = 1
       -- print("Ship is Silent Running")
    end
    
    -- Recalculate signature to account for cloaking/decloaking and spikes
    RecalculateSignature()
    
    -- Turn off sig aura if it was shown
    TurnOffSigAura()

    -- print("Spikes updated. New spike count:", currentSpikes)

function HUDSingleCondition(color, name, x, y, size)
    if not color or not name or not x or not y or not size then
        return ""
    end
    local id = "ConditionFrame_" .. name
    local position = string.format("%s %s 0", ((x * (size + 2)) - (1.5 * size + 2)), y * ((size + 2)))
    return string.format([[
        <Panel id="%s" width="%s" height="%s" alignment='LowerLeft' position='%s' onClick='UI_Modify%s()'>
        %s
        </Panel>
    ]], id, size, size, position, name, HUDSingleConditionBody(color, name, size) or "")
end

function HUDSingleConditionBody(color, name, size)
    if not color or not name or not size or not state.conditions then
        return ""
    end
    local conditionValue = state.conditions[name] or 0
    local secondary = Conditions[name] and Conditions[name].secondary
    local imageName = (secondary == nil and name or (conditionValue > 1 and name or secondary)) or name
    local colorValue = (Conditions[imageName] and Conditions[imageName].color) or "#FFFFFF"
    local colorBlock = colorValue .. (conditionValue > 0 and 'ff' or '22')
    local isActive = (Conditions[name] and Conditions[name].stacks and conditionValue > 0) and 'true' or 'false'
    local fontSize = math.floor(size * 0.85)

    return string.format([[
        <Image id="%s_ConditionImage_%s" image="%s" color="%s" rectAlignment='LowerLeft' width='%s' height='%s'/>
        <Text id="%s_ConditionText_%s" active='%s' fontSize='%s' text='%s' color='#ffffff' fontStyle='Bold' rectAlignment='LowerLeft' outline='#000000' outlineSize='1 1' />
    ]], color, name, imageName, colorBlock, size, size, color, name, isActive, fontSize, conditionValue)
end

------ Object SPAWNERS ----------------------

function showAura()
    local auraSize = state.conditions.Aura or 0

    -- Scale is directly the aura size (in inches)
    local scale = auraSize

    if ChildObjs.aura_obj then
        ChildObjs.aura_obj.setScale({scale, 1, scale})
        ChildObjs.aura_obj.setPosition(self.getPosition())
        ChildObjs.aura_obj.setRotation(self.getRotation())
    else
        local clr = self.getColorTint()
        ChildObjs.aura_obj = spawnObject({
            type = 'custom_model',
            position = self.getPosition(),
            rotation = self.getRotation(),
            scale = {scale, 1, scale},
            mass = 0,
            use_gravity = false,
            sound = false,
            snap_to_grid = false,
            callback_function = function(b)
                b.setColorTint(clr)
                b.setVar('parent', self)
                b.setLuaScript([[
                    function onUpdate()
                        if parent and parent.getPosition then
                            self.setPosition(parent.getPosition())
                            self.setRotation(parent.getRotation())
                        end
                    end
                ]])
                b.getComponent('MeshRenderer').set('receiveShadows', false)
            end
        })
        ChildObjs.aura_obj.setCustomObject({
            mesh = 'https://steamusercontent-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/2450611726223929022/E9FD1CA7DDCC15521C6B20FB250F5651DCEAEEA0/',
            collider = 'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/RobMayer/TTSLibrary/master/utility/null_COL.obj',
            material = 3,
            specularIntensity = 0,
            cast_shadows = false
        })
    end

    if auraSize == 0 and ChildObjs.aura_obj then
        ChildObjs.aura_obj.setScale({0, 0, 0})
    else
        ChildObjs.aura_obj.setScale({scale, 1, scale})
    end
end

function showSigAura()
    local auraSize = state.conditions.SigAura or 0

    -- Scale is directly the aura size (in inches)
    local scale = auraSize

    if ChildObjs.sig_aura_obj then
        if scale == 0 then
            -- Hide the aura object
            ChildObjs.sig_aura_obj.setScale({0, 0, 0})
        else
            -- Show and update the aura object
            ChildObjs.sig_aura_obj.setScale({scale, 1, scale})
            ChildObjs.sig_aura_obj.setPosition(self.getPosition())
            ChildObjs.sig_aura_obj.setRotation(self.getRotation())
        end
    else
        -- Only create the aura object if it should be visible
        if scale > 0 then
            local clr = {r=1, g=0, b=0}  -- Set color to red
            ChildObjs.sig_aura_obj = spawnObject({
                type = 'custom_model',
                position = self.getPosition(),
                rotation = self.getRotation(),
                scale = {scale, 1, scale},
                mass = 0,
                use_gravity = false,
                sound = false,
                snap_to_grid = false,
                callback_function = function(b)
                    b.setColorTint(clr)  -- Set the color to red
                    b.setVar('parent', self)
                    b.setLuaScript([[
                        function onUpdate()
                            if parent and parent.getPosition then
                                self.setPosition(parent.getPosition())
                                self.setRotation(parent.getRotation())
                            end
                        end
                    ]])
                    b.getComponent('MeshRenderer').set('receiveShadows', false)
                end
            })
            ChildObjs.sig_aura_obj.setCustomObject({
                mesh = 'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/RobMayer/TTSLibrary/master/components/arcs/round0.obj',
                collider = 'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/RobMayer/TTSLibrary/master/utility/null_COL.obj',
                material = 3,
                specularIntensity = 0,
                cast_shadows = false
            })
        end
    end

    if auraSize == 0 and ChildObjs.sig_aura_obj then
        ChildObjs.sig_aura_obj.setScale({0, 0, 0})
    elseif ChildObjs.sig_aura_obj then
        ChildObjs.sig_aura_obj.setScale({scale, 1, scale})
    end
end

-------------Model Rotation-------------------

function rotate_model(obj, color, alt_click)
    if (alt_click) then
        rotate_right()
    else
        rotate_left()
    end
end

function rotate_left()
    self.rotate({x=0, y=-5, z=0})
end

function rotate_right()
    self.rotate({x=0, y=5, z=0})
end
