ContainedObjects.LuaScript:
-- SHIP SCRIPT V2.0 06/10/2024

RSS_Class = 'Model';

------ CLASS VARIABLES ----------------------

local ChildObjs = {
    aura_obj = nil
};
-- Declare global variables at the beginning
local Shiphealth = 10       -- health variable
local ShipbaseSize = 30     -- base size variable
local Shipcost = 195        -- cost variable

local Signature = 4 		-- Ship Signature Variable
local SignatureStorage = 35  -- Used for keeping track of signature
local cloaked = 0			-- Tracker for Silent running

local MenuManager = nil
local MenuManagerGUID = "15fc7f"  -- Replace this with the actual GUID of your Move Manager

local originalData = nil;
local state = {
    conditions = {
        Navigation_Offline = 0, Orbital_Decay = 0, Fire = 0, Weapons_Offline = 0,
        Scanners_Offline = 0, Defence_Systems_Offline = 0, Spikes = 0, Aura = 0, Activated = 0, Mode = 0, Atmosphere = 0, Clockwise = 0, CounterClockwise = 0, Silent_Running = 0
    },
    tokens = {},
    health = { current = Shiphealth, max = Shiphealth },
    base = { size = ShipbaseSize, color = {r = 255, g = 255, b = 255} },
    imageScale = 1.5,
    moveHistory = {},
	sigAuraShown = false,
	sig = Signature,
    referenceCard = { GUID = '', obj = nil }
};

local UIStatus = {
    Blue = { rotation = -2 },
    Red = { rotation = -2 },
    Black = { rotation = -2 },
    Grey = { rotation = -2 }
};

------ LIFE CYCLE EVENTS --------------------

function onLoad(save)
    -- Decode save data
    local data = JSON.decode(save) or {}

    -- Restore state
    recoverState(data)

    -- Retrieve MenuManager
    MenuManager = getObjectFromGUID(MenuManagerGUID)

    -- Ensure Move Manager registration
    if MenuManager then
        MenuManager.call("RegisterToken", { obj = self, guid = self.getGUID() })
    else
        print("Error: Could not find Move Manager object.")
    end

    -- Initialize SignatureStorage with the value from the card
    SignatureStorage = state.sig or Signature

    -- Rebuild UI and assets
    rebuildAssets()
    self.UI.setXml(ui())

    -- Additional setup
    RefreshModelShape()
    showAura()
end

function onClick(player_color)
    -- Call StartControlledMove for both tokens
    MoveManager.call("StartControlledMove", {
        color = player_color,   -- The color of the player controlling the token
        obj = self              -- The token (self refers to this object)
    })
end

function onDestroy()
    if (ChildObjs.aura_obj ~= nil) then ChildObjs.aura_obj.destruct() end
    if (ChildObjs.sig_aura_obj ~= nil) then ChildObjs.sig_aura_obj.destruct() end
end

function onSave()
    local data = {}
    data.state = state;
    data.originalData = originalData ~= nil and originalData or state;
    return JSON.encode(data)
end

function onUpdate()
    for _, player in ipairs(Player.getPlayers()) do
        if IsPlayerSuscribed(player.color) then
            HUDLookAtPlayer(player);
        end
    end
end

function recoverState(save)
    if save.state ~= nil then
        state = save.state
    else
        state = {}
        originalData = save.originalData or {}
        state.health = originalData.health or { current = Shiphealth, max = Shiphealth }
        state.base = originalData.base or { size = ShipbaseSize, color = {r = 1, g = 1, b = 1} }
        state.imageScale = originalData.imageScale or 1.5
		state.sig = originalData.sig or 20
    end

    state.conditions = state.conditions or {}
    state.conditions.Mode = state.conditions.Mode or 0

    -- Initialize all conditions to 0 if nil
    local conditionNames = {
        "Navigation_Offline", "Orbital_Decay", "Fire", "Weapons_Offline",
        "Scanners_Offline", "Defence_Systems_Offline", "Spikes", "Aura",
        "Activated", "Mode", "Atmosphere", "Silent_Running", "Clockwise","CounterClockwise"
    }

    for _, condName in ipairs(conditionNames) do
        state.conditions[condName] = state.conditions[condName] or 0
    end

    -- Ensure state.base.color is properly set and valid
    state.base.color = state.base.color or {r = 1, g = 1, b = 1}
end

------ STATE ACTIONS ------------------------

function SetInitialState(newState) -- To be called from the reference card
    state.state = newState.state;
    state.health = newState.health;
    state.base = newState.base;
    state.imageScale = newState.imageScale;
    state.referenceCard = newState.referenceCard;
    state.sig = newState.sig;
    SignatureStorage = newState.sig; -- Set SignatureStorage to the initial sig value
    state.Shipcost = newState.shipcost;
    RecalculateSignature() -- Recalculate signature to account for any initial spikes
end

function ModifyHealth(params)
    state.health.current = math.max(0, math.min(state.health.max, state.health.current + params.amount));
    SyncHealth()
end

function ModifyAura(params)
    -- print("ModifyAura called with amount:", params.amount)
    state.conditions.Aura = math.max(0, math.floor((state.conditions.Aura or 0) + params.amount))
    -- print("New Aura value:", state.conditions.Aura)
    showAura()
    SyncCondition("Aura")
end

function ModifyBaseSignature(amount)
    SignatureStorage = math.max(0, SignatureStorage + amount)
    -- print("Base signature modified. New base value:", SignatureStorage)
    RecalculateSignature()
end

function RecalculateSignature()
    local baseSignature = cloaked == 1 and 0 or SignatureStorage
    local spikeBonus = (state.conditions.Spikes or 0) * 3
    local newSig = baseSignature + spikeBonus
    
    -- Ensure sig doesn't go below 0
    newSig = math.max(0, newSig)
    
    if newSig ~= state.sig then
        state.sig = newSig
        -- print("Signature recalculated. Base sig:", baseSignature, "Spike bonus:", spikeBonus, "Total sig:", state.sig)
        
        -- Turn off sig aura if it was shown
        TurnOffSigAura()
    end
end

function ShowSig()
    state.sigAuraShown = not state.sigAuraShown
    if state.sigAuraShown then
        state.conditions.SigAura = state.sig
        state.conditions.TargetSig = 1  -- Light up the button
        print("Showing Ship Signature and Spikes. Value:", state.sig," Inches")
    else
        state.conditions.SigAura = 0
        state.conditions.TargetSig = 0  -- Turn off the button
        -- print("Signature aura hidden")
    end
    showSigAura()
    SyncCondition("SigAura")
    SyncCondition("TargetSig")
end

function TurnOffSigAura()
    if state.sigAuraShown then
        state.sigAuraShown = false
        state.conditions.SigAura = 0
        state.conditions.TargetSig = 0
        showSigAura()
        SyncCondition("SigAura")
        SyncCondition("TargetSig")
        print("Signature aura turned off due to Silent Running or Spike changes")
    end
end

function ModifyCondition(params)
    local previousValue = state.conditions[params.name] or 0  -- Default to 0 if nil
    if params.amount == 0 then -- toggle
        state.conditions[params.name] = math.max(0, 1 - previousValue)
    else
        if Conditions[params.name].loop ~= nil then
            state.conditions[params.name] = math.max(0, (previousValue + params.amount + Conditions[params.name].loop) % Conditions[params.name].loop)
        else
            state.conditions[params.name] = math.max(0, previousValue + params.amount)
        end
    end
    if params.name == 'Mode' then
        Sync()
    else
        print(self.getData().Nickname .. [[: ']] .. params.name .. [[' ]] .. previousValue .. [[->]] .. state.conditions[params.name])
        SyncCondition(params.name)
    end
end

function ModifyMoveRange(params)
    state.move.moveRange = math.max(0, state.move.moveRange + params.amount);
end

------ MODEL MANIPULATION -------------------

function AuraFollowObject(params)
    if ChildObjs.aura_obj ~= nil then
        ChildObjs.aura_obj.setVar('parent', params.obj);
    end
end

function AuraResetFollow()
    if ChildObjs.aura_obj ~= nil then
        ChildObjs.aura_obj.setVar('parent', self);
    end
end

function RefreshModelShape()
    local attachments = self.getAttachments()
    for key, value in pairs(attachments) do
        local modelElement = self.removeAttachment(0)
        if modelElement then
            modelElement.setCustomObject({
                image_scalar = tonumber(state.imageScale * 1)
            });
            self.addAttachment(modelElement)
        end
    end
    RefreshBaseColor()
end

function adjustTransparency(baseColor, newAlpha)
    if type(baseColor) == "table" and baseColor.r and baseColor.g and baseColor.b then
        self.setColorTint({
            r = baseColor.r,
            g = baseColor.g,
            b = baseColor.b,
            a = newAlpha / 255  -- Normalize alpha value
        })
    else
        print("Error: baseColor is not in the expected format or missing r, g, b")
    end
end

function RefreshBaseColor()
    -- Temporarily force specific values
    state.base.color = {r = 1, g = 1, b = 1}
    
    local baseColor = state.base.color

    if type(baseColor) == "table" and baseColor.r and baseColor.g and baseColor.b then
        if state.conditions.Activated == 0 then
            adjustTransparency(baseColor, 255)  -- Fully opaque
        else
            adjustTransparency(baseColor, 135)  -- Slight transparency
        end
    else
        print("Error: baseColor is not properly set in RefreshBaseColor")
    end
end

------ UI GENERATION ------------------------

function calculatePlayerRotation()
    for _, player in ipairs(Player.getPlayers()) do
        UIStatus[player.color].rotation = player.getPointerRotation() - self.getRotation().y + 180;
    end
end

function Sync()
    self.UI.setXml(ui())
end

function SyncCondition(name)
    local secondary = Conditions[name] and Conditions[name].secondary
    local imageName = (secondary == nil and name or (state.conditions[name] > 1 and name or secondary))

    for k, color in pairs({'Red', 'Blue', 'Grey', 'Black'}) do
        local conditionData = Conditions[imageName]
        local colorValue = conditionData and conditionData.color or "#FFFFFF" -- Default to white if nil
        local colorBlock = colorValue .. ((state.conditions[name] or 0) > 0 and 'ff' or '22')

        self.UI.setAttributes(color .. "_ConditionImage_" .. name, {
            color = colorBlock,
            image = imageName,
        })
        self.UI.setAttributes(color .. "_ConditionText_" .. name, {
            active = (Conditions[name] and Conditions[name].stacks and state.conditions[name] > 0 and 'true' or 'false'),
            text = state.conditions[name]
        })
    end

    if name == "Activated" then
        RefreshBaseColor()
    end
end

function SyncHealth()
    for k, color in pairs({'Red', 'Blue', 'Grey', 'Black'}) do
        self.UI.setAttributes(color .. "_HealthBar_Text", {
            text = state.health.current .. [[/]] .. state.health.max
        });
        self.UI.setAttributes(color .. "_HealthBar", {
            percentage = (state.health.current / state.health.max * 100)
        });
    end
end

function IsPlayerSuscribed(color)
    return UIStatus[color] ~= nil;
end

function HUDLookAtPlayer(player)
    local playerRotation = player.getPointerRotation();
    if playerRotation == nil then playerRotation = 0 end;
    local pointerRotation = playerRotation - self.getRotation().y + 180;
    pointerRotation = math.floor((pointerRotation + 15) / 30)
    if pointerRotation ~= UIStatus[player.color].rotation then
        self.UI.setAttribute(player.color .. '_PlayerHUDPivot', 'rotation', '0 0 ' .. -30 * pointerRotation)
        UIStatus[player.color].rotation = pointerRotation;
    end
end

function ui()
    local panelContent = ""
    for _, color in ipairs({'Blue', 'Red', 'Grey', 'Black'}) do
        local pivot = PlayerHUDPivot(color)
        if pivot then
            panelContent = panelContent .. pivot
        end
    end
    local result = [[
        <Panel color="#FFFFFFff" height="0" width="0" rectAlignment="MiddleCenter" childForceExpandWidth="true" >]] 
        .. panelContent .. 
        [[</Panel>
    ]]
    return result
end

function rebuildAssets()
    local assets = {};
    for conditionName, value in pairs(Conditions) do
        assets[#assets + 1] = { name = conditionName, url = value.url };
    end

    self.UI.setCustomAssets(assets)
end

function PlayerHUDPivot(color)
    if not UIStatus[color] then 
        return "" 
    end
    local rotation = UIStatus[color].rotation or 0
    local mode = (state.conditions and state.conditions.Mode) or 0
    local content = mode == 0 and PlayerHUDContainer(color) or Compact_PlayerHUD(color)
    if not content then 
        return "" 
    end
    local result = string.format([[
        <Panel id='%s_PlayerHUDPivot' visibility='%s' height="260" width="100" position='0 0 -340' rotation='0 0 %s' rectAlignment="MiddleCenter" childForceExpandWidth="false">
        %s
        </Panel>
    ]], color, color, tostring(-rotation), content)
    return result
end

function Compact_PlayerHUD(color)
    if not state.health then return "" end
    local healthCurrent = state.health.current or 0
    local healthMax = state.health.max or 1
    local percentage = (healthCurrent / healthMax * 100) or 0
    local conditions = Compact_HUDConditions(color) or ""
    return string.format([[
        <Panel id='PlayerHUD_Container' active='true' height="180" width="60" rectAlignment="MiddleCenter" rotation='-35 0 0' position='0 0 -680' childForceExpandWidth="false">%s
        <ProgressBar width="100%%" height="20" id="%s_HealthBar" color='#00000080' fillImageColor="#44AA22FF" percentage="%s" textColor="#00000000"/>  
        <Text id='%s_HealthBar_Text' fontSize='18' height="20" onClick='UI_ModifyHealth' text='%s/%s' color='#ffffff' fontStyle='Bold' outline='#000000' outlineSize='1 1' />
        </Panel>
    ]], conditions, color, percentage, color, healthCurrent, healthMax)
end

function PlayerHUDContainer(color)
    if not state.health then return "" end
    local healthCurrent = state.health.current or 0
    local healthMax = state.health.max or 1
    local percentage = (healthCurrent / healthMax * 100) or 0
    local conditions = HUDConditions(color) or ""
    return string.format([[
        <Panel id='PlayerHUD_Container' active='true' height="180" width="128" rectAlignment="MiddleCenter" rotation='-35 0 0' position='0 50 -700' childForceExpandWidth="false">%s
        <ProgressBar width="200%%" height="60" id="%s_HealthBar" color='#00000080' fillImageColor="#44AA22FF" percentage="%s" textColor="#00000000"/>  
        <Text id='%s_HealthBar_Text' fontSize='25' height="30" onClick='UI_ModifyHealth' text='%s/%s' color='#ffffff' fontStyle='Bold' outline='#000000' outlineSize='1 1' />
        </Panel>
    ]], conditions, color, percentage, color, healthCurrent, healthMax)
end

function Compact_HUDConditions(color)
    if not color then return "" end
    local size = 38
    local size2 = 30
    local conditions = {
        HUDSingleCondition(color, "Fire", 0.5, 2.5, size2),
        HUDSingleCondition(color,"Atmosphere", -0.5 ,2.5,size2),
        HUDSingleCondition(color, "Orbital_Decay", 1.5, 2.5, size2),
        HUDSingleCondition(color, "Scanners_Offline", 2.5, 2.5, size2),
        HUDSingleCondition(color, "Weapons_Offline", 3.5, 2.5, size2),
        HUDSingleCondition(color, "Defence_Systems_Offline", 2.5, 1.5, size2),
        HUDSingleCondition(color, "Navigation_Offline", 3.5, 1.5, size2),
        HUDSingleCondition(color, "Spikes", -0.5, 1.5, size2),
        HUDSingleCondition(color, "Aura", 1.5, -1, size),
        HUDSingleCondition(color, "Activated", 0.5, -1, size),
        HUDSingleCondition(color, "Mode", 2.5, -1, size)
    }
    return "<Panel width=\"100%\" rectAlignment=\"MiddleLeft\" position='0 0 0' >" .. table.concat(conditions) .. "</Panel>"
end

function HUDConditions(color)
    if not color then return "" end
    local size = 60
    local conditions = {
        HUDSingleCondition(color, "Fire", 0, -1, size),
        HUDSingleCondition(color,"Atmosphere", -1 ,1,size),
        HUDSingleCondition(color, "Orbital_Decay", 1, -1, size),
        HUDSingleCondition(color, "Scanners_Offline", -1, -1, size),
        HUDSingleCondition(color, "Weapons_Offline", 4, -1, size),
        HUDSingleCondition(color, "Defence_Systems_Offline", 2, -1, size),
        HUDSingleCondition(color, "Navigation_Offline", 3, -1, size),
        HUDSingleCondition(color, "Spikes", -1, 0, size),
        HUDSingleCondition(color, "Aura", 4, 1, size),
        HUDSingleCondition(color, "Activated", 4, 0, size),
        HUDSingleCondition(color, "Mode", 3, 1, size),
        HUDSingleCondition(color, "Silent_Running", 0, 1, size),
        HUDSingleCondition(color, "Clockwise", 1, 1, size),
        HUDSingleCondition(color, "CounterClockwise", 2, 1, size),
		HUDSingleCondition(color, "TargetSig", -2, 0, size)
    }
    return "<Panel width=\"100%\" rectAlignment=\"MiddleLeft\" position='0 0 0' >" .. table.concat(conditions) .. "</Panel>"
end

function UI_ModifyCondition(alt, name) if alt ~= '-3' then ModifyCondition({ name = name, amount = (alt == '-1' and 1 or (alt == '-2' and -1) or 0) }) end end

function UI_ModifyAura(p, alt) if alt ~= '-3' then ModifyAura({ amount = (alt == '-1' and 1 or (alt == '-2' and -1) or 0) }) end end

function UI_ModifyHealth(p, alt) if alt ~= '-3' then ModifyHealth({ amount = (alt == '-1' and 1 or (alt == '-2' and -1) or 0) }) end end

function UI_ModifyFire(p, alt) UI_ModifyCondition(alt, "Fire") end

function UI_ModifyOrbital_Decay(p, alt) UI_ModifyCondition("0", "Orbital_Decay") end
function UI_ModifyScanners_Offline(p, alt) UI_ModifyCondition("0", "Scanners_Offline") end
function UI_ModifyWeapons_Offline(p, alt) UI_ModifyCondition("0", "Weapons_Offline") end
function UI_ModifyDefence_Systems_Offline(p, alt) UI_ModifyCondition("0", "Defence_Systems_Offline") end
function UI_ModifyNavigation_Offline(p, alt) UI_ModifyCondition("0", "Navigation_Offline") end
function UI_ModifyActivated(p, alt) UI_ModifyCondition("0", "Activated") end

function UI_ModifyClockwise(p, alt) rotate_right() end
function UI_ModifyCounterClockwise(p, alt) rotate_left() end

function UI_ModifyAtmosphere(p, alt_click) UI_ModifyCondition("0", "Atmosphere") end

function UI_ModifySilent_Running(p, alt_click) 
    UI_ModifyCondition("0", "Silent_Running") 
    if cloaked == 1 then
       cloaked = 0
       -- print("Ship is no Longer Silent Running")
    else
       cloaked = 1
       -- print("Ship is Silent Running")
    end
    
    -- Recalculate signature to account for cloaking/decloaking and spikes
    RecalculateSignature()
    
    -- Turn off sig aura if it was shown
    TurnOffSigAura()
end

function UI_ModifyMode(p, alt) UI_ModifyCondition(alt, "Mode") end

function UI_ModifySpikes(p, alt)
    local previousSpikes = state.conditions.Spikes or 0
    UI_ModifyCondition(alt, "Spikes")
    local currentSpikes = state.conditions.Spikes or 0
    
    -- print("Spikes updated. New spike count:", currentSpikes)
    
    -- Recalculate signature to account for the change in spikes
    RecalculateSignature()
    
    -- Turn off sig aura if it was shown
    TurnOffSigAura()
end

function UI_ModifyTargetSig(p, alt) if alt ~= '-3' then ShowSig() end end

function HUDSingleCondition(color, name, x, y, size)
    if not color or not name or not x or not y or not size then
        return ""
    end
    local id = "ConditionFrame_" .. name
    local position = string.format("%s %s 0", ((x * (size + 2)) - (1.5 * size + 2)), y * ((size + 2)))
    return string.format([[
        <Panel id="%s" width="%s" height="%s" alignment='LowerLeft' position='%s' onClick='UI_Modify%s()'>
        %s
        </Panel>
    ]], id, size, size, position, name, HUDSingleConditionBody(color, name, size) or "")
end

function HUDSingleConditionBody(color, name, size)
    if not color or not name or not size or not state.conditions then
        return ""
    end
    local conditionValue = state.conditions[name] or 0
    local secondary = Conditions[name] and Conditions[name].secondary
    local imageName = (secondary == nil and name or (conditionValue > 1 and name or secondary)) or name
    local colorValue = (Conditions[imageName] and Conditions[imageName].color) or "#FFFFFF"
    local colorBlock = colorValue .. (conditionValue > 0 and 'ff' or '22')
    local isActive = (Conditions[name] and Conditions[name].stacks and conditionValue > 0) and 'true' or 'false'
    local fontSize = math.floor(size * 0.85)

    return string.format([[
        <Image id="%s_ConditionImage_%s" image="%s" color="%s" rectAlignment='LowerLeft' width='%s' height='%s'/>
        <Text id="%s_ConditionText_%s" active='%s' fontSize='%s' text='%s' color='#ffffff' fontStyle='Bold' rectAlignment='LowerLeft' outline='#000000' outlineSize='1 1' />
    ]], color, name, imageName, colorBlock, size, size, color, name, isActive, fontSize, conditionValue)
end

Conditions = {
    Navigation_Offline = { url = "https://steamusercontent-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/1005936482532211133/61DFF5B90BD47155A27EBB39E2FF8B1A3BE9ECE1/", color = "#FFFFFF", stacks = false },
    Orbital_Decay = { url = "https://steamusercontent-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/1005936482532209261/A251D38D2A437456EB2FF1034C1CA064DF1D42A5/", color = "#FFFFFF", stacks = false },
    Fire = { url = "https://steamusercontent-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/1005936482532211732/C7DDA05380D46C229FAC1DBE053A4DC1DE03B8D6/", color = "#FFFFFF", stacks = true },
    Weapons_Offline = { url = "https://steamusercontent-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/1005936482532212904/620081408ACBA2B9FCDC14B86CB7C53E44EFEC48/", color = "#FFFFFF", stacks = false },
    Scanners_Offline = { url = "https://steamusercontent-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/1005936482532212349/B7AEBA523F75B3360AFEB439BF3C1B5983892557/", color = "#FFFFFF", stacks = false },
    Defence_Systems_Offline = { url = "https://steamusercontent-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/1005936482532207697/960058AA3C70751790AE88C667738D1E1CD95F21/", color = "#FFFFFF", stacks = false },

function showAura()
    local auraSize = state.conditions.Aura or 0

    -- Scale is directly the aura size (in inches)
    local scale = auraSize

    if ChildObjs.aura_obj then
        ChildObjs.aura_obj.setScale({scale, 1, scale})
        ChildObjs.aura_obj.setPosition(self.getPosition())
        ChildObjs.aura_obj.setRotation(self.getRotation())
    else
        local clr = self.getColorTint()
        ChildObjs.aura_obj = spawnObject({
            type = 'custom_model',
            position = self.getPosition(),
            rotation = self.getRotation(),
            scale = {scale, 1, scale},
            mass = 0,
            use_gravity = false,
            sound = false,
            snap_to_grid = false,
            callback_function = function(b)
                b.setColorTint(clr)
                b.setVar('parent', self)
                b.setLuaScript([[
                    function onUpdate()
                        if parent and parent.getPosition then
                            self.setPosition(parent.getPosition())
                            self.setRotation(parent.getRotation())
                        end
                    end
                ]])
                b.getComponent('MeshRenderer').set('receiveShadows', false)
            end
        })
        ChildObjs.aura_obj.setCustomObject({
            mesh = 'https://steamusercontent-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/2450611726223935325/77C02DD7AC66A61A2F30452D73585D02DFE0D72D/',

            material = 3,
            specularIntensity = 0,
            cast_shadows = false
        })
    end

    if auraSize == 0 and ChildObjs.aura_obj then
        ChildObjs.aura_obj.setScale({0, 0, 0})
    else
        ChildObjs.aura_obj.setScale({scale, 1, scale})
    end
end

function showSigAura()
    local auraSize = state.conditions.SigAura or 0

    if ChildObjs.sig_aura_obj then
        if scale == 0 then
            -- Hide the aura object
            ChildObjs.sig_aura_obj.setScale({0, 0, 0})
        else
            -- Show and update the aura object
            ChildObjs.sig_aura_obj.setScale({scale, 1, scale})
            ChildObjs.sig_aura_obj.setPosition(self.getPosition())
            ChildObjs.sig_aura_obj.setRotation(self.getRotation())

ObjectStates.LuaScript:
MIN_VALUE = 1
MAX_VALUE = 9

function onload(saved_data)
    light_mode = false
    tooltip_show = false
    val = 0

    if saved_data ~= "" then
        local loaded_data = JSON.decode(saved_data)
        light_mode = loaded_data[1]
        val = loaded_data[2]
        tooltip_show = loaded_data[3]
    end

    createAll()
end

function updateSave()
    local data_to_save = {light_mode, val, tooltip_show}
    saved_data = JSON.encode(data_to_save)
    self.script_state = saved_data
end

function createAll()
    s_color = {0.9, 0.9, 0.9, 100}

    if light_mode then
        f_color = {0.85,0.1,0.1,95}
    else
        f_color = {0.1,0.1,0.1,100}
    end

    if tooltip_show then
        ttText = "     " .. val .. "\n" .. self.getName()
    else
        ttText = self.getName()
    end

    self.createButton({
      label=tostring(val),
      click_function="add_subtract",
      tooltip=ttText,
      function_owner=self,
      position={0,0.05,0.2},
      height=600,
      width=1000,
      alignment = 3,
      scale={x=1.5, y=1.5, z=1.5},
      font_size=900,
      font_color=s_color,
      color={0,0,0,0}
      })

    setTooltips()
end

function removeAll()
    self.removeInput(0)
    self.removeButton(0)
    self.removeButton(1)
    self.removeButton(2)
    self.removeButton(3)
end

function reloadAll()
    removeAll()
    createAll()
    setTooltips()
    updateSave()
end

function swap_fcolor(_obj, _color, alt_click)
    light_mode = not light_mode
    reloadAll()
end

function swap_align(_obj, _color, alt_click)
    center_mode = not center_mode
    reloadAll()
end

function swap_tooltip(_obj, _color, alt_click)
    tooltip_show = not tooltip_show
    reloadAll()
    setTooltips()
end

function editName(_obj, _string, value) 
    self.setName(value)
    setTooltips()
end

function add_subtract(_obj, _color, alt_click)
    mod = alt_click and -1 or 1
    new_value = math.min(math.max(val + mod, MIN_VALUE), MAX_VALUE)
    if val ~= new_value then
        val = new_value
        updateVal()
        updateSave()
    end
end

function updateVal()
    if tooltip_show then
        ttText = "     " .. val .. "\n" .. self.getName()
    else
        ttText = self.getName()
    end

    self.editButton({
        index = 0,
        label = tostring(val),
        tooltip = ttText
        })
end

function reset_val()
    val = 0
    updateVal()
    updateSave()
end

function setTooltips()
    if tooltip_show then
        ttText = "     " .. val .. "\n" .. self.getName()
    else
        ttText = self.getName()
    end

    self.editButton({
        index = 0,
        value = tostring(val),
        tooltip = ttText
        })
end

function null()
end

function keepSample(_obj, _string, value) 
    reloadAll()
end

function increment()
    -- Simulate a regular click (increment)
    add_subtract(nil, nil, false)
end

function onPickedUp()  uq = 1  end

function onCollisionEnter(c)
    if not getObjectFromGUID(Global.getVar("im")) then seeList() end
    if uq then
        uq = nil  local g = "ADDED: "  od = string.char(13)  oa = string.char(10)
        local o = c.collision_object.name  if o == "Table_Custom" then do return  end  end
        local a = c.collision_object.guid  local b = ""  if a then b = " ("..a..")" end
        local s = getObjectFromGUID(Global.getVar("im")).getLuaScript()
        local x = string.sub(s, string.len(s), string.len(s))  if x == od or x == oa then s = string.sub(s, 1, string.len(s)-1) end
        local x = string.sub(s, string.len(s), string.len(s))  if x == od or x == oa then s = string.sub(s, 1, string.len(s)-1) end
        s = s..od..oa  local n = string.find(s, a)
        if n then  g = "REMOVED: "  s = string.sub(s, 1, n-1)..string.sub(s, n+6)
            else s = s.."X"..a.."@"  end
        s = string.gsub(s, "-", "X")  s = string.gsub(s, od, "@")  s = string.gsub(s, oa, "@")
        s = string.gsub(s, "XX", "X")  s = string.gsub(s, "@@", "@")  s = string.gsub(s, "X@", "")
        s = string.gsub(s, "XX", "X")  s = string.gsub(s, "@@", "@")  s = string.gsub(s, "X@", "")
        s = string.gsub(s, "X", "--")  s = string.gsub(s, "@", od..oa)
        getObjectFromGUID(Global.getVar("im")).setLuaScript(s)
        broadcastToAll(g..o..b, {0.943, 0.745, 0.14})
    end
end

function seeList()
    local aoj = {}  aoj = getAllObjects()  local g = aoj[1]  local n = 1  uq = nil
    while g do
        if g.getName() == "Ignore Me" then Global.setVar("im", g.getGUID())  uq = 1  end
        n = n+1  g = aoj[n]
    end
end

function FindDeploymentOverlay()
    if DeploymentOverlay == nil then
        DeploymentOverlay = getObjectFromGUID("08e8d1");
        if DeploymentOverlay == nil then
            for _, guid in pairs({"08e8d1", "c59152", "c92e74", "4256fc", "bd9cf2", "96a3a8", "420c4f", "17a801", "6e51e0", "a6bddd", "b6df4a", "22c453", "680a82", "5d3a9e"}) do
                DeploymentOverlay = getObjectFromGUID(guid);
                if DeploymentOverlay ~= nil then
                    break;
                end
            end
            if DeploymentOverlay == nil then
                print("Error: No DeploymentOverlay found");
            end
        end
    end
end


function StateToDeployment(depState)
    if     depState == 1 then return "Line"
    elseif depState == 2 then return "Table Corners"
    elseif depState == 3 then return "Midboard"
    elseif depState == 4 then return "From Corners"
    elseif depState == 5 then return "Attacker Defender"
    elseif depState == 6 then return "Encirclement"
    elseif depState == 7 then return "Green Planet"
    elseif depState == 8 then return "Ash"
    elseif depState == 9 then return "Icy"
    elseif depState == 10 then return "Nocturnal"
    elseif depState == 11 then return "Lava"
    elseif depState == 12 then return "Lake"
    elseif depState == 13 then return "Title Screen"
    elseif depState == 14 then return "Hidden"
    else   return "????"
    end
end

function ChangeModeDeployment()
    print("ChangeModeDeployment called")
    FindDeploymentOverlay();
    if DeploymentOverlay == nil then
        print("Error: DeploymentOverlay not found, cannot change deployment");
        return;
    end
    if UIState == nil then
        print("Error: UIState is nil");
        return;
    end
    if UIState.deployment == nil then
        print("Error: UIState.deployment is nil");
        UIState.deployment = {mode = 1, rotation = 0}
    end
    UIState.deployment.mode = (UIState.deployment.mode % 14) + 1;  -- Now cycles through 14 states
    if UIState.deployment.mode == 14 then
        -- Handle the "Hidden" state
        DeploymentOverlay.setPosition(Vector(0,0.95,0));
    else
        DeploymentOverlay.setPosition(Vector(0,0.95,0));
        DeploymentOverlay.setRotation(Vector(0, UIState.deployment.rotation * 90,0));
    end
    DeploymentOverlay.setState(UIState.deployment.mode);
    print('Deployment set to "' .. StateToDeployment(UIState.deployment.mode) .. '"');
end


function RotateDeployment()
    FindDeploymentOverlay();
    UIState.deployment.rotation = (UIState.deployment.rotation +1)%4;
    DeploymentOverlay.setRotation(Vector(0, UIState.deployment.rotation * 90,0));
end

function CallMenuAction(player, name)
    print("CallMenuAction called with name:", name)
    
    if GeneralMenuOptions == nil then
        print("Error: GeneralMenuOptions is nil")
        return
    end

    for k, v in pairs(GeneralMenuOptions) do
        if string.lower(string.gsub(k, "[^a-zA-Z]", "")) == string.lower(string.gsub(name, "[^a-zA-Z]", "")) then
            print("Match found for:", k)
            if v.action == nil then
                print("Error: No action found for name:", k)
            else
                print("Calling action for:", k)
                if v.action == "process_fleet_ui" then
                    -- Call the function on the Fleet Spawner object
                    if FleetSpawner then
                        FleetSpawner.call("process_fleet_ui", {color = player.color})
                    else
                        print("Error: FleetSpawner not found")
                    end
                else
                    -- Handle other menu actions as before
                    local func = _G[v.action]
                    if type(func) == "function" then
                        func()
                    else
                        print("Error: Action is not a valid function:", v.action)
                    end
                end
            end
            return
        end
    end

    print("Error: No option found for name:", name)
end

function RefreshAllShips()
    local allObjects = getAllObjects()
    local refreshCount = 0
    
    for _, obj in ipairs(allObjects) do
        if obj.getVar("RSS_Class") == "Model" then
            obj.call("RefreshShip")
            refreshCount = refreshCount + 1
        end
    end
    
    -- Only broadcast if ships were actually refreshed
    if refreshCount > 0 then
        broadcastToAll("All ships have been refreshed!", {1,1,1})
    else
        broadcastToAll("No ships found to refresh.", {1,0.8,0.8})
    end
end

function Reset_Round_ui()
    --print("Reset button clicked - beginning ship search")
    local shipCount = 0
    
    -- Reset all ships
    for _, obj in ipairs(getAllObjects()) do
        if obj.getVar("RSS_Class") == "Model" then
            shipCount = shipCount + 1
            
            obj.call("ModifyCondition", {
                name = "Activated",
                amount = -1
            })
            
            --print("Reset ship: " .. obj.getName())
        end
    end
    
    -- Find and increment round counter
    for _, obj in ipairs(getAllObjects()) do
        if obj.getName():find("Round") then  -- Adjust this name check based on your counter's name
            -- Simulate a regular click on the counter (non-alt-click for increment)
            obj.call("add_subtract", {})
            print("Incremented round counter")
            break  -- Only increment the first round counter found
        end
    end
    
    --print("Reset attempt complete")
    --print("Ships processed: " .. shipCount)
    
    if shipCount > 0 then
        broadcastToAll("Reset Ship Activations and advanced to next round", {r=1, g=1, b=0})
    else
        broadcastToAll("No ships found to reset", {r=1, g=1, b=0})
    end
end

[b]Space Telescope:[/b] 
When this ship uses the Active Scan special order, the target ship receives a Major Spike instead of a Minor Spike. 

If the target ship is on Silent Running and successfully revealed, it receives a Minor Spike. 

Additionally, place a Telescope token on that ship. 

A ship may have only 1 Telescope token. 

You may remove the Telescope token when the ship’s Group is targeted by a single friendly group. 

If so, the firing Group’s weapon systems targeting that ship score Critical hits when exceeding their Lock value by one rather than the usual two. 

For example, a weapon with a 3+ Lock will cause a Critical hit on a 4+ and a weapon with a 5+ Lock will cause a Critical hit on a 6+.

function onSave()
    local data_to_save = {['saved_damage']=current_health, ['saved_orbit']=current_orbit, ['saved_spike']=current_spike}
    saved_data = JSON.encode(data_to_save)
    --saved_data = ""
    return saved_data
end

function onload(saved_data)
    	generateButtonParameters()
    	Ship_Health = 4
    	Orbit = 3
    	Spike = 0
    	b_display_health.label = tostring(Ship_Health)
    	self.createButton(b_display_health)
    	self.createButton(b_display_orbit)
    	self.createButton(b_display_spike)

        --If there is saved data set it
        if saved_data ~= "" then
            local loaded_data = JSON.decode(saved_data)
            --Set up information off of loaded_data
            Ship_Health = loaded_data.saved_damage
            Orbit = loaded_data.saved_orbit
            Spike = loaded_data.saved_spike
        end
        -- Set default values
        current_health = Ship_Health
        damage_display()

        current_orbit = Orbit
        orbit_display()

        current_spike = Spike
        spike_display()


end

    if (alt_click) then
        current_health = current_health + 1
    else
        current_health = current_health - 1
    end

    damage_display()
end

    if (current_health < 0) then
        current_health = 0

    if (current_health <= Ship_Health / 2) then

    else
        b_display_health.color = {r=1, g=1, b=1}

function onSave()
    local data_to_save = {['saved_damage']=current_health, ['saved_orbit']=current_orbit, ['saved_spike']=current_spike}
    saved_data = JSON.encode(data_to_save)
    --saved_data = ""
    return saved_data
end

function onload(saved_data)
    	generateButtonParameters()
    	Ship_Health = 28
    	Orbit = 3
    	Spike = 0
    Hard1 = 1
    	b_display_health.label = tostring(Ship_Health)
    	self.createButton(b_display_health)
    	self.createButton(b_display_orbit)
    	self.createButton(b_display_spike)
    	self.createButton(b_display_hard1)
    	self.createButton(b_display_hard2)
    	self.createButton(b_display_hard3)
    	self.createButton(b_display_hard4)
self.createButton(b_display_hard5)
self.createButton(b_display_hard6)
self.createButton(b_display_hard7)
self.createButton(b_display_hard8)


        --If there is saved data set it
        if saved_data ~= "" then
            local loaded_data = JSON.decode(saved_data)
            --Set up information off of loaded_data
            Ship_Health = loaded_data.saved_damage
            Orbit = loaded_data.saved_orbit
            Spike = loaded_data.saved_spike
        end
        -- Set default values
        current_health = Ship_Health
        damage_display()

        current_orbit = Orbit
        orbit_display()

        current_spike = Spike
        spike_display()

        current_hard1 = Hard1
        current_hard2 = Hard1
        current_hard3 = Hard1
        current_hard4 = Hard1
        current_hard5 = Hard1
        current_hard6 = Hard1
        current_hard7 = Hard1
        current_hard8 = Hard1

end

function damage_counter(obj, color, alt_click)
    if (alt_click) then
        current_health = current_health + 1
    else
        current_health = current_health - 1
    end

    damage_display()
end

function damage_display()

    if (current_health < 0) then
        current_health = 0
    end

    if (current_health <= Ship_Health / 2) then
        b_display_health.color = {r=1, g=0, b=0}
    else
        b_display_health.color = {r=1, g=1, b=1}
    end

	b_display_health.label = tostring(current_health)
    b_display_health.tooltip = tostring(current_health)
    self.editButton(b_display_health)

end

function change_orbit(obj, color, alt_click)
    if (alt_click) then
        current_orbit = current_orbit + 1
    else
        current_orbit = current_orbit - 1
    end

    orbit_display()
end

function orbit_display()

    if (current_orbit < 1) then
            current_orbit = 3
    end

    if (current_orbit > 3) then
            current_orbit = 1
    end

    if (current_orbit == 3) then
        b_display_orbit.color = {r=0.25, g=0.25, b=0.25}
        b_display_orbit.label = ' '
        b_display_orbit.tooltip = 'High Orbit'


    end

    if (current_orbit == 2) then
        b_display_orbit.color = {r=1, g=1, b=1}
        b_display_orbit.label = '='
        b_display_orbit.tooltip = 'Low Orbit'
    end

    if (current_orbit == 1) then
        b_display_orbit.color = {r=1, g=1, b=1}
        b_display_orbit.label = ' '
        b_display_orbit.tooltip = 'Atmosphere'
    end

        self.editButton(b_display_orbit)
end

function change_spike(obj, color, alt_click)
    if (alt_click) then
        current_spike = current_spike - 1
    else
        current_spike = current_spike + 1
    end

    spike_display()

end

function spike_display()
    if (current_spike > 3) then
            current_spike = 0
    end

    if (current_spike < 0) then
            current_spike = 3
    end

    if (current_spike == 0) then
        b_display_spike.color = {r=0.25, g=0.25, b=0.25}
        b_display_spike.tooltip = "No Spike"
    end

    if (current_spike == 1) then
        b_display_spike.color = {r=1, g=1, b=0}
        b_display_spike.tooltip = "Minor Spike"
    end

    if (current_spike == 2) then
        b_display_spike.color = {r=1, g=0, b=0}
        b_display_spike.tooltip = "Major Spike"
    end

    if (current_spike == 3) then

function onSave()
    local data_to_save = {['saved_damage']=current_health, ['saved_orbit']=current_orbit, ['saved_spike']=current_spike}
    saved_data = JSON.encode(data_to_save)
    --saved_data = ""
    return saved_data
end

function onload(saved_data)
    	generateButtonParameters()
    	Ship_Health = 30
    	Orbit = 3
    	Spike = 0
    	b_display_health.label = tostring(Ship_Health)
    	self.createButton(b_display_health)
    	self.createButton(b_display_orbit)
    	self.createButton(b_display_spike)

        --If there is saved data set it
        if saved_data ~= "" then
            local loaded_data = JSON.decode(saved_data)
            --Set up information off of loaded_data
            Ship_Health = loaded_data.saved_damage
            Orbit = loaded_data.saved_orbit
            Spike = loaded_data.saved_spike
        end
        -- Set default values
        current_health = Ship_Health
        damage_display()

        current_orbit = Orbit
        orbit_display()

        current_spike = Spike
        spike_display()


end

function damage_counter(obj, color, alt_click)
    if (alt_click) then
        current_health = current_health + 1
    else
        current_health = current_health - 1
    end

    damage_display()
end

function damage_display()

    if (current_health < 0) then
        current_health = 0
    end

    if (current_health <= Ship_Health / 2) then
        b_display_health.color = {r=1, g=0, b=0}
    else
        b_display_health.color = {r=1, g=1, b=1}
    end

	b_display_health.label = tostring(current_health)
    b_display_health.tooltip = tostring(current_health)
    self.editButton(b_display_health)

end

function change_orbit(obj, color, alt_click)
    if (alt_click) then
        current_orbit = current_orbit + 1
    else
        current_orbit = current_orbit - 1
    end

    orbit_display()
end

function orbit_display()

    if (current_orbit < 1) then
            current_orbit = 3
    end

    if (current_orbit > 3) then
            current_orbit = 1
    end

    if (current_orbit == 3) then
        b_display_orbit.color = {r=0.25, g=0.25, b=0.25}
        b_display_orbit.label = ' '
        b_display_orbit.tooltip = 'High Orbit'

    end

    if (current_orbit == 2) then
        b_display_orbit.color = {r=1, g=1, b=1}
        b_display_orbit.label = '='
        b_display_orbit.tooltip = 'Low Orbit'
    end

    if (current_orbit == 1) then
        b_display_orbit.color = {r=1, g=1, b=1}
        b_display_orbit.label = ' '
        b_display_orbit.tooltip = 'Atmosphere'
    end

        self.editButton(b_display_orbit)
end

function change_spike(obj, color, alt_click)
    if (alt_click) then
        current_spike = current_spike - 1
    else
        current_spike = current_spike + 1
    end

    spike_display()

end

function spike_display()
    if (current_spike > 3) then
            current_spike = 0
    end

    if (current_spike < 0) then
            current_spike = 3
    end

    if (current_spike == 0) then
        b_display_spike.color = {r=0.25, g=0.25, b=0.25}
        b_display_spike.tooltip = "No Spike"
    end

    if (current_spike == 1) then
        b_display_spike.color = {r=1, g=1, b=0}
        b_display_spike.tooltip = "Minor Spike"
    end

    if (current_spike == 2) then
        b_display_spike.color = {r=1, g=0, b=0}
        b_display_spike.tooltip = "Major Spike"
    end

    if (current_spike == 3) then
        b_display_spike.color = {r=0, g=0, b=1}
        b_display_spike.tooltip = "Silent Running"
    end

    self.editButton(b_display_spike)
end

function generateButtonParameters()
    	b_display_health ={
    		index=0,
            click_function='damage_counter',
            function_owner=self, label='',
            position={1,0.3,0},
            rotation={0,270,0},
            width = 300,
            height=300,
            font_size=200
    }
    	b_display_orbit ={
    		index=1,
            click_function='change_orbit',
            function_owner=self,
            label='',
            color={r=0.25,g=0.25,b=0.25},
            position={0,0.3,1},
            rotation={0,270,0},
            width = 300,
            height=300,
            font_size=600
    }
    	b_display_spike ={
    		index=2,
            click_function='change_spike',
            function_owner=self,
            label='',
            tooltip='',
            color={r=0.25,g=0.25,b=0.25},
            position={0,0.3,-1},
            rotation={0,270,0},
            width = 300,
            height=300,
            font_size=200
    }
end

    local data_to_save = {['saved_damage']=current_health, ['saved_orbit']=current_orbit, ['saved_spike']=current_spike}
    saved_data = JSON.encode(data_to_save)
    --saved_data = ""
    return saved_data
end

function onload(saved_data)
    	generateButtonParameters()
    	Ship_Health = 14
    	Orbit = 3
    	Spike = 0
    	b_display_health.label = tostring(Ship_Health)
    	self.createButton(b_display_health)
    	self.createButton(b_display_orbit)
    	self.createButton(b_display_spike)

        --If there is saved data set it
        if saved_data ~= "" then
            local loaded_data = JSON.decode(saved_data)
            --Set up information off of loaded_data
            Ship_Health = loaded_data.saved_damage
            Orbit = loaded_data.saved_orbit
            Spike = loaded_data.saved_spike
        end
        -- Set default values
        current_health = Ship_Health
        damage_display()

        current_orbit = Orbit
        orbit_display()

        current_spike = Spike
        spike_display()


end

function damage_counter(obj, color, alt_click)
    if (alt_click) then
        current_health = current_health + 1
    else
        current_health = current_health - 1
    end

    damage_display()
end

function damage_display()

    if (current_health < 0) then
        current_health = 0
    end

    if (current_health <= Ship_Health / 2) then
        b_display_health.color = {r=1, g=0, b=0}
    else
        b_display_health.color = {r=1, g=1, b=1}
    end

	b_display_health.label = tostring(current_health)
    b_display_health.tooltip = tostring(current_health)
    self.editButton(b_display_health)

end

function change_orbit(obj, color, alt_click)
    if (alt_click) then
        current_orbit = current_orbit + 1
    else
        current_orbit = current_orbit - 1
    end

    orbit_display()
end

function orbit_display()

    if (current_orbit < 1) then
            current_orbit = 3
    end

    if (current_orbit > 3) then
            current_orbit = 1
    end

    if (current_orbit == 3) then
        b_display_orbit.color = {r=0.25, g=0.25, b=0.25}
        b_display_orbit.label = ' '
        b_display_orbit.tooltip = 'High Orbit'

    end

    if (current_orbit == 2) then
        b_display_orbit.color = {r=1, g=1, b=1}
        b_display_orbit.label = '='
        b_display_orbit.tooltip = 'Low Orbit'
    end

    if (current_orbit == 1) then
        b_display_orbit.color = {r=1, g=1, b=1}
        b_display_orbit.label = ' '
        b_display_orbit.tooltip = 'Atmosphere'
    end

        self.editButton(b_display_orbit)
end

    if (alt_click) then
        current_spike = current_spike - 1
    else
        current_spike = current_spike + 1
    end

    spike_display()

end

            current_spike = 0
    end

    if (current_spike < 0) then

    if (current_spike == 0) then

    local data_to_save = {['saved_damage']=current_health, ['saved_orbit']=current_orbit, ['saved_spike']=current_spike}
    saved_data = JSON.encode(data_to_save)
    --saved_data = ""
    return saved_data
end

function onload(saved_data)
    	generateButtonParameters()
    	Ship_Health = 6
    	Orbit = 3
    	Spike = 0
    Hard1 = 1
    	b_display_health.label = tostring(Ship_Health)
    	self.createButton(b_display_health)
    	self.createButton(b_display_orbit)
    	self.createButton(b_display_spike)
    	self.createButton(b_display_hard1)
 


        --If there is saved data set it
        if saved_data ~= "" then
            local loaded_data = JSON.decode(saved_data)
            --Set up information off of loaded_data
            Ship_Health = loaded_data.saved_damage
            Orbit = loaded_data.saved_orbit
            Spike = loaded_data.saved_spike
        end
        -- Set default values
        current_health = Ship_Health
        damage_display()

        current_orbit = Orbit
        orbit_display()

        current_spike = Spike
        spike_display()

        current_hard1 = Hard1
     

end

function damage_counter(obj, color, alt_click)
    if (alt_click) then
        current_health = current_health + 1
    else
        current_health = current_health - 1
    end

    damage_display()
end

function damage_display()

    if (current_health < 0) then
        current_health = 0
    end

    if (current_health <= Ship_Health / 2) then
        b_display_health.color = {r=1, g=0, b=0}
    else
        b_display_health.color = {r=1, g=1, b=1}
    end

	b_display_health.label = tostring(current_health)
    b_display_health.tooltip = tostring(current_health)
    self.editButton(b_display_health)

end

function change_orbit(obj, color, alt_click)
    if (alt_click) then
        current_orbit = current_orbit + 1
    else
        current_orbit = current_orbit - 1
    end

    orbit_display()
end

function orbit_display()

    if (current_orbit < 1) then
            current_orbit = 3
    end

    if (current_orbit > 3) then
            current_orbit = 1
    end

    if (current_orbit == 3) then
        b_display_orbit.color = {r=0.25, g=0.25, b=0.25}
        b_display_orbit.label = ' '
        b_display_orbit.tooltip = 'High Orbit'

    end

    if (current_orbit == 2) then
        b_display_orbit.color = {r=1, g=1, b=1}
        b_display_orbit.label = '='
        b_display_orbit.tooltip = 'Low Orbit'
    end

    if (current_orbit == 1) then
        b_display_orbit.color = {r=1, g=1, b=1}
        b_display_orbit.label = ' '
        b_display_orbit.tooltip = 'Atmosphere'
    end

        self.editButton(b_display_orbit)
end

function change_hard1(obj, color, alt_click)
    if (alt_click) then
        current_hard1 = current_hard1 + 1
    else
        current_hard1 = current_hard1 - 1
    end

    hard1_display()
end

function hard1_display()

    if (current_hard1 < 1) then
            current_hard1 = 2
    end

    if (current_hard1 > 2) then
            current_hard1 = 1
    end

 if (current_hard1 == 1) then
        b_display_hard1.color = {r=0, g=0.25, b=0}
        	b_display_hard1.label = "Cloaking Crest"
        b_display_hard1.tooltip = "Gain Stealth and Partial Cloak"
 end

 if (current_hard1 == 2) then
        b_display_hard1.color = {r=0, g=0, b=0.25}
        	b_display_hard1.label = "No Crest"
        b_display_hard1.tooltip = "No Crest Equipped"
 end

        self.editButton(b_display_hard1)
end


function change_spike(obj, color, alt_click)
    if (alt_click) then
        current_spike = current_spike - 1
    else
        current_spike = current_spike + 1
    end

    spike_display()

end

function spike_display()
    if (current_spike > 3) then
            current_spike = 0
    end

    if (current_spike < 0) then
            current_spike = 3
    end

    if (current_spike == 0) then
        b_display_spike.color = {r=0.25, g=0.25, b=0.25}
        b_display_spike.tooltip = "No Spike"
    end

    if (current_spike == 1) then
        b_display_spike.color = {r=1, g=1, b=0}
        b_display_spike.tooltip = "Minor Spike"
    end

    if (current_spike == 2) then
        b_display_spike.color = {r=1, g=0, b=0}
        b_display_spike.tooltip = "Major Spike"
    end

    if (current_spike == 3) then
        b_display_spike.color = {r=0, g=0, b=1}
        b_display_spike.tooltip = "Silent Running"
    end

    self.editButton(b_display_spike)
end

function generateButtonParameters()
    	b_display_health ={
    		index=0,
            click_function='damage_counter',
            function_owner=self, label='',
            position={1,0.3,0},
            rotation={0,270,0},
            width = 300,
            height=300,
            font_size=200
    }
    	b_display_orbit ={
    		index=1,
            click_function='change_orbit',
            function_owner=self,
            label='',
            color={r=0.25,g=0.25,b=0.25},
            position={1,0.3,1},
            rotation={0,270,0},
            width = 300,
            height=300,
            font_size=600
    }
    	b_display_spike ={
    		index=2,
            click_function='change_spike',
            function_owner=self,
            label='',
            tooltip='',
            color={r=0.25,g=0.25,b=0.25},
            position={1,0.3,-1},
            rotation={0,270,0},
            width = 300,
            height=300,
            font_size=200
    }

    	b_display_hard1 ={
    		index=3,
            click_function='change_hard1',
            function_owner=self,
            label='',
            tooltip='',
            color={r=1,g=1,b=1},
            position={-0.5,0.3,0},
            rotation={0,270,0},
            width = 700,
            height=300,
            font_color={r=1,g=1,b=1},
            font_size=100

    }

end

--[[   Based on Character Sheet Template    by: MrStump

    If you want to manually tweek the position values:
        {0,0,0} is the center of the character sheet
        {1,0,0} is right, {-1,0,0} is left
        {0,0,-1} is up, {0,0,1} is down
        0.1 for Y is the height off of the page.
            If it was 0, it would be down inside the model of the sheet

Begin editing below:    ]]

--Set this to true while editing and false when you have finished
disableSave = false
--Remember to set this to false once you are done making changes
--Then, after you save & apply it, save your game too

--Color information for button text (r,g,b, values of 0-1)
buttonFontColor = {0,0,0}
--Color information for button background
buttonColor = {1,1,1}
--Change scale of button (Avoid changing if possible)
buttonScale = {0.1,0.1,0.1}

--This is the button placement information
defaultButtonData = {
    --Add checkboxes
    --Add editable text boxes
    textbox = {
        --[[
        pos       = the position (pasted from the helper tool)
        rows      = how many lines of text you want for this box
        width     = how wide the text box is
        font_size = size of text. This and "rows" effect overall height
        label     = what is shown when there is no text. "" = nothing

local mini = nil

local cardBackImage;
local health=20;
local sig = 10;
points = 270;
local imageScale;
local modelImage='https://steamusercontent-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/2279450101601797704/3B81B9DBC16A38A2B833C2266DB4A931CA359615/';
local name='Beelzebub';
local playerColor='Purple';
local factionColor= Color(1,1,1);

local prototypes = {
    base = 'f00f62',
}
function destruct()
    if mini ~= nil then
mini.destruct()    
    end
end

function ui_createModel()
    -- Get the current position of the object and create a new model at that position
    --print("CREATING SHIP STAGE 1")
	createModel(self.getPosition())
end

function createModel(position)
    local pos = position:add(Vector(0, 2, 0))
    local objectData = self.getData()
    local modelPrototype = getObjectFromGUID('f00f62')
    if not modelPrototype then
        print("Error: Model prototype with the given GUID was not found.")
        return
    end

    -- Clone the object without scripts
    local model = modelPrototype.clone({
        position = pos,
        snap_to_grid = false
        -- Do not set 'script = ""' to allow scripts to be copied
    })

    -- Wait for the object to be fully created
    Wait.frames(function()
        -- Set custom object properties
        model.setCustomObject({
            mesh = modelPrototype.getCustomObject().mesh,
            diffuse = modelImage,
            normal = modelPrototype.getCustomObject().normal,
            material = modelPrototype.getCustomObject().material,
            collider = modelPrototype.getCustomObject().collider,
            type = modelPrototype.type,
            image = modelImage,
            image_secondary = modelImage,
            image_scalar = imageScale,
            name = "Unnamed Model"
        })
        
        -- Set the Lua script
        local placeholderScript = modelPrototype.getLuaScript()
        model.setLuaScript(placeholderScript)
        -- print("Current Health in create model is :", health)
        -- Set script state
        local scriptState = {
            state = {
                health = {current = health, max = health},
                base = {
                    color = {r = factionColor.r, g = factionColor.g, b = factionColor.b, a = 1},
                    size = baseScale * 25
                },
                imageScale = imageScale,
                conditions = {},
                sig = sig
            },
            originalData = {
                health = {current = health, max = health},
                base = {
                    color = {r = factionColor.r, g = factionColor.g, b = factionColor.b, a = 1},
                    size = baseScale * 25
                },
                imageScale = imageScale,
                sig = sig
            }
        }
        model.script_state = JSON.encode(scriptState)
        
        -- Apply changes and set other properties
        model.setScale({x = baseScale, y = baseScale, z = baseScale})
        model.setName(name or "Unnamed Model")
        model.setDescription(objectData.Description or "")
        model.setColorTint(factionColor)
        
        -- Reload the model to apply changes
        model.reload()

        mini = model
    end, 2)
		-- model.setName(name or "Unnamed Model")
		-- model.setDescription(objectData.Description or "")
end

	
	


function ui_pingmini(player)
    if (mini ~= nil) then

        end
    end
end

function rebuildAssets()
    local root = 'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/RobMayer/TTSLibrary/master/ui/';
    local assets = {
        {name='ui_power', url=root..'power.png'},
        {name='ui_gear', url=root..'gear.png'},
        {name='ui_close', url=root..'close.png'},
        {name='ui_plus', url=root..'plus.png'},
        {name='ui_minus', url=root..'minus.png'},
        {name='ui_reload', url=root..'reload.png'},
        {name='ui_location', url=root..'location.png'},
        {name='ui_bars_new', url=root..'bars_new.png'},
        {name='ui_arrow_u', url=root..'arrow_u.png'},
        {name='ui_arrow_d', url=root..'arrow_d.png'},
        {name='ui_arrow_l', url=root..'arrow_l.png'},
        {name='ui_arrow_r', url=root..'arrow_r.png'},
    }

    assetBuffer = {}
    local bufLen = 0
    for idx,guid in pairs(mapI2G) do
        local mini = getObjectFromGUID(guid)
        if (mini ~= nil) then
            for i,marker in pairs(mini.call('getMarkers', {})) do

                    assetBuffer[marker.url] = self.guid..'_mk_'..bufLen

            end
        end

    self.UI.setCustomAssets(assets)

-- 40mm SHIP SCRIPT V3.1 10/20/2024

local BigUI_Height = -900
local SmallUI_Height = -880

RSS_Class = 'Model';

------ CLASS VARIABLES ----------------------

local ChildObjs = {
    aura_obj = nil,
    sig_aura_obj = nil
};

-- Declare global variables at the beginning
local Shiphealth = 12       -- health variable
local ShipbaseSize = 40     -- base size variable
local Shipcost = 9999        -- cost variable

local Signature = 3        -- Ship Signature Variable
local SignatureStorage = 35  -- Used for keeping track of signature
local cloaked = 0           -- Tracker for Silent running

local MenuManager = nil
local MenuManagerGUID = "15fc7f"  -- Replace this with the actual GUID of your Move Manager

local originalData = nil;
local state = {
    conditions = {
        Navigation_Offline = 0, Orbital_Decay = 0, Fire = 0, Weapons_Offline = 0,
        Scanners_Offline = 0, Defence_Systems_Offline = 0, Spikes = 0, Aura = 0, Activated = 0, Mode = 0, Atmosphere = 0, Clockwise = 0, CounterClockwise = 0, Silent_Running = 0
    },
    tokens = {},
    health = { current = Shiphealth, max = Shiphealth },
    base = { size = ShipbaseSize, color = {r = 255, g = 255, b = 255} },
    imageScale = 1.5,
    moveHistory = {},
    sigAuraShown = false,
    sig = Signature,
    referenceCard = { GUID = '', obj = nil }
};

local UIStatus = {
    Blue = { rotation = -2 },
    Red = { rotation = -2 },
    Black = { rotation = -2 },
    Grey = { rotation = -2 }
};

-- New variable to track the current UI mode
local currentUIMode = 0  -- 0: High Visibility, 1: Subtle, 2: Compact

-- Add this at the top of your script
local UI_SCALE = 1.3  -- Adjust this value to scale all UI elements
local BACKGROUND_COLOR = "#000000CC"  -- More opaque background
local TEXT_COLOR = "#FFFFFFFF"  -- Bright white text
local OUTLINE_COLOR = "#000000"
local OUTLINE_SIZE = "2 2"  -- Thicker outline

------ LIFE CYCLE EVENTS --------------------

function onLoad(save)
    -- Decode save data
    local data = JSON.decode(save) or {}

    -- Restore state
    recoverState(data)

    -- Retrieve MenuManager
    MenuManager = getObjectFromGUID(MenuManagerGUID)

    -- Ensure Move Manager registration
    if MenuManager then
        MenuManager.call("RegisterToken", { obj = self, guid = self.getGUID() })
    else
        print("Error: Could not find Move Manager object.")
    end

    -- Initialize SignatureStorage with the value from the card
    SignatureStorage = state.sig or Signature

    -- Rebuild UI and assets
    rebuildAssets()
    self.UI.setXml(ui())

    -- Additional setup
    RefreshModelShape()
    showAura()
end

function onClick(player_color)
    -- Call StartControlledMove for both tokens
    MoveManager.call("StartControlledMove", {
        color = player_color,   -- The color of the player controlling the token
        obj = self              -- The token (self refers to this object)
    })
end

function onDestroy()
    if (ChildObjs.aura_obj ~= nil) then ChildObjs.aura_obj.destruct() end
    if (ChildObjs.sig_aura_obj ~= nil) then ChildObjs.sig_aura_obj.destruct() end
end

function onSave()
    local data = {}
    data.state = state;
    data.originalData = originalData ~= nil and originalData or state;
    return JSON.encode(data)
end

function onUpdate()
    for _, player in ipairs(Player.getPlayers()) do
        if IsPlayerSuscribed(player.color) then
            HUDLookAtPlayer(player);
        end
    end
end

function recoverState(save)
    if save.state ~= nil then
        state = save.state
    else
        state = {}
        originalData = save.originalData or {}
        state.health = originalData.health or { current = Shiphealth, max = Shiphealth }
        state.base = originalData.base or { size = ShipbaseSize, color = {r = 1, g = 1, b = 1} }
        state.imageScale = originalData.imageScale or 1.5
        state.sig = originalData.sig or 20
    end

    state.conditions = state.conditions or {}
    state.conditions.Mode = state.conditions.Mode or 0

    -- Initialize all conditions to 0 if nil
    local conditionNames = {
        "Navigation_Offline", "Orbital_Decay", "Fire", "Weapons_Offline",
        "Scanners_Offline", "Defence_Systems_Offline", "Spikes", "Aura",
        "Activated", "Mode", "Atmosphere", "Silent_Running", "Clockwise","CounterClockwise"
    }

    for _, condName in ipairs(conditionNames) do
        state.conditions[condName] = state.conditions[condName] or 0
    end

    -- Ensure state.base.color is properly set and valid
    state.base.color = state.base.color or {r = 1, g = 1, b = 1}
end

------ STATE ACTIONS ------------------------

function SetInitialState(newState) -- To be called from the reference card
    state.state = newState.state;
    state.health = newState.health;
    state.base = newState.base;
    state.imageScale = newState.imageScale;
    state.referenceCard = newState.referenceCard;
    state.sig = newState.sig;
    SignatureStorage = newState.sig; -- Set SignatureStorage to the initial sig value
    state.Shipcost = newState.shipcost;
    RecalculateSignature() -- Recalculate signature to account for any initial spikes
end

function ModifyHealth(params)
    state.health.current = math.max(0, math.min(state.health.max, state.health.current + params.amount));
    SyncHealth()
end

function ModifyAura(params)
    state.conditions.Aura = math.max(0, math.floor((state.conditions.Aura or 0) + params.amount))
    showAura()
    SyncCondition("Aura")
end

function ModifyBaseSignature(amount)
    SignatureStorage = math.max(0, SignatureStorage + amount)
    RecalculateSignature()
end

function RecalculateSignature()
    local baseSignature = cloaked == 1 and 0 or SignatureStorage
    local spikeBonus = (state.conditions.Spikes or 0) * 3
    local newSig = baseSignature + spikeBonus
    
    -- Ensure sig doesn't go below 0
    newSig = math.max(0, newSig)
    
    if newSig ~= state.sig then
        state.sig = newSig
        
        -- Turn off sig aura if it was shown
        TurnOffSigAura()
    end
end

function ShowSig()
    state.sigAuraShown = not state.sigAuraShown
    if state.sigAuraShown then
        state.conditions.SigAura = state.sig
        state.conditions.TargetSig = 1  -- Light up the button
        print("Showing Ship Signature and Spikes. Value:", state.sig," Inches")
    else
        state.conditions.SigAura = 0
        state.conditions.TargetSig = 0  -- Turn off the button
    end
    showSigAura()
    SyncCondition("SigAura")
    SyncCondition("TargetSig")
end

function TurnOffSigAura()
    if state.sigAuraShown then
        state.sigAuraShown = false
        state.conditions.SigAura = 0
        state.conditions.TargetSig = 0
        showSigAura()
        SyncCondition("SigAura")
        SyncCondition("TargetSig")
        print("Signature aura turned off due to Silent Running or Spike changes")
    end
end

function ModifyCondition(params)
    local previousValue = state.conditions[params.name] or 0  -- Default to 0 if nil
    if params.amount == 0 then -- toggle
        state.conditions[params.name] = math.max(0, 1 - previousValue)
    else
        if Conditions[params.name].loop ~= nil then
            state.conditions[params.name] = math.max(0, (previousValue + params.amount + Conditions[params.name].loop) % Conditions[params.name].loop)
        else
            state.conditions[params.name] = math.max(0, previousValue + params.amount)
        end
    end
    if params.name == 'Mode' then
        Sync()
    else
        print(self.getData().Nickname .. [[: ']] .. params.name .. [[' ]] .. previousValue .. [[->]] .. state.conditions[params.name])
        SyncCondition(params.name)
    end
end

function ModifyMoveRange(params)
    state.move.moveRange = math.max(0, state.move.moveRange + params.amount);
end

function AuraFollowObject(params)
    if ChildObjs.aura_obj ~= nil then
        ChildObjs.aura_obj.setVar('parent', params.obj);
    end
end

function AuraResetFollow()
    if ChildObjs.aura_obj ~= nil then
        ChildObjs.aura_obj.setVar('parent', self);
    end
end

function RefreshModelShape()
    local attachments = self.getAttachments()
    for key, value in pairs(attachments) do
        local modelElement = self.removeAttachment(0)
        if modelElement then
            modelElement.setCustomObject({
                image_scalar = tonumber(state.imageScale * 1)
            });
            self.addAttachment(modelElement)
        end
    end
    RefreshBaseColor()
end

function adjustTransparency(baseColor, newAlpha)
    if type(baseColor) == "table" and baseColor.r and baseColor.g and baseColor.b then
        self.setColorTint({
            r = baseColor.r,
            g = baseColor.g,
            b = baseColor.b,
            a = newAlpha / 255  -- Normalize alpha value
        })
    else
        print("Error: baseColor is not in the expected format or missing r, g, b")
    end
end

function RefreshBaseColor()
    -- Temporarily force specific values
    state.base.color = {r = 1, g = 1, b = 1}
    
    local baseColor = state.base.color

    if type(baseColor) == "table" and baseColor.r and baseColor.g and baseColor.b then
        if state.conditions.Activated == 0 then
            adjustTransparency(baseColor, 255)  -- Fully opaque
        else
            adjustTransparency(baseColor, 135)  -- Slight transparency
        end
    else
        print("Error: baseColor is not properly set in RefreshBaseColor")
    end
end

function calculatePlayerRotation()
    for _, player in ipairs(Player.getPlayers()) do
        UIStatus[player.color].rotation = player.getPointerRotation() - self.getRotation().y + 180;
    end
end

function Sync()
    self.UI.setXml(ui())
end

function SyncCondition(name)
    for k, color in pairs({'Red', 'Blue', 'Grey', 'Black'}) do
        local conditionValue = state.conditions[name] or 0
        local conditionData = Conditions[name]
        if not conditionData then
            print("Error: No condition data found for " .. name)
            return
        end
        
        local isActive = conditionValue > 0
        local imageUrl = isActive and conditionData.active_url or conditionData.url
        local colorBlock
        if currentUIMode == 1 then  -- Subtle mode
            colorBlock = conditionData.color .. (isActive and 'FF' or '22')
        else
            colorBlock = conditionData.color .. "FF"  -- Always fully opaque for other modes
        end

        self.UI.setAttributes(color .. "_ConditionImage_" .. name, {
            color = colorBlock,
            image = imageUrl,
        })
        self.UI.setAttributes(color .. "_ConditionText_" .. name, {
            active = (conditionData.stacks and isActive) and 'true' or 'false',
            text = conditionValue
        })
    end

    if name == "Activated" then
        RefreshBaseColor()
    end
end

function SyncHealth()
    for k, color in pairs({'Red', 'Blue', 'Grey', 'Black'}) do
        self.UI.setAttributes(color .. "_HealthBar_Text", {
            text = state.health.current .. [[/]] .. state.health.max
        });
        self.UI.setAttributes(color .. "_HealthBar", {
            percentage = (state.health.current / state.health.max * 100)
        });
    end
end

function IsPlayerSuscribed(color)
    return UIStatus[color] ~= nil;
end

function HUDLookAtPlayer(player)
    local playerRotation = player.getPointerRotation();
    if playerRotation == nil then playerRotation = 0 end;
    local pointerRotation = playerRotation - self.getRotation().y + 180;
    pointerRotation = math.floor((pointerRotation + 15) / 30)
    if pointerRotation ~= UIStatus[player.color].rotation then
        self.UI.setAttribute(player.color .. '_PlayerHUDPivot', 'rotation', '0 0 ' .. -30 * pointerRotation)
        UIStatus[player.color].rotation = pointerRotation;
    end
end

function ui()
    local panelContent = ""
    for _, color in ipairs({'Blue', 'Red', 'Grey', 'Black'}) do
        local pivot = PlayerHUDPivot(color)
        if pivot then
            panelContent = panelContent .. pivot
        end
    end
    local result = [[
        <Panel color="#FFFFFFff" height="0" width="0" rectAlignment="MiddleCenter" childForceExpandWidth="true" >]] 
        .. panelContent .. 
        [[</Panel>
    ]]
    return result
end

function rebuildAssets()
    local assets = {};
    for conditionName, value in pairs(Conditions) do
        assets[#assets + 1] = { name = conditionName, url = value.url };
        if value.active_url then
            assets[#assets + 1] = { name = conditionName .. "_active", url = value.active_url };
        end
    end

    self.UI.setCustomAssets(assets)
end

function PlayerHUDPivot(color)
    if not UIStatus[color] then 
        return "" 
    end
    local rotation = UIStatus[color].rotation or 0
    local content = getUIContent(color)
    if not content then 
        return "" 
    end
    local result = string.format([[
        <Panel id='%s_PlayerHUDPivot' visibility='%s' height="260" width="100" position='0 0 -340' rotation='0 0 %s' rectAlignment="MiddleCenter" childForceExpandWidth="false">
        %s
        </Panel>
    ]], color, color, tostring(-rotation), content)
    return result
end

    elseif currentUIMode == 1 then

function HUDSingleConditionBody(color, name, size)
    if not color or not name or not size or not state.conditions then
        return ""
    end
    local conditionValue = state.conditions[name] or 0
    local condition = Conditions[name]
    if not condition then
        return ""
    end
    
    local isActive = conditionValue > 0
    local imageUrl = isActive and condition.active_url or condition.url
    local colorBlock
    if currentUIMode == 1 then  -- Subtle mode
        colorBlock = condition.color .. (isActive and 'FF' or '22')  -- Fully opaque when active, partially transparent when inactive
    else
        colorBlock = condition.color .. "FF"  -- Always fully opaque for other modes
    end
    local fontSize = math.floor(size * 0.85)

    return string.format([[
        <Image id="%s_ConditionImage_%s" image="%s" color="%s" rectAlignment='MiddleCenter' width='%d' height='%d'/>

end

function showAura()
    local auraSize = state.conditions.Aura or 0

    -- Scale is directly the aura size (in inches)
    local scale = auraSize

    if ChildObjs.aura_obj then
        ChildObjs.aura_obj.setScale({scale, 1, scale})
        ChildObjs.aura_obj.setPosition(self.getPosition())
        ChildObjs.aura_obj.setRotation(self.getRotation())
    else

        ChildObjs.aura_obj = spawnObject({

            rotation = self.getRotation(),
            scale = {scale, 1, scale},
            mass = 0,
            use_gravity = false,
            sound = false,
            snap_to_grid = false,
            callback_function = function(b)
                b.setColorTint(clr)
                b.setVar('parent', self)
                b.setLuaScript([[
                    function onUpdate()
                        if parent and parent.getPosition then
                            self.setPosition(parent.getPosition())
                            self.setRotation(parent.getRotation())
                        end
                    end
                ]])
                b.getComponent('MeshRenderer').set('receiveShadows', false)
            end
        })
        ChildObjs.aura_obj.setCustomObject({

function RefreshShip()
    -- Decode save data
    local data = JSON.encode(state)  -- Assuming 'state' contains all necessary data

    -- Restore state
    recoverState(JSON.decode(data))

    -- Rebuild UI and assets
    rebuildAssets()

    -- Use Wait.frames to delay UI initialization
    Wait.frames(function()
        self.UI.setXml(ui())
        Sync()  -- Ensure UI is fully updated
        RefreshModelShape()
        showAura()
    end, 2)  -- Wait for 2 frames before initializing UI

    print(self.getName() .. " has been refreshed.")
end

    ["Bioficer Ships"] = "0bc2f6",

function createButtons()
    local buttonData = {
        {
            label="Bioficer Ships",
            click_function="doButton1",
            position={-2.5, 2.0, -1.5},
            rotation={0,180,0},

        },
        {

            rotation={0,180,0},
            color={0, 0, 1}, -- Blue
        },
        {
            label="PHR Ships",
            click_function="doButton4",
            position={-2.5, 2.0, 0},
            rotation={0,180,0},
            color={1, 1, 0}, -- Yellow
        },
        {
            label="Scourge Ships",

            position={0, 2.0, 0},
            rotation={0,180,0},
            color={1, 0, 1}, -- Magenta
        },
        {
            label="UCM Ships",

            position={2.5, 2.0, 0},
            rotation={0,180,0},
            color={0, 1, 1}, -- Cyan
        },
        {
            label="Remove All",
            click_function="doButton7",
            position={0, 2.0, 1.5},
            rotation={0,180,0},
            color={0.5, 0.5, 0.5}, -- Gray
        }
    }

    for i, btn in ipairs(buttonData) do
        self.createButton({
            label=btn.label,
            click_function=btn.click_function,
            function_owner=self,
            position=btn.position,
            rotation=btn.rotation,
            height=150,
            width=800,
            font_size=130,
            color=btn.color,

    processShipContainer(shipContainers["Bioficer Ships"])
end

end

end

end
