ObjectStates.LuaScript:
-- SHIP SCRIPT V5.2 08/04/2025
-- Added movement Projection
-- Added option for Fraction Movement
-- Added Arc Projection
-- Added ShipCard

-- 30mm
 local BigUI_Height = -700
 local SmallUI_Height = -680

-- 40mm
-- local BigUI_Height = -900
-- local SmallUI_Height = -880

-- 50mm
-- local BigUI_Height = -1100
-- local SmallUI_Height = -1080

-- 60mm
-- local BigUI_Height = -1300
-- local SmallUI_Height = -1280



RSS_Class = 'Model';

------ CLASS VARIABLES ----------------------

local ChildObjs = {
    aura_obj = nil,
    sig_aura_obj = nil,
	measurement_line = nil
};

-- Declare global variables at the beginning
TEXT_COLOR = TEXT_COLOR or "#FFFFFFFF"
OUTLINE_COLOR = OUTLINE_COLOR or "#000000"
OUTLINE_SIZE = OUTLINE_SIZE or "2 2"
local Shiphealth = 20       -- health variable
local ShipbaseSize = 40     -- base size variable
local Shipcost = 195        -- cost variable

local Signature = 30        -- Ship Signature Variable
local SignatureStorage = 35  -- Used for keeping track of signature
local cloaked = 0           -- Tracker for Silent running
local BROADCAST_CHANNEL = "Ship_Activation_Reset"
local arcsProjected = 0  -- Tracker for projected arcs

local SHIPCardURL = "https://steamusercontent-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/9676758734292095/FE0FE086CB3EE555C341EB422818ACF1E9375EFB/"

local MenuManager = nil
local MenuManagerGUID = "15fc7f"  -- Replace this with the actual GUID of your Move Manager

-- state.positionHistory = {}  -- Array to store position history
local MAX_HISTORY = 10     -- Maximum number of positions to remember
local POSITION_CHECK_INTERVAL = 1  -- How often to check position (in seconds)
local lastPosition = nil    -- Last recorded position
local lastCheckTime = 0    -- Time of last position check

local originalData = nil;
local state = {
    conditions = {
        Navigation_Offline = 0, Orbital_Decay = 0, Fire = 0, Weapons_Offline = 0,
        Scanners_Offline = 0, Defence_Systems_Offline = 0, Spikes = 0, Aura = 0, 
		Activated = 0, Mode = 0, Atmosphere = 0, Clockwise = 0, CounterClockwise = 0, 
		Silent_Running = 0, ProjectArcs = 0, ShipCard = 0 
    },
    tokens = {},
    health = { current = Shiphealth, max = Shiphealth },
    base = { size = ShipbaseSize, color = {r = 255, g = 255, b = 255} },
    imageScale = 1.5,
    moveHistory = {},
    sigAuraShown = false,
    sig = Signature,
    referenceCard = { GUID = '', obj = nil },
    positionHistory = {},
    moveNumber = 5,
    fractionNumber = 0  -- New variable for fractional movement
};

local UIStatus = {
    Blue = { rotation = -2 },
    Red = { rotation = -2 },
    Black = { rotation = -2 },
    Grey = { rotation = -2 }
};

-- Update the UI_ModifyMove function to use fractional movement
function UI_ModifyMove(p, alt)
    if alt ~= '-3' then
        local moveWhole = state.conditions.MoveNumber or 0
        local moveFraction = state.conditions.FractionNumber or 0
        local moveAmount = moveWhole + (moveFraction / 10)  -- Convert to decimal
        
        if moveAmount > 0 then
            -- Check if model is locked
            if not self.getLock() then
                -- Lock the model before moving
                self.setLock(true)
            end
            
            -- Get current position and rotation
            local currentPos = self.getPosition()
            local rotation = self.getRotation()
            
            -- Convert ship's angle to radians and add 90 degrees (π/2 radians) for rightward movement
            local shipAngle = math.rad(rotation.y)
            local moveAngle = shipAngle + math.rad(90)
            
            -- Determine direction based on alt (right-click)
            local directionMultiplier = alt == '-2' and -1 or 1  -- -1 for backward, 1 for forward
            
            -- Calculate the movement offsets using the exact angle
            local deltaX = directionMultiplier * moveAmount * math.sin(moveAngle)
            local deltaZ = directionMultiplier * moveAmount * math.cos(moveAngle)
            
            -- Calculate new position
            local newPos = {
                x = currentPos.x + deltaX,
                y = currentPos.y,  -- Maintain height
                z = currentPos.z + deltaZ
            }
            
            -- Move the model
            self.setPosition(newPos)
            
            -- Get the direction and model name for the print statement
            local direction = directionMultiplier == 1 and "forward" or "backward"
            local modelName = self.getName()
            
            -- Print movement message with fraction and color
            local colorCode = directionMultiplier == 1 and "22AA22" or "AA2222"  -- Green for forward, red for backward
            print(modelName .. " has moved " .. 
                "[" .. colorCode .. "]" .. direction .. "[-][F4641D] " .. 
                string.format("%.1f", moveAmount) .. "[-] inches ")
            
            -- Update the measurement line
            showMeasurementLine()
        end
    end
end

-- New variable to track the current UI mode
local currentUIMode = 1  -- 0: High Visibility, 1: Subtle, 2: Compact

-- Add this at the top of your script
local UI_SCALE = 1.3  -- Adjust this value to scale all UI elements
local BACKGROUND_COLOR = "#000000CC"  -- More opaque background
local TEXT_COLOR = "#FFFFFFFF"  -- Bright white text
local OUTLINE_COLOR = "#000000"
local OUTLINE_SIZE = "2 2"  -- Thicker outline

------ LIFE CYCLE EVENTS --------------------

function onLoad(save)
    -- Decode save data
    local data = JSON.decode(save) or {}
    state.moveNumber = data.moveNumber or 5
    state.fractionNumber = data.fractionNumber or 0
    
	if data.SHIPCardURL then
        SHIPCardURL = data.SHIPCardURL
    end
	
    -- Restore state
    recoverState(data)
    
    -- Initialize position tracking
    lastPosition = self.getPosition()
    lastCheckTime = Time.time
    state.positionHistory = data.positionHistory or {}

    -- Retrieve MenuManager
    MenuManager = getObjectFromGUID(MenuManagerGUID)

    -- Ensure Move Manager registration
    if MenuManager then
        MenuManager.call("RegisterToken", { obj = self, guid = self.getGUID() })
    else
        print("Error: Could not find Move Manager object.")
    end

    -- Initialize SignatureStorage with the saved base signature value, not the current sig
    SignatureStorage = data.baseSignature or state.sig or Signature

    -- Rebuild UI and assets
    rebuildAssets()
    self.UI.setXml(ui())

    -- Additional setup
    RefreshModelShape()
    showAura()
    showMeasurementLine()  -- Initialize the measurement line
    
    -- Recalculate signature based on the loaded base value and current spikes
    RecalculateSignature()
end

function onClick(player_color)
    -- Call StartControlledMove for both tokens
    MoveManager.call("StartControlledMove", {
        color = player_color,   -- The color of the player controlling the token
        obj = self              -- The token (self refers to this object)
    })
end

function onDestroy()
    -- Safely destroy child objects
    if ChildObjs.aura_obj ~= nil then ChildObjs.aura_obj.destruct() end
    if ChildObjs.sig_aura_obj ~= nil then ChildObjs.sig_aura_obj.destruct() end
    if ChildObjs.measurement_line ~= nil then ChildObjs.measurement_line.destruct() end
    
    -- Reset ProjectArcs condition safely
    if state and state.conditions and state.conditions.ProjectArcs and state.conditions.ProjectArcs > 0 then
        state.conditions.ProjectArcs = 0
        -- Don't call ResetArcs here, as it might cause recursive issues during destruction
    end
end

function onSave()
    local data = {}
    data.state = state
    data.originalData = originalData ~= nil and originalData or state
    data.positionHistory = state.positionHistory
    data.moveNumber = state.moveNumber
    data.fractionNumber = state.fractionNumber  
    data.baseSignature = SignatureStorage  -- Save the base signature separately
	data.SHIPCardURL = SHIPCardURL
    return JSON.encode(data)
end

function onUpdate()
    if not state or not state.conditions then return end
    
    -- Add safe checks for ProjectArcs condition
    if state.conditions.ProjectArcs and state.conditions.ProjectArcs > 0 and 
       ((ChildObjs.aura_obj) or (state.sigAuraShown and ChildObjs.sig_aura_obj)) then
        ProjectArcsForward()
    end
	
    for _, player in ipairs(Player.getPlayers()) do
        if IsPlayerSuscribed(player.color) then
            HUDLookAtPlayer(player)
        end
    end
    trackPosition()
    
    -- Update measurement line when ship rotates
    if ChildObjs.measurement_line then
        local rotation = self.getRotation()
        ChildObjs.measurement_line.setRotation({0, rotation.y + 90, 0})
    end
end

-- Add a new function to modify the fraction number
function UI_ModifyFractionNumber(p, alt)
    if alt ~= '-3' then
        ModifyCondition({
            name = "FractionNumber",
            amount = (alt == '-1' and 1 or (alt == '-2' and -1) or 0)
        })
        showMeasurementLine()  -- Update the measurement line
    end
end

function recoverState(save)
    if save.state ~= nil then
        state = save.state
    else
        state = {}
        originalData = save.originalData or {}
        state.health = originalData.health or { current = Shiphealth, max = Shiphealth }
        state.base = originalData.base or { size = ShipbaseSize, color = {r = 1, g = 1, b = 1} }
        state.imageScale = originalData.imageScale or 1.5
        state.sig = originalData.sig or 20
    end

    state.conditions = state.conditions or {}
    state.conditions.Mode = state.conditions.Mode or 0

    -- Initialize all conditions to 0 if nil
    local conditionNames = {
        "Navigation_Offline", "Orbital_Decay", "Fire", "Weapons_Offline",
        "Scanners_Offline", "Defence_Systems_Offline", "Spikes", "Aura",
        "Activated", "Mode", "Atmosphere", "Silent_Running", "Clockwise",
		"CounterClockwise","MoveNumber","ShipCard"
    }

    for _, condName in ipairs(conditionNames) do
        state.conditions[condName] = state.conditions[condName] or 0
    end

    -- Ensure state.base.color is properly set and valid
    state.base.color = state.base.color or {r = 1, g = 1, b = 1}
end

------ STATE ACTIONS ------------------------

function SetInitialState(newState) -- To be called from the reference card
    state.state = newState.state;
    state.health = newState.health;
    state.base = newState.base;
    state.imageScale = newState.imageScale;
    state.referenceCard = newState.referenceCard;
    state.sig = newState.sig;
    SignatureStorage = newState.sig; -- Set SignatureStorage to the initial sig value
    state.Shipcost = newState.shipcost;
    RecalculateSignature() -- Recalculate signature to account for any initial spikes
end

function ModifyHealth(params)
    state.health.current = math.max(0, math.min(state.health.max, state.health.current + params.amount));
    SyncHealth()
end

function ModifyAura(params)
    state.conditions.Aura = math.max(0, math.floor((state.conditions.Aura or 0) + params.amount))
    showAura()
    SyncCondition("Aura")
end

function ModifyBaseSignature(amount)
    SignatureStorage = math.max(0, SignatureStorage + amount)
    RecalculateSignature()
end

function RecalculateSignature()
    local baseSignature = cloaked == 1 and 0 or SignatureStorage
    local spikeBonus = (state.conditions.Spikes or 0) * 3
    local newSig = baseSignature + spikeBonus
    
    -- Ensure sig doesn't go below 0
    newSig = math.max(0, newSig)
    
    if newSig ~= state.sig then
        state.sig = newSig
        
        -- Turn off sig aura if it was shown
        TurnOffSigAura()
    end
end

function ShowSig()
    state.sigAuraShown = not state.sigAuraShown
    if state.sigAuraShown then
        state.conditions.SigAura = state.sig
        state.conditions.TargetSig = 1  -- Light up the button
        print("Showing Ship Signature and Spikes. Value:", state.sig," Inches")
    else
        state.conditions.SigAura = 0
        state.conditions.TargetSig = 0  -- Turn off the button
    end
    showSigAura()
    SyncCondition("SigAura")
    SyncCondition("TargetSig")
end

function TurnOffSigAura()
    if state.sigAuraShown then
        state.sigAuraShown = false
        state.conditions.SigAura = 0
        state.conditions.TargetSig = 0
        showSigAura()
        SyncCondition("SigAura")
        SyncCondition("TargetSig")
        print("Signature aura turned off due to Silent Running or Spike changes")
    end
end

-- Update the ModifyCondition function to handle fractionNumber wrapping (0-9)
function ModifyCondition(params)
    local previousValue = state.conditions[params.name] or 0  -- Default to 0 if nil
    if params.amount == 0 then -- toggle
        state.conditions[params.name] = math.max(0, 1 - previousValue)
    else
        if Conditions[params.name].loop ~= nil then
            state.conditions[params.name] = math.max(0, (previousValue + params.amount + Conditions[params.name].loop) % Conditions[params.name].loop)
        else
            -- Special handling for FractionNumber
            if params.name == "FractionNumber" then
                -- Increment or decrement and wrap around 0-9
                local newValue = (previousValue + params.amount) % 10
                if newValue < 0 then newValue = 9 end  -- Handle negative wrap-around
                state.conditions[params.name] = newValue
                state.fractionNumber = newValue  -- Update the state variable
            else
                state.conditions[params.name] = math.max(0, previousValue + params.amount)
            end
        end
    end
    if params.name == 'Mode' then
        Sync()
    else
        if params.name ~= "MoveNumber" and params.name ~= "FractionNumber" then
            print(self.getData().Nickname .. [[: ']] .. params.name .. [[' ]] .. previousValue .. [[->]] .. state.conditions[params.name])
        else 
            if params.name == "MoveNumber" then
                state.moveNumber = state.conditions[params.name]
            elseif params.name == "FractionNumber" then
                state.fractionNumber = state.conditions[params.name]
            end
        end
        SyncCondition(params.name)
    end
end

function ModifyMoveRange(params)
    state.move.moveRange = math.max(0, state.move.moveRange + params.amount);
end

------ MODEL MANIPULATION -------------------

function AuraFollowObject(params)
    if ChildObjs.aura_obj ~= nil then
        ChildObjs.aura_obj.setVar('parent', params.obj);
    end
end

function AuraResetFollow()
    if ChildObjs.aura_obj ~= nil then
        ChildObjs.aura_obj.setVar('parent', self);
    end
end

function RefreshModelShape()
    local attachments = self.getAttachments()
    for key, value in pairs(attachments) do
        local modelElement = self.removeAttachment(0)
        if modelElement then
            modelElement.setCustomObject({
                image_scalar = tonumber(state.imageScale * 1)
            });
            self.addAttachment(modelElement)
        end
    end
    RefreshBaseColor()
end

function adjustTransparency(baseColor, newAlpha)
    if type(baseColor) == "table" and baseColor.r and baseColor.g and baseColor.b then
        self.setColorTint({
            r = baseColor.r,
            g = baseColor.g,
            b = baseColor.b,
            a = newAlpha / 255  -- Normalize alpha value
        })
    else
        print("Error: baseColor is not in the expected format or missing r, g, b")
    end
end

function RefreshBaseColor()
    -- Temporarily force specific values
    state.base.color = {r = 1, g = 1, b = 1}
    
    local baseColor = state.base.color

    if type(baseColor) == "table" and baseColor.r and baseColor.g and baseColor.b then
        if state.conditions.Activated == 0 then
            adjustTransparency(baseColor, 255)  -- Fully opaque
        else
            adjustTransparency(baseColor, 255)  -- Slight transparency
        end
    else
        print("Error: baseColor is not properly set in RefreshBaseColor")
    end
end

------ UI GENERATION ------------------------

function calculatePlayerRotation()
    for _, player in ipairs(Player.getPlayers()) do
        UIStatus[player.color].rotation = player.getPointerRotation() - self.getRotation().y + 180;
    end
end

function Sync()
    self.UI.setXml(ui())
end

function SyncCondition(name)
    for k, color in pairs({'Red', 'Blue', 'Grey', 'Black'}) do
        local conditionValue = state.conditions[name] or 0
        local conditionData = Conditions[name]
        if not conditionData then
            --print("Error: No condition data found for " .. name)
            return
        end
        
        local isActive = conditionValue > 0
        local imageUrl = isActive and conditionData.active_url or conditionData.url
        local colorBlock
        if currentUIMode == 1 then  -- Subtle mode
            colorBlock = conditionData.color .. (isActive and 'FF' or '22')
        else
            colorBlock = conditionData.color .. "FF"  -- Always fully opaque for other modes
        end

        self.UI.setAttributes(color .. "_ConditionImage_" .. name, {
            color = colorBlock,
            image = imageUrl,
        })
        self.UI.setAttributes(color .. "_ConditionText_" .. name, {
            active = (conditionData.stacks and isActive) and 'true' or 'false',
            text = conditionValue
        })
    end

    if name == "Activated" then
        RefreshBaseColor()
    end
end

function SyncHealth()
    for k, color in pairs({'Red', 'Blue', 'Grey', 'Black'}) do
        self.UI.setAttributes(color .. "_HealthBar_Text", {
            text = state.health.current .. [[/]] .. state.health.max
        });
        self.UI.setAttributes(color .. "_HealthBar", {
            percentage = (state.health.current / state.health.max * 100)
        });
    end
end

function IsPlayerSuscribed(color)
    return UIStatus[color] ~= nil;
end

function HUDLookAtPlayer(player)
    local playerRotation = player.getPointerRotation();
    if playerRotation == nil then playerRotation = 0 end;
    local pointerRotation = playerRotation - self.getRotation().y + 180;
    pointerRotation = math.floor((pointerRotation + 15) / 30)
    if pointerRotation ~= UIStatus[player.color].rotation then
        self.UI.setAttribute(player.color .. '_PlayerHUDPivot', 'rotation', '0 0 ' .. -30 * pointerRotation)
        UIStatus[player.color].rotation = pointerRotation;
    end
end

function ui()
    local panelContent = ""
    
    -- Generate ship card panel if needed
    local shipCardPanel = ""
    if state.conditions.ShipCard > 0 then
        shipCardPanel = generateShipCardPanel()
    end
    
    for _, color in ipairs({'Blue', 'Red', 'Grey', 'Black'}) do
        local pivot = PlayerHUDPivot(color, shipCardPanel)
        if pivot then
            panelContent = panelContent .. pivot
        end
    end
    
    local result = [[
        <Panel color="#FFFFFFff" height="0" width="0" rectAlignment="MiddleCenter" childForceExpandWidth="true" >]] 
        .. panelContent .. 
        [[</Panel>
    ]]
    return result
end

function rebuildAssets()
    local assets = {};
    for conditionName, value in pairs(Conditions) do
        assets[#assets + 1] = { name = conditionName, url = value.url };
        if value.active_url then
            assets[#assets + 1] = { name = conditionName .. "_active", url = value.active_url };

function HUDSingleCondition(color, name, x, y, size)
    if not color or not name or not x or not y or not size then
        return ""
    end
    local id = "ConditionFrame_" .. name
    local position = string.format("%s %s 0", ((x * (size + 4) * UI_SCALE) - (1.5 * size + 4) * UI_SCALE), y * ((size + 4) * UI_SCALE))
    return string.format([[
        <Panel id="%s" width="%d" height="%d" alignment='LowerLeft' position='%s' onClick='UI_Modify%s()'>
        %s
        </Panel>
    ]], id, size * UI_SCALE, size * UI_SCALE, position, name, HUDSingleConditionBody(color, name, size * UI_SCALE) or "")
end

function HUDSingleConditionBody(color, name, size)
    if not color or not name or not size or not state.conditions then
        return ""
    end
    
    local condition = Conditions[name]
    if not condition then
        return ""
    end
    
    local conditionValue = state.conditions[name] or 0
    local isActive = conditionValue > 0
    local imageUrl = isActive and condition.active_url or condition.url
    local colorBlock
    if currentUIMode == 1 then
        colorBlock = condition.color .. (isActive and 'FF' or '22')
    else
        colorBlock = condition.color .. "FF"
    end
    local fontSize = math.floor(size * 0.85)
    
    -- Special handling for Move button text
    local displayText = name == "Move" and "Move" or tostring(conditionValue)
    
    return string.format([[
        <Image id="%s_ConditionImage_%s" image="%s" color="%s" rectAlignment='MiddleCenter' width='%d' height='%d'/>
        <Text id="%s_ConditionText_%s" active='%s' fontSize='%d' text='%s' color='%s' fontStyle='Bold' rectAlignment='LowerRight' outline='%s' outlineSize='%s' />
    ]], 
    color, name, imageUrl, colorBlock, size, size,
    color, name, tostring(condition.stacks and isActive), fontSize, displayText, TEXT_COLOR, OUTLINE_COLOR, OUTLINE_SIZE)
end

function ToggleProjectedArcs()
    local isProjected = state.conditions.ProjectArcs > 0
    
    if isProjected then
        -- Project the arcs forward
        ProjectArcsForward()
        print("[22AA22] Projecting ship arcs [-]")
    else
        -- Return arcs to ship
        ResetArcs()
        print("[AA2222] Resetting ship arcs [-]")
    end
end

function ProjectArcsForward()
    -- Prevent multiple calls in the same frame
    if state._projectingArcs then return end
    state._projectingArcs = true
    
    if ChildObjs.aura_obj then
        local moveWhole = state.conditions.MoveNumber or 0
        local moveFraction = state.conditions.FractionNumber or 0
        local moveAmount = moveWhole + (moveFraction / 10)  -- Convert to decimal
        
        if moveAmount > 0 then
            -- Get current position and rotation
            local currentPos = self.getPosition()
            local rotation = self.getRotation()
            
            -- Convert ship's angle to radians for forward movement
            local shipAngle = math.rad(rotation.y)
            local moveAngle = shipAngle + math.rad(90)
            
            -- Calculate the new position for the aura
            local deltaX = moveAmount * math.sin(moveAngle)
            local deltaZ = moveAmount * math.cos(moveAngle)
            
            -- Calculate projected position
            local projectedPos = {
                x = currentPos.x + deltaX,
                y = currentPos.y,  -- Maintain height
                z = currentPos.z + deltaZ
            }
            
            -- Create temporary variable to store original parent
            ChildObjs.aura_obj.setVar('originalParent', self)
            ChildObjs.aura_obj.setVar('parent', nil)
            
            -- Set new position and color
            ChildObjs.aura_obj.setPosition(projectedPos)
            ChildObjs.aura_obj.setColorTint({r = 0, g = 1, b = 0, a = 0.6})
            
            -- Update Lua script to keep position
            ChildObjs.aura_obj.setLuaScript([[
                function onUpdate()
                    -- Keep position static when projected
                end
            ]])
        end
    end
    
    -- Do the same for the signature aura if it's visible
    if state.sigAuraShown and ChildObjs.sig_aura_obj then
        local moveWhole = state.conditions.MoveNumber or 0
        local moveFraction = state.conditions.FractionNumber or 0
        local moveAmount = moveWhole + (moveFraction / 10)
        
        if moveAmount > 0 then
            local currentPos = self.getPosition()
            local rotation = self.getRotation()
            local shipAngle = math.rad(rotation.y)
            local moveAngle = shipAngle + math.rad(90)
            
            local deltaX = moveAmount * math.sin(moveAngle)
            local deltaZ = moveAmount * math.cos(moveAngle)
            
            local projectedPos = {
                x = currentPos.x + deltaX,
                y = currentPos.y,
                z = currentPos.z + deltaZ
            }
            
            ChildObjs.sig_aura_obj.setVar('originalParent', self)
            ChildObjs.sig_aura_obj.setVar('parent', nil)
            ChildObjs.sig_aura_obj.setPosition(projectedPos)
            ChildObjs.sig_aura_obj.setColorTint({r = 0, g = 1, b = 0.3, a = 0.6})
            
            ChildObjs.sig_aura_obj.setLuaScript([[
                function onUpdate()
                    -- Keep position static when projected
                end
            ]])
        end
    end
    
    -- Allow future calls to this function
    state._projectingArcs = false
end

function ResetArcs()
    if ChildObjs.aura_obj then
        -- Restore original parent
        ChildObjs.aura_obj.setVar('parent', self)
        
        -- Reset position to match ship
        ChildObjs.aura_obj.setPosition(self.getPosition())
        
        -- Reset color
        local clr = self.getColorTint()
        ChildObjs.aura_obj.setColorTint(clr)
        
        -- Reset script to follow parent
        ChildObjs.aura_obj.setLuaScript([[
            function onUpdate()
                if parent and parent.getPosition then
                    self.setPosition(parent.getPosition())
                    self.setRotation(parent.getRotation())
                end
            end
        ]])
    end
    
    -- Do the same for signature aura
    if ChildObjs.sig_aura_obj then
        ChildObjs.sig_aura_obj.setVar('parent', self)
        ChildObjs.sig_aura_obj.setPosition(self.getPosition())
        ChildObjs.sig_aura_obj.setColorTint({r = 1, g = 0, b = 0})
        
        ChildObjs.sig_aura_obj.setLuaScript([[
            function onUpdate()
                if parent and parent.getPosition then
                    self.setPosition(parent.getPosition())
                    self.setRotation(parent.getRotation())
                end
            end
        ]])
    end
end

-------- Rewind Function -------------------

function trackPosition()
    local currentTime = Time.time
    if currentTime - lastCheckTime >= POSITION_CHECK_INTERVAL then
        local currentPos = self.getPosition()
        
        -- Only record if position has changed significantly
        if lastPosition == nil or
           math.abs(currentPos.x - lastPosition.x) > 0.1 or
           math.abs(currentPos.y - lastPosition.y) > 0.1 or
           math.abs(currentPos.z - lastPosition.z) > 0.1 then
            
            -- Add new position to history
            table.insert(state.positionHistory, 1, {
                x = lastPosition and lastPosition.x or currentPos.x,
                y = lastPosition and lastPosition.y or currentPos.y,
                z = lastPosition and lastPosition.z or currentPos.z
            })
            
            -- Limit history size
            while #state.positionHistory > MAX_HISTORY do
                table.remove(state.positionHistory)
            end
            
            lastPosition = {
                x = currentPos.x,
                y = currentPos.y,
                z = currentPos.z
            }
        end
        
        lastCheckTime = currentTime
    end
end

function rewindPosition()
    if #state.positionHistory > 0 then
        local prevPos = table.remove(state.positionHistory, 1)
        self.setPosition(prevPos)
        -- Update last position to the new current position
        lastPosition = {
            x = prevPos.x,
            y = prevPos.y,
            z = prevPos.z
        }
        print("Ship rewound to previous position")
    else
        print("No previous position available")
    end
end

function UI_ModifyRewind(p, alt)
    if alt ~= '-3' then 
        rewindPosition()
    end
end

function showMeasurementLine()
    -- Tweakable variables - Adjust these to fine-tune the appearance
    local ARROW_LENGTH_MULTIPLIER = 0.5    -- How the moveAmount affects arrow length (smaller = shorter)
    local ARROW_WIDTH = 1.05                -- Width of the arrow
    local ARROW_HEIGHT = 1               -- Height of the arrow
    local ARROW_Y_OFFSET = 0             -- Height above the table
    local ARROW_FORWARD_OFFSET = 0         -- How far forward to place the arrow (can be negative)
    local ARROW_ROTATION_OFFSET = 270      -- Rotation offset in degrees
    local ARROW_COLOR = {r=0, g=1, b=0, a=0.7} -- Color (RGBA)
    local ADDITIONAL_ROTATION = {0, 0, 0}  -- Additional rotation (X, Y, Z) to flip arrow orientation
    
    local moveWhole = state.conditions.MoveNumber or 0
    local moveFraction = state.conditions.FractionNumber or 0
    local moveAmount = moveWhole + (moveFraction / 10)  -- Convert to decimal
    
    -- Only show measurement line if move amount is greater than 0
    if moveAmount > 0 then
        -- Calculate the direction vector based on ship's rotation
        local rotation = self.getRotation()
        local shipAngle = math.rad(rotation.y)
        local moveAngle = shipAngle + math.rad(90)  -- Keep at 90 for correct positioning
        
        -- Get current position
        local currentPos = self.getPosition()
        
        -- Calculate position with offset
        local arrowPos = {
            x = currentPos.x + ARROW_FORWARD_OFFSET * math.sin(moveAngle),
            y = currentPos.y + ARROW_Y_OFFSET,
            z = currentPos.z + ARROW_FORWARD_OFFSET * math.cos(moveAngle)
        }
        
        -- Create or update the measurement line
        if ChildObjs.measurement_line then
            -- Update existing line
            ChildObjs.measurement_line.setPosition(arrowPos)
            ChildObjs.measurement_line.setRotation({
                ADDITIONAL_ROTATION[1], 
                rotation.y + ARROW_ROTATION_OFFSET, 
                ADDITIONAL_ROTATION[3]
            })
            ChildObjs.measurement_line.setScale({ARROW_LENGTH_MULTIPLIER, ARROW_HEIGHT, moveAmount * ARROW_WIDTH})
        else
            -- Create new line with the custom mesh
            ChildObjs.measurement_line = spawnObject({
                type = 'Custom_Model',
                position = arrowPos,
                rotation = {
                    ADDITIONAL_ROTATION[1], 
                    rotation.y + ARROW_ROTATION_OFFSET, 
                    ADDITIONAL_ROTATION[3]
                },
                scale = {ARROW_LENGTH_MULTIPLIER, ARROW_HEIGHT, ARROW_WIDTH},
                mass = 0,
                use_gravity = false,
                sound = false,
                snap_to_grid = false,
                callback_function = function(obj)
                    -- Set color properties
                    obj.setColorTint(ARROW_COLOR)
                    obj.setVar('parent', self)
                    obj.setLuaScript([[
                        -- Tweakable variables - Must match the ones in the parent script
                        local ARROW_Y_OFFSET = ]] .. ARROW_Y_OFFSET .. [[
                        local ARROW_FORWARD_OFFSET = ]] .. ARROW_FORWARD_OFFSET .. [[
                        local ARROW_ROTATION_OFFSET = ]] .. ARROW_ROTATION_OFFSET .. [[
                        local ADDITIONAL_ROTATION_X = ]] .. ADDITIONAL_ROTATION[1] .. [[
                        local ADDITIONAL_ROTATION_Z = ]] .. ADDITIONAL_ROTATION[3] .. [[
                        
                        function onUpdate()
                            if parent and parent.getPosition then
                                -- Update position and rotation to follow the ship
                                local shipPos = parent.getPosition()
                                local shipRot = parent.getRotation()
                                
                                -- Calculate the angle for positioning
                                local shipAngle = math.rad(shipRot.y)
                                local moveAngle = shipAngle + math.rad(90)  -- Keep at 90 for correct positioning
                                
                                -- Calculate position with offset
                                local arrowPos = {
                                    x = shipPos.x + ARROW_FORWARD_OFFSET * math.sin(moveAngle),
                                    y = shipPos.y + ARROW_Y_OFFSET,
                                    z = shipPos.z + ARROW_FORWARD_OFFSET * math.cos(moveAngle)
                                }
                                
                                self.setPosition(arrowPos)
                                self.setRotation({
                                    ADDITIONAL_ROTATION_X, 
                                    shipRot.y + ARROW_ROTATION_OFFSET, 
                                    ADDITIONAL_ROTATION_Z
                                })
                            end
                        end
                    ]])
                    obj.getComponent('MeshRenderer').set('receiveShadows', false)
                end
            })
            
            -- Set custom object properties using your custom arrow mesh
            ChildObjs.measurement_line.setCustomObject({
                mesh = 'https://steamusercontent-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/9677217278061704/57037684E623F5E07758B8F6811F78DD224C8668/',
                collider = 'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/RobMayer/TTSLibrary/master/utility/null_COL.obj',
                type = 0,
                material = 3,
                specularIntensity = 0.1,
                cast_shadows = false
            })
        end
    else
        -- Hide the measurement line if move amount is 0
        if ChildObjs.measurement_line then
            ChildObjs.measurement_line.setScale({0, 0, 0})
        end
    end
end

function RefreshShip()
    -- Save current state
    local currentState = {
        conditions = state.conditions,
        health = state.health,
        base = state.base,
        imageScale = state.imageScale,
        sig = state.sig,
        sigAuraShown = state.sigAuraShown,
        -- Add any other state variables you need to preserve
    }

    -- Rebuild UI and assets
    rebuildAssets()

    -- Use Wait.frames to delay UI initialization
    Wait.frames(function()
        -- Restore saved state
        for key, value in pairs(currentState) do
            state[key] = value
        end

        -- Reinitialize UI and other visual elements
        self.UI.setXml(ui())
        Sync()  -- Ensure UI is fully updated
        RefreshModelShape()
        showAura()
        if state.sigAuraShown then
            showSigAura()
        end
        showMeasurementLine()  -- Refresh the measurement line
        
        -- Recalculate any derived values
        RecalculateSignature()

        print(self.getName() .. " has been refreshed.")
    end, 2)  -- Wait for 2 frames before initializing UI
end

    rebuildAssets()
    self.UI.setXml(ui())

    -- Additional setup
    RefreshModelShape()
    showAura()

function onDestroy()
    -- Safely destroy child objects
    if ChildObjs.aura_obj ~= nil then ChildObjs.aura_obj.destruct() end
    if ChildObjs.sig_aura_obj ~= nil then ChildObjs.sig_aura_obj.destruct() end
    if ChildObjs.measurement_line ~= nil then ChildObjs.measurement_line.destruct() end
    
    -- Reset ProjectArcs condition safely
    if state and state.conditions and state.conditions.ProjectArcs and state.conditions.ProjectArcs > 0 then
        state.conditions.ProjectArcs = 0
        -- Don't call ResetArcs here, as it might cause recursive issues during destruction
    end
end

function onSave()
    local data = {}
    data.state = state
    data.originalData = originalData ~= nil and originalData or state
    data.positionHistory = state.positionHistory
    data.moveNumber = state.moveNumber
    data.fractionNumber = state.fractionNumber  
    data.baseSignature = SignatureStorage  -- Save the base signature separately
	data.SHIPCardURL = SHIPCardURL
    return JSON.encode(data)
end

function onUpdate()
    if not state or not state.conditions then return end
    
    -- Add safe checks for ProjectArcs condition
    if state.conditions.ProjectArcs and state.conditions.ProjectArcs > 0 and 
       ((ChildObjs.aura_obj) or (state.sigAuraShown and ChildObjs.sig_aura_obj)) then
        ProjectArcsForward()
    end
	
    for _, player in ipairs(Player.getPlayers()) do
        if IsPlayerSuscribed(player.color) then
            HUDLookAtPlayer(player)
        end
    end
    trackPosition()
    
    -- Update measurement line when ship rotates
    if ChildObjs.measurement_line then
        local rotation = self.getRotation()
        ChildObjs.measurement_line.setRotation({0, rotation.y + 90, 0})
    end
end

function recoverState(save)

        state = save.state
    else
        state = {}

        state.health = originalData.health or { current = Shiphealth, max = Shiphealth }
        state.base = originalData.base or { size = ShipbaseSize, color = {r = 1, g = 1, b = 1} }
        state.imageScale = originalData.imageScale or 1.5
        state.sig = originalData.sig or 20
    end

    state.conditions = state.conditions or {}
    state.conditions.Mode = state.conditions.Mode or 0

    -- Initialize all conditions to 0 if nil
    local conditionNames = {
        "Navigation_Offline", "Orbital_Decay", "Fire", "Weapons_Offline",

        "Activated", "Mode", "Atmosphere", "Silent_Running", "Clockwise",
		"CounterClockwise","MoveNumber","ShipCard"
    }

    for _, condName in ipairs(conditionNames) do
        state.conditions[condName] = state.conditions[condName] or 0
    end

    -- Ensure state.base.color is properly set and valid
    state.base.color = state.base.color or {r = 1, g = 1, b = 1}

function SetInitialState(newState) -- To be called from the reference card
    state.state = newState.state;
    state.health = newState.health;
    state.base = newState.base;
    state.imageScale = newState.imageScale;
    state.referenceCard = newState.referenceCard;
    state.sig = newState.sig;
    SignatureStorage = newState.sig; -- Set SignatureStorage to the initial sig value
    state.Shipcost = newState.shipcost;
    RecalculateSignature() -- Recalculate signature to account for any initial spikes
end

function ModifyHealth(params)
    state.health.current = math.max(0, math.min(state.health.max, state.health.current + params.amount));
    SyncHealth()
end

function ModifyAura(params)
    state.conditions.Aura = math.max(0, math.floor((state.conditions.Aura or 0) + params.amount))
    showAura()
    SyncCondition("Aura")
end

function ModifyBaseSignature(amount)
    SignatureStorage = math.max(0, SignatureStorage + amount)
    RecalculateSignature()
end

function RecalculateSignature()
    local baseSignature = cloaked == 1 and 0 or SignatureStorage
    local spikeBonus = (state.conditions.Spikes or 0) * 3
    local newSig = baseSignature + spikeBonus
    
    -- Ensure sig doesn't go below 0
    newSig = math.max(0, newSig)
    
    if newSig ~= state.sig then
        state.sig = newSig
        
        -- Turn off sig aura if it was shown
        TurnOffSigAura()
    end
end

function ShowSig()
    state.sigAuraShown = not state.sigAuraShown
    if state.sigAuraShown then
        state.conditions.SigAura = state.sig
        state.conditions.TargetSig = 1  -- Light up the button
        print("Showing Ship Signature and Spikes. Value:", state.sig," Inches")
    else
        state.conditions.SigAura = 0
        state.conditions.TargetSig = 0  -- Turn off the button
    end
    showSigAura()
    SyncCondition("SigAura")
    SyncCondition("TargetSig")
end

function TurnOffSigAura()
    if state.sigAuraShown then
        state.sigAuraShown = false
        state.conditions.SigAura = 0
        state.conditions.TargetSig = 0
        showSigAura()
        SyncCondition("SigAura")
        SyncCondition("TargetSig")
        print("Signature aura turned off due to Silent Running or Spike changes")
    end
end

-- Update the ModifyCondition function to handle fractionNumber wrapping (0-9)
function ModifyCondition(params)
    local previousValue = state.conditions[params.name] or 0  -- Default to 0 if nil
    if params.amount == 0 then -- toggle
        state.conditions[params.name] = math.max(0, 1 - previousValue)
    else
        if Conditions[params.name].loop ~= nil then
            state.conditions[params.name] = math.max(0, (previousValue + params.amount + Conditions[params.name].loop) % Conditions[params.name].loop)
        else
            -- Special handling for FractionNumber
            if params.name == "FractionNumber" then
                -- Increment or decrement and wrap around 0-9
                local newValue = (previousValue + params.amount) % 10
                if newValue < 0 then newValue = 9 end  -- Handle negative wrap-around
                state.conditions[params.name] = newValue
                state.fractionNumber = newValue  -- Update the state variable
            else
                state.conditions[params.name] = math.max(0, previousValue + params.amount)
            end
        end
    end
    if params.name == 'Mode' then
        Sync()
    else
        if params.name ~= "MoveNumber" and params.name ~= "FractionNumber" then
            print(self.getData().Nickname .. [[: ']] .. params.name .. [[' ]] .. previousValue .. [[->]] .. state.conditions[params.name])
        else 
            if params.name == "MoveNumber" then
                state.moveNumber = state.conditions[params.name]
            elseif params.name == "FractionNumber" then
                state.fractionNumber = state.conditions[params.name]
            end
        end
        SyncCondition(params.name)
    end
end

function ModifyMoveRange(params)
    state.move.moveRange = math.max(0, state.move.moveRange + params.amount);
end

function RefreshModelShape()
    local attachments = self.getAttachments()
    for key, value in pairs(attachments) do
        local modelElement = self.removeAttachment(0)
        if modelElement then
            modelElement.setCustomObject({
                image_scalar = tonumber(state.imageScale * 1)
            });
            self.addAttachment(modelElement)
        end
    end
    RefreshBaseColor()
end

function adjustTransparency(baseColor, newAlpha)
    if type(baseColor) == "table" and baseColor.r and baseColor.g and baseColor.b then
        self.setColorTint({
            r = baseColor.r,
            g = baseColor.g,
            b = baseColor.b,
            a = newAlpha / 255  -- Normalize alpha value
        })
    else
        print("Error: baseColor is not in the expected format or missing r, g, b")
    end
end

function RefreshBaseColor()
    -- Temporarily force specific values
    state.base.color = {r = 1, g = 1, b = 1}
    
    local baseColor = state.base.color

    if type(baseColor) == "table" and baseColor.r and baseColor.g and baseColor.b then
        if state.conditions.Activated == 0 then
            adjustTransparency(baseColor, 255)  -- Fully opaque
        else
            adjustTransparency(baseColor, 255)  -- Slight transparency
        end
    else
        print("Error: baseColor is not properly set in RefreshBaseColor")
    end
end

function SyncCondition(name)
    for k, color in pairs({'Red', 'Blue', 'Grey', 'Black'}) do
        local conditionValue = state.conditions[name] or 0
        local conditionData = Conditions[name]
        if not conditionData then
            --print("Error: No condition data found for " .. name)
            return
        end
        
        local isActive = conditionValue > 0
        local imageUrl = isActive and conditionData.active_url or conditionData.url
        local colorBlock
        if currentUIMode == 1 then  -- Subtle mode
            colorBlock = conditionData.color .. (isActive and 'FF' or '22')
        else
            colorBlock = conditionData.color .. "FF"  -- Always fully opaque for other modes
        end

        self.UI.setAttributes(color .. "_ConditionImage_" .. name, {
            color = colorBlock,
            image = imageUrl,
        })
        self.UI.setAttributes(color .. "_ConditionText_" .. name, {
            active = (conditionData.stacks and isActive) and 'true' or 'false',
            text = conditionValue
        })
    end

    if name == "Activated" then
        RefreshBaseColor()
    end
end

function SyncHealth()
    for k, color in pairs({'Red', 'Blue', 'Grey', 'Black'}) do
        self.UI.setAttributes(color .. "_HealthBar_Text", {
            text = state.health.current .. [[/]] .. state.health.max
        });
        self.UI.setAttributes(color .. "_HealthBar", {
            percentage = (state.health.current / state.health.max * 100)
        });
    end
end

function IsPlayerSuscribed(color)
    return UIStatus[color] ~= nil;
end

function HUDLookAtPlayer(player)
    local playerRotation = player.getPointerRotation();
    if playerRotation == nil then playerRotation = 0 end;
    local pointerRotation = playerRotation - self.getRotation().y + 180;
    pointerRotation = math.floor((pointerRotation + 15) / 30)
    if pointerRotation ~= UIStatus[player.color].rotation then
        self.UI.setAttribute(player.color .. '_PlayerHUDPivot', 'rotation', '0 0 ' .. -30 * pointerRotation)
        UIStatus[player.color].rotation = pointerRotation;
    end
end

function ui()
    local panelContent = ""
    
    -- Generate ship card panel if needed
    local shipCardPanel = ""
    if state.conditions.ShipCard > 0 then
        shipCardPanel = generateShipCardPanel()
    end
    
    for _, color in ipairs({'Blue', 'Red', 'Grey', 'Black'}) do
        local pivot = PlayerHUDPivot(color, shipCardPanel)
        if pivot then
            panelContent = panelContent .. pivot
        end
    end
    
    local result = [[
        <Panel color="#FFFFFFff" height="0" width="0" rectAlignment="MiddleCenter" childForceExpandWidth="true" >]] 
        .. panelContent .. 
        [[</Panel>
    ]]
    return result
end

function rebuildAssets()
    local assets = {};
    for conditionName, value in pairs(Conditions) do
        assets[#assets + 1] = { name = conditionName, url = value.url };
        if value.active_url then
            assets[#assets + 1] = { name = conditionName .. "_active", url = value.active_url };
        end
    end

    self.UI.setCustomAssets(assets)
end

function PlayerHUDPivot(color, additionalContent)
    if not UIStatus[color] then 
        return "" 
    end
    local rotation = UIStatus[color].rotation or 0
    local content = getUIContent(color)
    if not content then 
        return "" 
    end
    
    local extraContent = additionalContent or ""
    
    local result = string.format([[
        <Panel id='%s_PlayerHUDPivot' visibility='%s' height="260" width="100" position='0 0 -340' rotation='0 0 %s' rectAlignment="MiddleCenter" childForceExpandWidth="false">
        %s

    ]], color, color, tostring(-rotation), content, extraContent)
    return result
end

    end
    
    local conditionValue = state.conditions[name] or 0
    local isActive = conditionValue > 0
    local imageUrl = isActive and condition.active_url or condition.url
    local colorBlock
    if currentUIMode == 1 then
        colorBlock = condition.color .. (isActive and 'FF' or '22')
    else
        colorBlock = condition.color .. "FF"
    end
    local fontSize = math.floor(size * 0.85)
    
    -- Special handling for Move button text
    local displayText = name == "Move" and "Move" or tostring(conditionValue)
    
    return string.format([[
        <Image id="%s_ConditionImage_%s" image="%s" color="%s" rectAlignment='MiddleCenter' width='%d' height='%d'/>
        <Text id="%s_ConditionText_%s" active='%s' fontSize='%d' text='%s' color='%s' fontStyle='Bold' rectAlignment='LowerRight' outline='%s' outlineSize='%s' />
    ]], 
    color, name, imageUrl, colorBlock, size, size,
    color, name, tostring(condition.stacks and isActive), fontSize, displayText, TEXT_COLOR, OUTLINE_COLOR, OUTLINE_SIZE)
end

function ToggleProjectedArcs()
    local isProjected = state.conditions.ProjectArcs > 0
    
    if isProjected then
        -- Project the arcs forward
        ProjectArcsForward()
        print("[22AA22] Projecting ship arcs [-]")
    else
        -- Return arcs to ship
        ResetArcs()
        print("[AA2222] Resetting ship arcs [-]")
    end
end

function ProjectArcsForward()
    -- Prevent multiple calls in the same frame
    if state._projectingArcs then return end
    state._projectingArcs = true
    
    if ChildObjs.aura_obj then
        local moveWhole = state.conditions.MoveNumber or 0
        local moveFraction = state.conditions.FractionNumber or 0
        local moveAmount = moveWhole + (moveFraction / 10)  -- Convert to decimal
        
        if moveAmount > 0 then
            -- Get current position and rotation
            local currentPos = self.getPosition()
            local rotation = self.getRotation()
            
            -- Convert ship's angle to radians for forward movement
            local shipAngle = math.rad(rotation.y)
            local moveAngle = shipAngle + math.rad(90)
            
            -- Calculate the new position for the aura
            local deltaX = moveAmount * math.sin(moveAngle)
            local deltaZ = moveAmount * math.cos(moveAngle)
            
            -- Calculate projected position
            local projectedPos = {
                x = currentPos.x + deltaX,
                y = currentPos.y,  -- Maintain height
                z = currentPos.z + deltaZ
            }
            
            -- Create temporary variable to store original parent
            ChildObjs.aura_obj.setVar('originalParent', self)
            ChildObjs.aura_obj.setVar('parent', nil)
            
            -- Set new position and color
            ChildObjs.aura_obj.setPosition(projectedPos)
            ChildObjs.aura_obj.setColorTint({r = 0, g = 1, b = 0, a = 0.6})
            
            -- Update Lua script to keep position
            ChildObjs.aura_obj.setLuaScript([[
                function onUpdate()
                    -- Keep position static when projected
                end
            ]])
        end
    end
    
    -- Do the same for the signature aura if it's visible
    if state.sigAuraShown and ChildObjs.sig_aura_obj then
        local moveWhole = state.conditions.MoveNumber or 0
        local moveFraction = state.conditions.FractionNumber or 0
        local moveAmount = moveWhole + (moveFraction / 10)
        
        if moveAmount > 0 then
            local currentPos = self.getPosition()
            local rotation = self.getRotation()
            local shipAngle = math.rad(rotation.y)
            local moveAngle = shipAngle + math.rad(90)
            
            local deltaX = moveAmount * math.sin(moveAngle)
            local deltaZ = moveAmount * math.cos(moveAngle)
            
            local projectedPos = {
                x = currentPos.x + deltaX,
                y = currentPos.y,
                z = currentPos.z + deltaZ
            }
            
            ChildObjs.sig_aura_obj.setVar('originalParent', self)
            ChildObjs.sig_aura_obj.setVar('parent', nil)
            ChildObjs.sig_aura_obj.setPosition(projectedPos)
            ChildObjs.sig_aura_obj.setColorTint({r = 0, g = 1, b = 0.3, a = 0.6})
            
            ChildObjs.sig_aura_obj.setLuaScript([[
                function onUpdate()
                    -- Keep position static when projected
                end
            ]])
        end
    end
    
    -- Allow future calls to this function
    state._projectingArcs = false
end

function ResetArcs()
    if ChildObjs.aura_obj then
        -- Restore original parent
        ChildObjs.aura_obj.setVar('parent', self)
        
        -- Reset position to match ship
        ChildObjs.aura_obj.setPosition(self.getPosition())
        
        -- Reset color
        local clr = self.getColorTint()
        ChildObjs.aura_obj.setColorTint(clr)
        
        -- Reset script to follow parent
        ChildObjs.aura_obj.setLuaScript([[
            function onUpdate()
                if parent and parent.getPosition then
                    self.setPosition(parent.getPosition())
                    self.setRotation(parent.getRotation())
                end
            end
        ]])
    end
    
    -- Do the same for signature aura
    if ChildObjs.sig_aura_obj then
        ChildObjs.sig_aura_obj.setVar('parent', self)
        ChildObjs.sig_aura_obj.setPosition(self.getPosition())
        ChildObjs.sig_aura_obj.setColorTint({r = 1, g = 0, b = 0})
        
        ChildObjs.sig_aura_obj.setLuaScript([[
            function onUpdate()
                if parent and parent.getPosition then
                    self.setPosition(parent.getPosition())
                    self.setRotation(parent.getRotation())
                end
            end
        ]])
    end
end

-------- Rewind Function -------------------

function trackPosition()
    local currentTime = Time.time
    if currentTime - lastCheckTime >= POSITION_CHECK_INTERVAL then
        local currentPos = self.getPosition()
        
        -- Only record if position has changed significantly
        if lastPosition == nil or
           math.abs(currentPos.x - lastPosition.x) > 0.1 or
           math.abs(currentPos.y - lastPosition.y) > 0.1 or
           math.abs(currentPos.z - lastPosition.z) > 0.1 then
            
            -- Add new position to history
            table.insert(state.positionHistory, 1, {
                x = lastPosition and lastPosition.x or currentPos.x,
                y = lastPosition and lastPosition.y or currentPos.y,
                z = lastPosition and lastPosition.z or currentPos.z
            })
            
            -- Limit history size
            while #state.positionHistory > MAX_HISTORY do
                table.remove(state.positionHistory)
            end
            
            lastPosition = {
                x = currentPos.x,
                y = currentPos.y,
                z = currentPos.z
            }
        end
        
        lastCheckTime = currentTime
    end
end

function rewindPosition()
    if #state.positionHistory > 0 then
        local prevPos = table.remove(state.positionHistory, 1)
        self.setPosition(prevPos)
        -- Update last position to the new current position
        lastPosition = {
            x = prevPos.x,
            y = prevPos.y,
            z = prevPos.z
        }
        print("Ship rewound to previous position")
    else
        print("No previous position available")
    end
end

function UI_ModifyRewind(p, alt)
    if alt ~= '-3' then 
        rewindPosition()
    end
end

function showAura()
    local auraSize = state.conditions.Aura or 0

    -- Scale is directly the aura size (in inches)
    local scale = auraSize

    if ChildObjs.aura_obj then
        ChildObjs.aura_obj.setScale({scale, 1, scale})
        ChildObjs.aura_obj.setPosition(self.getPosition())
        ChildObjs.aura_obj.setRotation(self.getRotation())
    else
        local clr = self.getColorTint()
        ChildObjs.aura_obj = spawnObject({
            type = 'custom_model',
            position = self.getPosition(),
            rotation = self.getRotation(),
            scale = {scale, 1, scale},
            mass = 0,
            use_gravity = false,
            sound = false,
            snap_to_grid = false,
            callback_function = function(b)
                b.setColorTint(clr)
                b.setVar('parent', self)
                b.setLuaScript([[
                    function onUpdate()
                        if parent and parent.getPosition then
                            self.setPosition(parent.getPosition())
                            self.setRotation(parent.getRotation())
                        end
                    end
                ]])
                b.getComponent('MeshRenderer').set('receiveShadows', false)
            end
        })
        ChildObjs.aura_obj.setCustomObject({
            mesh = 'https://steamusercontent-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/2450611726223935325/77C02DD7AC66A61A2F30452D73585D02DFE0D72D/',
            collider = 'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/RobMayer/TTSLibrary/master/utility/null_COL.obj',
            material = 3,
            specularIntensity = 0,
            cast_shadows = false
        })
    end

    if auraSize == 0 and ChildObjs.aura_obj then
        ChildObjs.aura_obj.setScale({0, 0, 0})
    else
        ChildObjs.aura_obj.setScale({scale, 1, scale})
    end
    
    -- If arcs are projected and aura size is non-zero, reproject them
    -- Use a slight delay and safe check
    if state.conditions.ProjectArcs and state.conditions.ProjectArcs > 0 and scale > 0 then
        -- Use a variable to prevent recursion
        if not state._reprojecting then
            state._reprojecting = true
            Wait.frames(function()
                if state and state.conditions and state.conditions.ProjectArcs and state.conditions.ProjectArcs > 0 then
                    ProjectArcsForward()
                end
                state._reprojecting = false
            end, 2)  -- Wait 2 frames to be safe
        end
    end
end

function showSigAura()
    local auraSize = state.conditions.SigAura or 0

    -- Scale is directly the aura size (in inches)

    if ChildObjs.sig_aura_obj then

    local ARROW_ROTATION_OFFSET = 270      -- Rotation offset in degrees
    local ARROW_COLOR = {r=0, g=1, b=0, a=0.7} -- Color (RGBA)
    local ADDITIONAL_ROTATION = {0, 0, 0}  -- Additional rotation (X, Y, Z) to flip arrow orientation
    
    local moveWhole = state.conditions.MoveNumber or 0
    local moveFraction = state.conditions.FractionNumber or 0
    local moveAmount = moveWhole + (moveFraction / 10)  -- Convert to decimal
    
    -- Only show measurement line if move amount is greater than 0
    if moveAmount > 0 then
        -- Calculate the direction vector based on ship's rotation
        local rotation = self.getRotation()
        local shipAngle = math.rad(rotation.y)
        local moveAngle = shipAngle + math.rad(90)  -- Keep at 90 for correct positioning
        
        -- Get current position
        local currentPos = self.getPosition()
        
        -- Calculate position with offset
        local arrowPos = {
            x = currentPos.x + ARROW_FORWARD_OFFSET * math.sin(moveAngle),
            y = currentPos.y + ARROW_Y_OFFSET,
            z = currentPos.z + ARROW_FORWARD_OFFSET * math.cos(moveAngle)
        }
        
        -- Create or update the measurement line
        if ChildObjs.measurement_line then
            -- Update existing line
            ChildObjs.measurement_line.setPosition(arrowPos)
            ChildObjs.measurement_line.setRotation({
                ADDITIONAL_ROTATION[1], 
                rotation.y + ARROW_ROTATION_OFFSET, 
                ADDITIONAL_ROTATION[3]
            })
            ChildObjs.measurement_line.setScale({ARROW_LENGTH_MULTIPLIER, ARROW_HEIGHT, moveAmount * ARROW_WIDTH})
        else
            -- Create new line with the custom mesh
            ChildObjs.measurement_line = spawnObject({
                type = 'Custom_Model',
                position = arrowPos,
                rotation = {
                    ADDITIONAL_ROTATION[1], 
                    rotation.y + ARROW_ROTATION_OFFSET, 
                    ADDITIONAL_ROTATION[3]
                },
                scale = {ARROW_LENGTH_MULTIPLIER, ARROW_HEIGHT, ARROW_WIDTH},
                mass = 0,
                use_gravity = false,
                sound = false,
                snap_to_grid = false,
                callback_function = function(obj)
                    -- Set color properties
                    obj.setColorTint(ARROW_COLOR)
                    obj.setVar('parent', self)
                    obj.setLuaScript([[
                        -- Tweakable variables - Must match the ones in the parent script
                        local ARROW_Y_OFFSET = ]] .. ARROW_Y_OFFSET .. [[
                        local ARROW_FORWARD_OFFSET = ]] .. ARROW_FORWARD_OFFSET .. [[
                        local ARROW_ROTATION_OFFSET = ]] .. ARROW_ROTATION_OFFSET .. [[
                        local ADDITIONAL_ROTATION_X = ]] .. ADDITIONAL_ROTATION[1] .. [[
                        local ADDITIONAL_ROTATION_Z = ]] .. ADDITIONAL_ROTATION[3] .. [[
                        
                        function onUpdate()
                            if parent and parent.getPosition then
                                -- Update position and rotation to follow the ship
                                local shipPos = parent.getPosition()
                                local shipRot = parent.getRotation()
                                
                                -- Calculate the angle for positioning
                                local shipAngle = math.rad(shipRot.y)
                                local moveAngle = shipAngle + math.rad(90)  -- Keep at 90 for correct positioning
                                
                                -- Calculate position with offset
                                local arrowPos = {
                                    x = shipPos.x + ARROW_FORWARD_OFFSET * math.sin(moveAngle),
                                    y = shipPos.y + ARROW_Y_OFFSET,
                                    z = shipPos.z + ARROW_FORWARD_OFFSET * math.cos(moveAngle)
                                }
                                
                                self.setPosition(arrowPos)
                                self.setRotation({
                                    ADDITIONAL_ROTATION_X, 
                                    shipRot.y + ARROW_ROTATION_OFFSET, 
                                    ADDITIONAL_ROTATION_Z
                                })
                            end
                        end
                    ]])
                    obj.getComponent('MeshRenderer').set('receiveShadows', false)
                end
            })
            
            -- Set custom object properties using your custom arrow mesh
            ChildObjs.measurement_line.setCustomObject({
                mesh = 'https://steamusercontent-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/9677217278061704/57037684E623F5E07758B8F6811F78DD224C8668/',
                collider = 'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/RobMayer/TTSLibrary/master/utility/null_COL.obj',
                type = 0,
                material = 3,
                specularIntensity = 0.1,
                cast_shadows = false
            })
        end
    else
        -- Hide the measurement line if move amount is 0
        if ChildObjs.measurement_line then
            ChildObjs.measurement_line.setScale({0, 0, 0})
        end
    end
end



------- SHIP REFRESH ---------
function RefreshShip()
    -- Save current state
    local currentState = {
        conditions = state.conditions,
        health = state.health,
        base = state.base,
        imageScale = state.imageScale,
        sig = state.sig,
        sigAuraShown = state.sigAuraShown,
        -- Add any other state variables you need to preserve
    }

    -- Rebuild UI and assets
    rebuildAssets()

    -- Use Wait.frames to delay UI initialization
    Wait.frames(function()
        -- Restore saved state
        for key, value in pairs(currentState) do
            state[key] = value
        end

        -- Reinitialize UI and other visual elements
        self.UI.setXml(ui())
        Sync()  -- Ensure UI is fully updated
        RefreshModelShape()
        showAura()
        if state.sigAuraShown then
            showSigAura()
        end
        showMeasurementLine()  -- Refresh the measurement line
        
        -- Recalculate any derived values
        RecalculateSignature()

        print(self.getName() .. " has been refreshed.")
    end, 2)  -- Wait for 2 frames before initializing UI
end

---------------SHIPCARD DISPLAY CODE----------------------
function UI_ModifyShipCard(p, alt)
    if alt ~= '-3' then 
        UI_ModifyCondition("0", "ShipCard")
        toggleShipCard()
    end
end

function toggleShipCard()
    local isShown = state.conditions.ShipCard > 0
    
    if isShown then
        print("Showing Ship Card")
    else
        print("Hiding Ship Card")
    end
    
    -- Update the UI to reflect the new state
    Sync()
end

function generateShipCardPanel()
    -- Position the card panel to the left/front of the main UI
    local panelWidth = 1500  -- Width of the card panel 
    local panelHeight = 1250 -- Height of the card panel 
    
    -- Position relative to the player pivot
    local posX = -1100       -- X position (negative to place it to the left)
    local posY = 0          -- Y position - centered vertically
    local posZ = -1000       -- Z position - slightly in front of the main UI
    
    return string.format([[
        <Panel id="ShipCardPanel" width="%d" height="%d" position="%d %d %d" rectAlignment="MiddleCenter">
            <Panel width="100%%" height="100%%" color="#000000CC">
                <Image width="90%%" height="90%%" rectAlignment="MiddleCenter" image="%s" preserveAspect="true" />
                <Button width="40" height="40" rectAlignment="TopRight" fontSize="20" text="X" onClick="UI_ModifyShipCard" color="#AA0000" textColor="#FFFFFF" />
            </Panel>
        </Panel>
    ]], panelWidth, panelHeight, posX, posY, posZ, SHIPCardURL)
end

function SetShipCardURL(params)
    if params and params.url then
        SHIPCardURL = params.url
        print("Ship card URL set to: " .. SHIPCardURL)
    end
end
