function findPreciseMatch(name, factionList)
    -- Check for famous admirals first
    if famousAdmirals[name] then
        return name
    end
    
    -- Clean the input name for comparison - remove points cost and trim
    local cleanInput = name:gsub("%[.-%]", ""):trim()
    
    -- Try direct exact match first (case insensitive)
    for _, shipName in ipairs(factionList) do
        if string.lower(shipName) == string.lower(cleanInput) then
            print("Found exact match: " .. shipName)
            return shipName
        end
    end
    
    -- For partial matches, collect all possible matches and select the LONGEST one
    -- This ensures we prefer specific ships (Centurion Grand Cruiser) over generic ones (Cruiser)
    local possibleMatches = {}
    local cleanInputLower = cleanInput:lower()
    
    -- Try with cleaned names
    for _, shipName in ipairs(factionList) do
        local cleanShipName = shipName:gsub("[%c%p%s]", ""):lower()
        local cleanInputNoSpecial = cleanInput:gsub("[%c%p%s]", ""):lower()
        
        if cleanShipName == cleanInputNoSpecial then
            table.insert(possibleMatches, {name = shipName, length = #shipName, quality = 2})
        end
    end
    
    -- Then try partial match in either direction
    for _, shipName in ipairs(factionList) do
        local shipNameLower = shipName:lower()
        
        -- Check if ship name contains input or input contains ship name
        if shipNameLower:find(cleanInputLower, 1, true) or cleanInputLower:find(shipNameLower, 1, true) then
            table.insert(possibleMatches, {name = shipName, length = #shipName, quality = 1})
        end
    end
    
    -- Sort matches first by quality (exact matches before partial), then by length (descending)
    table.sort(possibleMatches, function(a, b) 
        if a.quality ~= b.quality then
            return a.quality > b.quality
        else
            return a.length > b.length
        end
    end)
    
    -- Return the highest quality, longest match if found
    if #possibleMatches > 0 then
        print("Selected best match: " .. possibleMatches[1].name .. " (from " .. #possibleMatches .. " possible matches)")
        return possibleMatches[1].name
    end
    
    -- If no matches found, return nil
    print("No match found for: " .. name)
    return nil
end

function spawnModel(modelName, modelSlot, faction, isReference, quantity)
 if not factionContainers[faction] then
        print("[F4641D]Error: Invalid faction or faction container not defined")
        return false
    end

    currentFactionContainerGUID = factionContainers[faction]
    local factionContainerObject = getObjectFromGUID(currentFactionContainerGUID)

    if factionContainerObject == nil then
        print("[F4641D]Error: Could not find faction container for " .. faction)
        return false
    end
    
    -- Get the precise name from our list if possible
    local preciseFaction = faction
    if faction == "Bioficers" then preciseFaction = "Bioficer" end
    
    local preciseShipName = nil
    if preciseShipListByFaction[preciseFaction] then
        preciseShipName = findPreciseMatch(modelName, preciseShipListByFaction[preciseFaction])
    end
    
    -- If no match in faction-specific list, try neutral list
    if not preciseShipName and preciseShipListByFaction["Neutral"] then
        preciseShipName = findPreciseMatch(modelName, preciseShipListByFaction["Neutral"])
    end
    
    -- Use original name if no precise match found
    local nameToFind = preciseShipName or modelName
    
    -- Debug output
    if preciseShipName and preciseShipName ~= modelName then
        print("[A020F0]Using precise ship name: " .. preciseShipName .. " instead of " .. modelName)
    end

    local function cleanName(name)
        return name:gsub("[%c%p%s]", ""):lower()
    end

    -- Check if model exists in container first
    local foundContainedObject = nil
    for _, containedObject in pairs(factionContainerObject.getObjects()) do
        -- For famous admirals or precise matches, use exact name matching
        if famousAdmirals[nameToFind] or preciseShipName then
            if containedObject.name == nameToFind then
                foundContainedObject = containedObject
                break
            end
        else
            -- For regular ships with no precise match, use cleaned name matching
            if cleanName(containedObject.name) == cleanName(nameToFind) then
                foundContainedObject = containedObject
                break
            end
        end
    end

    if not foundContainedObject then
        print("[F4641D]Error: Model not found in container: " .. nameToFind)
        return false
    end
	
    -- Take object from container
    local spawnedObject = factionContainerObject.takeObject({
        index = foundContainedObject.index,
        position = getSlotPosition(modelSlot):add(Vector(0,2,0)),
        rotation = getSlotRotation(),
        callback_function = function(obj)
            obj.setCustomObject({stackable = false})
            obj.reload()
            obj.call("ui_createModel")
            
            local guid = obj.getGUID()
            spawnedObjectsByPlayer[playerColor][guid] = obj
            
            -- Clone back to container immediately
            local containerClone = obj.clone({
                position = factionContainerObject.getPosition(),
                rotation = {x=0, y=0, z=0}
            })
            
            -- Handle additional quantities through cloning
            if quantity > 1 then
                for i = 2, quantity do
                    local newPosition = getSlotPosition(modelSlot + i - 1)
                    local clonedObject = obj.clone({
                        position = newPosition,
                        rotation = getSlotRotation()
                    })
                    if clonedObject then
                        Wait.frames(function()
                            clonedObject.call("ui_createModel", {suppressLog = true})
                            local clonedGUID = clonedObject.getGUID()
                            spawnedObjectsByPlayer[playerColor][clonedGUID] = clonedObject
                        end, 1)
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    })

    return spawnedObject.getGUID()
end


function cloneModel(modelName, modelPosition, quantity)
    local cachedModel = modelCacheByPlayer[playerColor][modelName]
    if not cachedModel then
        print('[F4641D]Error: Model not found in cache: ' .. modelName)
        return false
    end
    
    local originalObject = getObjectFromGUID(cachedModel.guid)
    if not originalObject then
        print('[F4641D]Error: Original object not found for model: ' .. modelName)
        return false
    end
    
    local spawnedCount = 0
    for i = 1, quantity do
        local newPosition = getSlotPosition(modelPosition + i - 1)
        local clonedObject = originalObject.clone({
            position = newPosition,
            rotation = getSlotRotation()
        })
        if clonedObject then
            local clonedGUID = clonedObject.getGUID()
            spawnedObjectsByPlayer[playerColor][clonedGUID] = clonedObject
            
            Wait.frames(function()
                clonedObject.call("ui_createModel")
            end, 1)
            
            spawnedCount = spawnedCount + 1
        else
            print("[F4641D]Failed to clone object")
        end
    end
    
    return spawnedCount > 0
end

    local nameToFind = preciseUpgradeName or upgradeName
    
    -- Debug output
    if preciseUpgradeName and preciseUpgradeName ~= upgradeName then
        print("[A020F0]Using precise upgrade name: " .. preciseUpgradeName .. " instead of " .. upgradeName)
    end

    for _, containedObject in pairs(upgradeContainerObject.getObjects()) do
        -- Try exact match with precise name first
        if preciseUpgradeName and containedObject.name == preciseUpgradeName then
            local spawnedUpgrade = upgradeContainerObject.takeObject({
                index = containedObject.index,
                position = position,
                rotation = getSlotRotation(),
                callback_function = function(obj)
                    obj.setCustomObject({stackable = false})
                    obj.reload()
                end,
            })
            
            -- Clone the upgrade back into the container
            spawnedUpgrade.clone({
                position = upgradeContainerObject.getPosition(),
                rotation = {x=0, y=0, z=0}
            })
            
            return spawnedUpgrade.getGUID()
        -- Fall back to original fuzzy matching as a last resort
        elseif string.lower(containedObject.name) == string.lower(nameToFind) then
            local spawnedUpgrade = upgradeContainerObject.takeObject({
                index = containedObject.index,
                position = position,
                rotation = getSlotRotation(),
                callback_function = function(obj)
                    obj.setCustomObject({stackable = false})
                    obj.reload()
                end,
            })
            
            -- Clone the upgrade back into the container
            spawnedUpgrade.clone({
                position = upgradeContainerObject.getPosition(),
                rotation = {x=0, y=0, z=0}
            })
            
            return spawnedUpgrade.getGUID()
        end
    end

    -- If not found in faction container, try the neutral container as fallback
    if faction ~= "Neutral" then
        print("Upgrade not found in " .. faction .. " container, trying Neutral container")
        return spawnUpgrade(upgradeName, position, "Neutral")
    end

    print("Upgrade not found in any container: " .. nameToFind)
    return nil
end


function cloneUpgrade(upgradeName, modelSlot, upgradeIndex, upgradeFaction)
    local faction = upgradeFaction or currentFleetFaction
    if not upgradeCache[faction] or not upgradeCache[faction][upgradeName] then
        -- Fallback to neutral cache if available
        if faction ~= "Neutral" and upgradeCache["Neutral"] and upgradeCache["Neutral"][upgradeName] then
            faction = "Neutral"
        else
            print("Upgrade not found in cache: " .. upgradeName)
            return false
        end
    end

    local originalUpgrade = getObjectFromGUID(upgradeCache[faction][upgradeName])
    if not originalUpgrade then
        print("Original upgrade object not found: " .. upgradeName)
        return false
    end

    -- Calculate a grid position for the upgrade relative to the unit slot.
    local upgradePos = getUpgradeGridPosition(modelSlot, upgradeIndex)
    local clonedUpgrade = originalUpgrade.clone({
        position = upgradePos,
        rotation = getSlotRotation()
    })

    if clonedUpgrade then
        local clonedGUID = clonedUpgrade.getGUID()
        spawnedObjectsByPlayer[playerColor][clonedGUID] = clonedUpgrade
        return true
    else
        print("[F4641D]Failed to clone upgrade: " .. upgradeName)
        return false
    end
end

function getUpgradeGridPosition(modelSlot, upgradeIndex)
    -- Get the base position for the ship's model slot.
    local basePosition = getSlotPosition(modelSlot)
    
    -- Grid parameters: 3 columns and 2 rows.
    local gridColumns = 3
    local gridRows = 2
    
    -- Define separate spacing values:
    local horizontalSpacing = 2  -- spacing between columns
    local verticalSpacing = 1.3    -- spacing between rows (further apart than columns)

    -- Convert the 1-based upgradeIndex into a zero-indexed number.
    local idx = upgradeIndex - 1

    -- Determine column and row (using row-major order).
    local col = idx % gridColumns
    local row = math.floor(idx / gridColumns)

    -- Calculate the overall grid dimensions.
    local totalGridWidth = (gridColumns - 1) * horizontalSpacing
    local totalGridDepth = (gridRows - 1) * verticalSpacing
    
    -- Center the grid relative to the base position.
    local centeringOffset = Vector(-totalGridWidth / 2, 0, -totalGridDepth / 2)

    -- Compute the upgrade's offset within the grid.
    local upgradeOffset = Vector(col * horizontalSpacing, 0, row * verticalSpacing)

    -- Apply a slight vertical lift so the upgrades don't clip with the ship.
    local verticalOffset = Vector(0, 0.5, 0)

    return basePosition + centeringOffset + upgradeOffset + verticalOffset
end

-- Update getSlotPosition function to handle upgrades
function getSlotPosition(modelSlot, isUpgrade)
    -- Change from 6 to 8 columns
    local column = modelSlot % 8
    local row = math.floor(modelSlot / 8)
    -- Decrease spacing between items by half (from 8 to 4)
    local spacing = 8
    local rowSpacing = 7
    local upgradeOffset = isUpgrade and Vector(0, 0, -2) or Vector(0, 0, 0)

    if playerColor == 'Red' then
        -- Move start position right by 7
        local startX = -81.87  -- Original was -81.54
        local startY = 1.7
        local startZ = -26.73

        local position = Vector(
            startX + row * rowSpacing,
            startY,
            startZ + column * spacing
        ) + upgradeOffset

        if modelSlot == 0 then
            position.y = startY
        end

        return position
    elseif playerColor == 'Blue' then
        -- Move start position left by 7 (since Blue side is mirrored)
        local startX = 81.14  -- Original was 80.99
        local startY = 1.44
        local startZ = 31.99

        local position = Vector(
            startX - row * rowSpacing,
            startY,
            startZ - column * spacing
        ) - upgradeOffset

        if modelSlot == 0 then
            position.y = startY
        end

        return position
    end
end

    if playerColor == 'Red' then

    end
end

function extractFactionAndShips(input)
    local processedShips = {}
    local ships = {}
    local headerShips = {} -- Track headers to avoid double counting
    local pendingUpgrades = {}
    local faction = ""
    local headersWithBullets = {} -- New table to track which headers have bullet points
    
    -- Split by newlines
    local lines = {}
    for line in input:gmatch("[^\r\n]+") do
        table.insert(lines, line)
    end
    
    -- Extract faction from first line
    local firstLine = lines[1]
    for fac, transform in pairs(factionList) do
        if firstLine:find(fac) then
            faction = transform
            break
        end
    end
    
    -- First pass: identify all headers and check which ones have bullet points
    for i, line in ipairs(lines) do
        -- Modified pattern to catch both headers with and without colons at the end
        if (line:find(":$") or line:find(" pts]:") or line:find(" pts]$")) and not line:find("^#") then
            local preciseFaction = faction
            if faction == "Bioficers" then preciseFaction = "Bioficer" end
            
            -- Extract header name without point costs
            local headerName = line:match("^([^%[]+)")
            if headerName then
                headerName = headerName:trim()
                
                -- Find the precise ship name match
                local preciseShipName = nil
                if preciseShipListByFaction[preciseFaction] then
                    preciseShipName = findPreciseMatch(headerName, preciseShipListByFaction[preciseFaction])
                end
                
                -- If not found in faction list, try neutral list
                if not preciseShipName and preciseShipListByFaction["Neutral"] then
                    preciseShipName = findPreciseMatch(headerName, preciseShipListByFaction["Neutral"])
                end
                
                if preciseShipName then
                    print("Found precise match for header: " .. headerName .. " -> " .. preciseShipName)
                    headerShips[preciseShipName] = true
                    
                    -- Check if this header has bullet points following it
                    local hasBullets = false
                    for j = i+1, #lines do
                        if lines[j]:find("^•") then
                            hasBullets = true
                            headersWithBullets[preciseShipName] = true
                            break
                        elseif lines[j]:find("^[^•%s]") and not lines[j]:find("^%+") then 
                            -- New header or section (but not upgrades starting with +)
                            break
                        end
                    end
                else
                    print("Found non-exact header: " .. headerName)
                    headerShips[headerName] = true
                    
                    -- Check for bullet points
                    local hasBullets = false
                    for j = i+1, #lines do
                        if lines[j]:find("^•") then
                            hasBullets = true
                            headersWithBullets[headerName] = true
                            break
                        elseif lines[j]:find("^[^•%s]") and not lines[j]:find("^%+") then
                            -- New header or section (but not upgrades starting with +)
                            break
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end
    
    -- Second pass: process all ships and upgrades
    for _, line in ipairs(lines) do
        -- Skip headers and configuration lines
        if line:find("^#") or line:find("^%s*$") or line:find("^Configuration") or
           line:find("Game Size:") or line:find("^%[") or line:find("^pts") then
            -- Skip these lines
        
        -- Famous admirals
        elseif line:match("^[^•]+") then
            for admiralName, _ in pairs(famousAdmirals) do
                if line:find(admiralName, 1, true) then
                    print("Found admiral: " .. admiralName)
                    ships[admiralName] = {
                        count = 1,
                        processOrder = #processedShips + 1,
                        upgrades = {}
                    }
                    processedShips[#processedShips + 1] = admiralName
                    break
                end
            end
            
        -- Check for admiral upgrades
        elseif line:match("Lvl %d+: ") then
            local upgrade = line:match("(Lvl %d+: [%w%s]+)")
            if upgrade and #processedShips > 0 then
                local firstShip = processedShips[1]
                if not ships[firstShip].upgrades then
                    ships[firstShip].upgrades = {}
                end
                table.insert(ships[firstShip].upgrades, upgrade)
                print("Added upgrade: " .. upgrade .. " to " .. firstShip)
            end
            
        -- Process bullet points with explicit counts AND their upgrades
        elseif line:find("^•%s*%d+x") then
            local count = line:match("^•%s*(%d+)x")
            count = tonumber(count) or 1
            
            local shipPart = line:match("^•%s*%d+x%s*([^%[]+)")
            if shipPart then
                -- Extract the ship name (before any ":")
                local shipName = shipPart:match("([^:]+)")
                if shipName then
                    shipName = shipName:trim()
                    
                    -- Find the exact ship name in the precise list
                    local preciseFaction = faction
                    if faction == "Bioficers" then preciseFaction = "Bioficer" end
                    
                    local exactMatch = nil
                    if preciseShipListByFaction[preciseFaction] then
                        exactMatch = findPreciseMatch(shipName, preciseShipListByFaction[preciseFaction])
                    end
                    
                    -- If not found, try neutral list
                    if not exactMatch and preciseShipListByFaction["Neutral"] then
                        exactMatch = findPreciseMatch(shipName, preciseShipListByFaction["Neutral"])
                    end
                    
                    if exactMatch then
                        print("Adding ship from bullet point: " .. exactMatch .. " x" .. count)
                        local shipUpgrades = {}
                        
                        -- Extract upgrades - can be comma-separated after the colon
                        if line:find(":") then
                            local upgradePart = line:match(":(.+)")
                            if upgradePart then
                                -- Split by commas and process each upgrade
                                for upgText in upgradePart:gmatch("[^,]+") do
                                    -- Extract count and upgrade name (e.g., "2x Fighters & Bombers")
                                    local upgCount, upgName = upgText:match("(%d+)x%s*([^,]+)")
                                    if upgCount and upgName then
                                        upgName = upgName:trim()
                                        upgCount = tonumber(upgCount)
                                        
                                        -- Add the upgrade multiple times based on count
                                        for i=1, upgCount do
                                            table.insert(shipUpgrades, upgName)
                                            print("Added upgrade with count: " .. upgName)
                                        end
                                    else
                                        -- No count prefix, just a single upgrade
                                        local singleUpgrade = upgText:trim()
                                        table.insert(shipUpgrades, singleUpgrade)
                                        print("Added single upgrade: " .. singleUpgrade)
                                    end
                                end
                            end
                        end
                        
                        ships[exactMatch] = {
                            count = count,
                            processOrder = #processedShips + 1,
                            upgrades = shipUpgrades
                        }
                        processedShips[#processedShips + 1] = exactMatch
                    else
                        print("[F4641D]Warning: Could not find precise match for " .. shipName)
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end
    
    -- Third pass: process headers that didn't have bullet points
    for shipName, _ in pairs(headerShips) do
        if not headersWithBullets[shipName] and not ships[shipName] then
            print("Adding standalone header ship: " .. shipName)
            ships[shipName] = {
                count = 1,
                processOrder = #processedShips + 1,
                upgrades = {}
            }
            processedShips[#processedShips + 1] = shipName
        end
    end
    
    -- Build output
    local output = {firstLine}
    if faction ~= "" then
        table.insert(output, "Faction: " .. faction)
    end
    
    -- Output ships in order of processing with their upgrades
    for _, shipName in ipairs(processedShips) do
        local shipData = ships[shipName]
        if shipData and shipData.count > 0 then
            table.insert(output, shipData.count .. " X " .. shipName)
            -- Add upgrades right after their associated ship
            if shipData.upgrades then
                for _, upgrade in ipairs(shipData.upgrades) do
                    if not upgrade:match("^%+") then
                        table.insert(output, "+" .. upgrade)
                    else
                        table.insert(output, upgrade)
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end
    
    return table.concat(output, "\n")
end

    if sep == nil then

    local t = {}

function generateCardList()
    local cardCounts = {}
    local objectsOnBoard = getAllObjects()
    local detectedFaction = nil
    
    -- Count cards and gather information
    for _, obj in pairs(objectsOnBoard) do
        if isOnBoard(obj) then
            local points = obj.getVar("points")
            if points and points > 0 then
                local cardName = obj.getName()
                local cardDesc = obj.getDescription()
                local key = cardName .. "|||" .. cardDesc
                
                -- Detect faction if we haven't already
                if not detectedFaction then
                    detectedFaction = getFactionFromDescription(cardDesc)
                end
                
                if cardCounts[key] then
                    cardCounts[key].count = cardCounts[key].count + 1
                else
                    cardCounts[key] = {
                        count = 1,
                        name = cardName,
                        description = cardDesc
                    }
                end
            end
        end
    end
    
    -- Create the note content

    end

    -- Convert to array for sorting
    local cardList = {}
    for _, cardInfo in pairs(cardCounts) do
        table.insert(cardList, cardInfo)
    end
    
    -- Sort by card name
    table.sort(cardList, function(a, b) return a.name < b.name end)
    
    -- Generate formatted list
    for _, cardInfo in ipairs(cardList) do
        local line = cardInfo.count .. " X " .. cardInfo.name
        noteContent = noteContent .. line .. "\n"
    end

    -- Spawn the note
    local noteParams = {
        type = "Notecard",
        position = {0, 3, 0},
        rotation = {0, 180, 0}
    }
    local note = spawnObject(noteParams)
    
    Wait.frames(function()
        note.setDescription(noteContent)
        note.setName("Saved Fleet")
    end, 1)
    
    broadcastToAll("Card list generated!", {1, 1, 1})
end

function isOnBoard(obj)
    local objPos = obj.getPosition()
    local boardPos = self.getPosition()
    local boardBounds = self.getBounds()
    
    local withinX = math.abs(objPos.x - boardPos.x) <= (boardBounds.size.x / 2)
    local withinZ = math.abs(objPos.z - boardPos.z) <= (boardBounds.size.z / 2)
    local aboveBoard = objPos.y > boardPos.y
    
    return withinX and withinZ and aboveBoard
end

-- Function to sum the points from all objects on the board
function sumPoints()
    local totalPoints = 0  -- Variable to store the total points

    -- Get all objects in the game
    local objectsOnBoard = getAllObjects()

    -- Loop through each object and sum its points if valid
    for _, obj in pairs(objectsOnBoard) do
        if isOnBoard(obj) then
            -- Try to get points from the object's Lua variable
            local points = obj.getVar("points")  -- Look for lowercase 'points'
            
            -- Debugging: Check if the points variable exists and its value
          --  if points ~= nil then
               -- print("Object: " .. obj.getName() .. " has points: " .. tostring(points))
        --    else
               -- print("Object: " .. obj.getName() .. " has no points variable.")
         --   end

            if points and points > 0 then
                totalPoints = totalPoints + points
            end
        end
    end

    -- Display the total points in the chat
    broadcastToAll("Total Points on the board: " .. totalPoints, {1, 1, 1})

-- Function to check if an object is on top of the board
function isOnBoard(obj)
    -- Get the position of the object and the board
    local objPos = obj.getPosition()
    local boardPos = self.getPosition()
    local boardBounds = self.getBounds()

    -- Check if the object is within the X and Z bounds of the board
    local withinX = math.abs(objPos.x - boardPos.x) <= (boardBounds.size.x / 2)
    local withinZ = math.abs(objPos.z - boardPos.z) <= (boardBounds.size.z / 2)
    
    -- Check if the object is above the board in the Y axis (height)
    local aboveBoard = objPos.y > boardPos.y

    -- Return true if the object is within the board's bounds and above the board
    return withinX and withinZ and aboveBoard
end

-- List definitions
local deploymentTypes = {"1. Line", "2. Table Quarters", "3. Midboard", "4. From Corners", "5. Attacker Defender", "6. Encirclement"}
local approachTypes = {"1. Standoff - Directly Deploy - Directly Deploy", "2. Close Enough - Close - Close", "3. Column - Distant - Distant", "4. Counterattack - Directly Deploy - Close", "5. Delayed Response - Close - Distant", "6. Home Fleet Disadvantage - Close - Directly Deploy"}
local layouts = {"1. Diagonal", "2. Edge Case", "3. Eruption", "4. Gatecrash", "5. Moonlight", "6. Moonstruck"}
local variants = {"1. Guarded Sectors", "2. Secure Comms Array", "3. Battlescarred", "4. Gridlocked", "5. Expansive Atmosphere", "6. Orbital Complex"}
local objectives = {"1. Attrition", "2. Survey", "3. Extract", "4. Protect", "5. Breakthrough", "6. Raise"}

-- Function to randomly select from a list
function getRandomFromList(list, maxIndex)
    maxIndex = maxIndex or #list
    return list[math.random(1, maxIndex)]
end

-- Function to generate and display random mission (original version)
function randomMission()
    local randomDeployment = getRandomFromList(deploymentTypes)
    local randomApproach = getRandomFromList(approachTypes)
    local randomLayout = getRandomFromList(layouts)
    local randomVariant = getRandomFromList(variants)
    local randomObjective = getRandomFromList(objectives)
    
    displayMissionDetails(randomDeployment, randomApproach, randomLayout, randomVariant, randomObjective)
end

-- Function to generate competitive mission (limited approach types)
function competitiveMission()
    local randomDeployment = getRandomFromList(deploymentTypes, 4)
    local randomApproach = getRandomFromList(approachTypes, 3)  -- Only select from first 3 approach types
    local randomLayout = getRandomFromList(layouts, 3)
    local randomVariant = getRandomFromList(variants)
    local randomObjective = getRandomFromList(objectives)
    
    displayMissionDetails(randomDeployment, randomApproach, randomLayout, randomVariant, randomObjective)
end

-- Function to display mission details
function displayMissionDetails(deployment, approach, layout, variant, objective)
    local result = "Mission Details:\n" ..
                   "[1F87FF]Deployment Type:[-] " .. deployment .. "\n" ..
                   "[31B32B]Approach Type:[-] " .. approach .. "\n" ..
                   "[A020F0]Layout:[-] " .. layout .. "\n" ..
                   "[F4641D]Variant:[-] " .. variant .. "\n" ..
                   "[21B19B]Objective:[-] " .. objective
    
    -- Output to item description
    self.setDescription(result)
    -- Print to chat
    print(result)
    -- Display on screen (for 10 seconds)
    -- broadcastToAll(result, {1,1,1}) -- Color white for text
end

-- Button creation
function onLoad()
    -- Left button for truly random mission
    self.createButton({
        label="Generate Truly Random Mission",
        click_function="randomMission",
        function_owner=self,
        position={-0.4,1,0.6},  -- Positioned on the left
        height=30,
        width=600,
        scale={x=-0.6, y=1, z=-0.6},
        font_size=30,
        color={0.8,0.8,0.9,1}
    })
    
    -- Right button for competitive mission
    self.createButton({
        label="Generate Random Competitive Mission",
        click_function="competitiveMission",
        function_owner=self,
        position={0.4,1,0.6},  -- Positioned on the right
        height=30,
        width=600,
        scale={x=-0.6, y=1, z=-0.6},
        font_size=30,
        color={0.9,0.8,0.8,1}  -- Slightly different color to distinguish
    })

local BigUI_Height = -900
local SmallUI_Height = -880

RSS_Class = 'Model';

------ CLASS VARIABLES ----------------------

local ChildObjs = {
    aura_obj = nil,
    sig_aura_obj = nil
};

-- Declare global variables at the beginning
local Shiphealth = 20       -- health variable
local ShipbaseSize = 40     -- base size variable
local Shipcost = 195        -- cost variable

local Signature = 30        -- Ship Signature Variable
local SignatureStorage = 35  -- Used for keeping track of signature
local cloaked = 0           -- Tracker for Silent running

local MenuManager = nil
local MenuManagerGUID = "15fc7f"  -- Replace this with the actual GUID of your Move Manager

local originalData = nil;
local state = {
    conditions = {
        Navigation_Offline = 0, Orbital_Decay = 0, Fire = 0, Weapons_Offline = 0,
        Scanners_Offline = 0, Defence_Systems_Offline = 0, Spikes = 0, Aura = 0, Activated = 0, Mode = 0, Atmosphere = 0, Clockwise = 0, CounterClockwise = 0, Silent_Running = 0
    },
    tokens = {},
    health = { current = Shiphealth, max = Shiphealth },
    base = { size = ShipbaseSize, color = {r = 255, g = 255, b = 255} },
    imageScale = 1.5,
    moveHistory = {},
    sigAuraShown = false,
    sig = Signature,
    referenceCard = { GUID = '', obj = nil }
};

local UIStatus = {
    Blue = { rotation = -2 },
    Red = { rotation = -2 },
    Black = { rotation = -2 },
    Grey = { rotation = -2 }
};

-- New variable to track the current UI mode
local currentUIMode = 1  -- 0: High Visibility, 1: Subtle, 2: Compact

-- Add this at the top of your script
local UI_SCALE = 1.3  -- Adjust this value to scale all UI elements
local BACKGROUND_COLOR = "#000000CC"  -- More opaque background
local TEXT_COLOR = "#FFFFFFFF"  -- Bright white text
local OUTLINE_COLOR = "#000000"
local OUTLINE_SIZE = "2 2"  -- Thicker outline

------ LIFE CYCLE EVENTS --------------------

function onLoad(save)
    -- Decode save data
    local data = JSON.decode(save) or {}

    -- Restore state
    recoverState(data)

    -- Retrieve MenuManager
    MenuManager = getObjectFromGUID(MenuManagerGUID)

    -- Ensure Move Manager registration
    if MenuManager then
        MenuManager.call("RegisterToken", { obj = self, guid = self.getGUID() })
    else
        print("Error: Could not find Move Manager object.")
    end

    -- Initialize SignatureStorage with the value from the card
    SignatureStorage = state.sig or Signature

    -- Rebuild UI and assets
    rebuildAssets()
    self.UI.setXml(ui())

    -- Additional setup
    RefreshModelShape()
    showAura()
end

function onClick(player_color)
    -- Call StartControlledMove for both tokens
    MoveManager.call("StartControlledMove", {
        color = player_color,   -- The color of the player controlling the token
        obj = self              -- The token (self refers to this object)
    })
end

function onDestroy()
    if (ChildObjs.aura_obj ~= nil) then ChildObjs.aura_obj.destruct() end
    if (ChildObjs.sig_aura_obj ~= nil) then ChildObjs.sig_aura_obj.destruct() end
end

function onSave()
    local data = {}
    data.state = state;
    data.originalData = originalData ~= nil and originalData or state;
    return JSON.encode(data)
end

function onUpdate()
    for _, player in ipairs(Player.getPlayers()) do
        if IsPlayerSuscribed(player.color) then
            HUDLookAtPlayer(player);
        end
    end
end

function recoverState(save)
    if save.state ~= nil then
        state = save.state
    else
        state = {}
        originalData = save.originalData or {}
        state.health = originalData.health or { current = Shiphealth, max = Shiphealth }
        state.base = originalData.base or { size = ShipbaseSize, color = {r = 1, g = 1, b = 1} }
        state.imageScale = originalData.imageScale or 1.5
        state.sig = originalData.sig or 20
    end

    state.conditions = state.conditions or {}
    state.conditions.Mode = state.conditions.Mode or 0

    -- Initialize all conditions to 0 if nil
    local conditionNames = {
        "Navigation_Offline", "Orbital_Decay", "Fire", "Weapons_Offline",
        "Scanners_Offline", "Defence_Systems_Offline", "Spikes", "Aura",
        "Activated", "Mode", "Atmosphere", "Silent_Running", "Clockwise","CounterClockwise"
    }

    for _, condName in ipairs(conditionNames) do
        state.conditions[condName] = state.conditions[condName] or 0
    end

    -- Ensure state.base.color is properly set and valid
    state.base.color = state.base.color or {r = 1, g = 1, b = 1}
end

------ STATE ACTIONS ------------------------

function SetInitialState(newState) -- To be called from the reference card
    state.state = newState.state;
    state.health = newState.health;
    state.base = newState.base;
    state.imageScale = newState.imageScale;
    state.referenceCard = newState.referenceCard;
    state.sig = newState.sig;
    SignatureStorage = newState.sig; -- Set SignatureStorage to the initial sig value
    state.Shipcost = newState.shipcost;
    RecalculateSignature() -- Recalculate signature to account for any initial spikes
end

function ModifyHealth(params)
    state.health.current = math.max(0, math.min(state.health.max, state.health.current + params.amount));
    SyncHealth()
end

function ModifyAura(params)
    state.conditions.Aura = math.max(0, math.floor((state.conditions.Aura or 0) + params.amount))
    showAura()
    SyncCondition("Aura")
end

function ModifyBaseSignature(amount)
    SignatureStorage = math.max(0, SignatureStorage + amount)
    RecalculateSignature()
end

function RecalculateSignature()
    local baseSignature = cloaked == 1 and 0 or SignatureStorage
    local spikeBonus = (state.conditions.Spikes or 0) * 3
    local newSig = baseSignature + spikeBonus
    
    -- Ensure sig doesn't go below 0
    newSig = math.max(0, newSig)
    
    if newSig ~= state.sig then
        state.sig = newSig
        
        -- Turn off sig aura if it was shown
        TurnOffSigAura()
    end
end

function ShowSig()
    state.sigAuraShown = not state.sigAuraShown
    if state.sigAuraShown then
        state.conditions.SigAura = state.sig
        state.conditions.TargetSig = 1  -- Light up the button
        print("Showing Ship Signature and Spikes. Value:", state.sig," Inches")
    else
        state.conditions.SigAura = 0
        state.conditions.TargetSig = 0  -- Turn off the button
    end
    showSigAura()
    SyncCondition("SigAura")
    SyncCondition("TargetSig")
end

function TurnOffSigAura()
    if state.sigAuraShown then
        state.sigAuraShown = false
        state.conditions.SigAura = 0
        state.conditions.TargetSig = 0
        showSigAura()
        SyncCondition("SigAura")
        SyncCondition("TargetSig")
        print("Signature aura turned off due to Silent Running or Spike changes")
    end
end

function ModifyCondition(params)
    local previousValue = state.conditions[params.name] or 0  -- Default to 0 if nil
    if params.amount == 0 then -- toggle
        state.conditions[params.name] = math.max(0, 1 - previousValue)
    else
        if Conditions[params.name].loop ~= nil then
            state.conditions[params.name] = math.max(0, (previousValue + params.amount + Conditions[params.name].loop) % Conditions[params.name].loop)
        else
            state.conditions[params.name] = math.max(0, previousValue + params.amount)
        end
    end
    if params.name == 'Mode' then
        Sync()
    else
        print(self.getData().Nickname .. [[: ']] .. params.name .. [[' ]] .. previousValue .. [[->]] .. state.conditions[params.name])
        SyncCondition(params.name)
    end
end

function ModifyMoveRange(params)
    state.move.moveRange = math.max(0, state.move.moveRange + params.amount);
end

function AuraFollowObject(params)
    if ChildObjs.aura_obj ~= nil then
        ChildObjs.aura_obj.setVar('parent', params.obj);
    end
end

function AuraResetFollow()
    if ChildObjs.aura_obj ~= nil then
        ChildObjs.aura_obj.setVar('parent', self);
    end
end

function RefreshModelShape()
    local attachments = self.getAttachments()
    for key, value in pairs(attachments) do
        local modelElement = self.removeAttachment(0)
        if modelElement then
            modelElement.setCustomObject({
                image_scalar = tonumber(state.imageScale * 1)
            });
            self.addAttachment(modelElement)
        end
    end
    RefreshBaseColor()
end

function adjustTransparency(baseColor, newAlpha)
    if type(baseColor) == "table" and baseColor.r and baseColor.g and baseColor.b then
        self.setColorTint({
            r = baseColor.r,
            g = baseColor.g,
            b = baseColor.b,
            a = newAlpha / 255  -- Normalize alpha value
        })
    else
        print("Error: baseColor is not in the expected format or missing r, g, b")
    end
end

function RefreshBaseColor()
    -- Temporarily force specific values
    state.base.color = {r = 1, g = 1, b = 1}
    
    local baseColor = state.base.color

    if type(baseColor) == "table" and baseColor.r and baseColor.g and baseColor.b then
        if state.conditions.Activated == 0 then
            adjustTransparency(baseColor, 255)  -- Fully opaque
        else
            adjustTransparency(baseColor, 135)  -- Slight transparency
        end
    else
        print("Error: baseColor is not properly set in RefreshBaseColor")
    end
end

function calculatePlayerRotation()
    for _, player in ipairs(Player.getPlayers()) do
        UIStatus[player.color].rotation = player.getPointerRotation() - self.getRotation().y + 180;
    end
end

function Sync()
    self.UI.setXml(ui())
end

function SyncCondition(name)
    for k, color in pairs({'Red', 'Blue', 'Grey', 'Black'}) do
        local conditionValue = state.conditions[name] or 0
        local conditionData = Conditions[name]
        if not conditionData then
            print("Error: No condition data found for " .. name)
            return
        end
        
        local isActive = conditionValue > 0
        local imageUrl = isActive and conditionData.active_url or conditionData.url
        local colorBlock
        if currentUIMode == 1 then  -- Subtle mode
            colorBlock = conditionData.color .. (isActive and 'FF' or '22')
        else
            colorBlock = conditionData.color .. "FF"  -- Always fully opaque for other modes
        end

        self.UI.setAttributes(color .. "_ConditionImage_" .. name, {
            color = colorBlock,
            image = imageUrl,
        })
        self.UI.setAttributes(color .. "_ConditionText_" .. name, {
            active = (conditionData.stacks and isActive) and 'true' or 'false',
            text = conditionValue
        })
    end

    if name == "Activated" then
        RefreshBaseColor()
    end
end

function SyncHealth()
    for k, color in pairs({'Red', 'Blue', 'Grey', 'Black'}) do
        self.UI.setAttributes(color .. "_HealthBar_Text", {
            text = state.health.current .. [[/]] .. state.health.max
        });
        self.UI.setAttributes(color .. "_HealthBar", {
            percentage = (state.health.current / state.health.max * 100)
        });
    end
end

function IsPlayerSuscribed(color)
    return UIStatus[color] ~= nil;
end

function HUDLookAtPlayer(player)
    local playerRotation = player.getPointerRotation();
    if playerRotation == nil then playerRotation = 0 end;
    local pointerRotation = playerRotation - self.getRotation().y + 180;
    pointerRotation = math.floor((pointerRotation + 15) / 30)
    if pointerRotation ~= UIStatus[player.color].rotation then
        self.UI.setAttribute(player.color .. '_PlayerHUDPivot', 'rotation', '0 0 ' .. -30 * pointerRotation)
        UIStatus[player.color].rotation = pointerRotation;
    end
end

function ui()
    local panelContent = ""
    for _, color in ipairs({'Blue', 'Red', 'Grey', 'Black'}) do
        local pivot = PlayerHUDPivot(color)
        if pivot then
            panelContent = panelContent .. pivot
        end
    end
    local result = [[
        <Panel color="#FFFFFFff" height="0" width="0" rectAlignment="MiddleCenter" childForceExpandWidth="true" >]] 
        .. panelContent .. 
        [[</Panel>
    ]]
    return result
end

function rebuildAssets()
    local assets = {};
    for conditionName, value in pairs(Conditions) do
        assets[#assets + 1] = { name = conditionName, url = value.url };
        if value.active_url then
            assets[#assets + 1] = { name = conditionName .. "_active", url = value.active_url };
        end
    end

    self.UI.setCustomAssets(assets)
end

function PlayerHUDPivot(color)
    if not UIStatus[color] then 
        return "" 
    end
    local rotation = UIStatus[color].rotation or 0
    local content = getUIContent(color)
    if not content then 
        return "" 
    end
    local result = string.format([[
        <Panel id='%s_PlayerHUDPivot' visibility='%s' height="260" width="100" position='0 0 -340' rotation='0 0 %s' rectAlignment="MiddleCenter" childForceExpandWidth="false">
        %s
        </Panel>
    ]], color, color, tostring(-rotation), content)
    return result
end

function getUIContent(color)
    if currentUIMode == 0 then
        return HighVisibilityUI(color, BigUI_Height)
    elseif currentUIMode == 1 then
        return SubtleUI(color, BigUI_Height)  -- Passing BigUI_Height here as well
    else
        return CompactUI(color, SmallUI_Height)
    end
end

function HUDSingleCondition(color, name, x, y, size)
    if not color or not name or not x or not y or not size then
        return ""
    end
    local id = "ConditionFrame_" .. name
    local position = string.format("%s %s 0", ((x * (size + 4) * UI_SCALE) - (1.5 * size + 4) * UI_SCALE), y * ((size + 4) * UI_SCALE))
    return string.format([[
        <Panel id="%s" width="%d" height="%d" alignment='LowerLeft' position='%s' onClick='UI_Modify%s()'>
        %s
        </Panel>
    ]], id, size * UI_SCALE, size * UI_SCALE, position, name, HUDSingleConditionBody(color, name, size * UI_SCALE) or "")
end

function HUDSingleConditionBody(color, name, size)
    if not color or not name or not size or not state.conditions then
        return ""
    end
    local conditionValue = state.conditions[name] or 0
    local condition = Conditions[name]
    if not condition then
        return ""
    end
    
    local isActive = conditionValue > 0
    local imageUrl = isActive and condition.active_url or condition.url
    local colorBlock
    if currentUIMode == 1 then  -- Subtle mode
        colorBlock = condition.color .. (isActive and 'FF' or '22')  -- Fully opaque when active, partially transparent when inactive
    else
        colorBlock = condition.color .. "FF"  -- Always fully opaque for other modes
    end
    local fontSize = math.floor(size * 0.85)

    return string.format([[
        <Image id="%s_ConditionImage_%s" image="%s" color="%s" rectAlignment='MiddleCenter' width='%d' height='%d'/>
        <Text id="%s_ConditionText_%s" active='%s' fontSize='%d' text='%s' color='%s' fontStyle='Bold' rectAlignment='LowerRight' outline='%s' outlineSize='%s' />
    ]], color, name, imageUrl, colorBlock, size, size, color, name, tostring(condition.stacks and isActive), fontSize, conditionValue, TEXT_COLOR, OUTLINE_COLOR, OUTLINE_SIZE)
end

        ModifyCondition({ name = name, amount = (alt == '-1' and 1 or (alt == '-2' and -1) or 0) })

    end
end

function showAura()
    local auraSize = state.conditions.Aura or 0

    -- Scale is directly the aura size (in inches)
    local scale = auraSize

    if ChildObjs.aura_obj then
        ChildObjs.aura_obj.setScale({scale, 1, scale})
        ChildObjs.aura_obj.setPosition(self.getPosition())
        ChildObjs.aura_obj.setRotation(self.getRotation())
    else
        local clr = self.getColorTint()
        ChildObjs.aura_obj = spawnObject({
            type = 'custom_model',
            position = self.getPosition(),
            rotation = self.getRotation(),
            scale = {scale, 1, scale},
            mass = 0,
            use_gravity = false,
            sound = false,
            snap_to_grid = false,
            callback_function = function(b)
                b.setColorTint(clr)
                b.setVar('parent', self)
                b.setLuaScript([[
                    function onUpdate()
                        if parent and parent.getPosition then
                            self.setPosition(parent.getPosition())
                            self.setRotation(parent.getRotation())
                        end
                    end
                ]])
                b.getComponent('MeshRenderer').set('receiveShadows', false)
            end
        })
        ChildObjs.aura_obj.setCustomObject({
            mesh = 'https://steamusercontent-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/2450611726223935325/77C02DD7AC66A61A2F30452D73585D02DFE0D72D/',

            material = 3,
            specularIntensity = 0,
            cast_shadows = false
        })
    end

    if auraSize == 0 and ChildObjs.aura_obj then
        ChildObjs.aura_obj.setScale({0, 0, 0})
    else
        ChildObjs.aura_obj.setScale({scale, 1, scale})
    end
end

function showSigAura()
    local auraSize = state.conditions.SigAura or 0

    -- Scale is directly the aura size (in inches)
    local scale = auraSize

    if ChildObjs.sig_aura_obj then
        if scale == 0 then
            -- Hide the aura object
            ChildObjs.sig_aura_obj.setScale({0, 0, 0})
        else
            -- Show and update the aura object
            ChildObjs.sig_aura_obj.setScale({scale, 1, scale})
            ChildObjs.sig_aura_obj.setPosition(self.getPosition())
            ChildObjs.sig_aura_obj.setRotation(self.getRotation())
        end
    else

        if scale > 0 then

            ChildObjs.sig_aura_obj = spawnObject({

function RefreshShip()

    local currentState = {
        conditions = state.conditions,
        health = state.health,
        base = state.base,
        imageScale = state.imageScale,
        sig = state.sig,
        sigAuraShown = state.sigAuraShown,
        -- Add any other state variables you need to preserve
    }

    -- Rebuild UI and assets
    rebuildAssets()

    -- Use Wait.frames to delay UI initialization
    Wait.frames(function()
        -- Restore saved state
        for key, value in pairs(currentState) do
            state[key] = value
        end

        -- Reinitialize UI and other visual elements
        self.UI.setXml(ui())
        Sync()  -- Ensure UI is fully updated
        RefreshModelShape()
        showAura()
        if state.sigAuraShown then
            showSigAura()
        end
        
        -- Recalculate any derived values
        RecalculateSignature()

        print(self.getName() .. " has been refreshed.")
    end, 2)  -- Wait for 2 frames before initializing UI
end

-- 40mm SHIP SCRIPT V3.1 10/20/2024

local BigUI_Height = -900
local SmallUI_Height = -880

RSS_Class = 'Model';

------ CLASS VARIABLES ----------------------

local ChildObjs = {
    aura_obj = nil,
    sig_aura_obj = nil
};

-- Declare global variables at the beginning
local Shiphealth = 20       -- health variable
local ShipbaseSize = 40     -- base size variable
local Shipcost = 195        -- cost variable

local Signature = 30        -- Ship Signature Variable
local SignatureStorage = 35  -- Used for keeping track of signature
local cloaked = 0           -- Tracker for Silent running

local MenuManager = nil
local MenuManagerGUID = "15fc7f"  -- Replace this with the actual GUID of your Move Manager

local originalData = nil;
local state = {
    conditions = {
        Navigation_Offline = 0, Orbital_Decay = 0, Fire = 0, Weapons_Offline = 0,
        Scanners_Offline = 0, Defence_Systems_Offline = 0, Spikes = 0, Aura = 0, Activated = 0, Mode = 0, Atmosphere = 0, Clockwise = 0, CounterClockwise = 0, Silent_Running = 0
    },
    tokens = {},
    health = { current = Shiphealth, max = Shiphealth },
    base = { size = ShipbaseSize, color = {r = 255, g = 255, b = 255} },
    imageScale = 1.5,
    moveHistory = {},
    sigAuraShown = false,
    sig = Signature,
    referenceCard = { GUID = '', obj = nil }
};

local UIStatus = {
    Blue = { rotation = -2 },
    Red = { rotation = -2 },
    Black = { rotation = -2 },
    Grey = { rotation = -2 }
};

-- New variable to track the current UI mode
local currentUIMode = 1  -- 0: High Visibility, 1: Subtle, 2: Compact

-- Add this at the top of your script
local UI_SCALE = 1.3  -- Adjust this value to scale all UI elements
local BACKGROUND_COLOR = "#000000CC"  -- More opaque background
local TEXT_COLOR = "#FFFFFFFF"  -- Bright white text
local OUTLINE_COLOR = "#000000"
local OUTLINE_SIZE = "2 2"  -- Thicker outline

------ LIFE CYCLE EVENTS --------------------

function onLoad(save)
    -- Decode save data
    local data = JSON.decode(save) or {}

    -- Restore state
    recoverState(data)

    -- Retrieve MenuManager
    MenuManager = getObjectFromGUID(MenuManagerGUID)

    -- Ensure Move Manager registration
    if MenuManager then
        MenuManager.call("RegisterToken", { obj = self, guid = self.getGUID() })
    else
        print("Error: Could not find Move Manager object.")
    end

    -- Initialize SignatureStorage with the value from the card
    SignatureStorage = state.sig or Signature

    -- Rebuild UI and assets
    rebuildAssets()
    self.UI.setXml(ui())

    -- Additional setup
    RefreshModelShape()
    showAura()
end

function onClick(player_color)
    -- Call StartControlledMove for both tokens
    MoveManager.call("StartControlledMove", {
        color = player_color,   -- The color of the player controlling the token
        obj = self              -- The token (self refers to this object)
    })
end

function onDestroy()
    if (ChildObjs.aura_obj ~= nil) then ChildObjs.aura_obj.destruct() end
    if (ChildObjs.sig_aura_obj ~= nil) then ChildObjs.sig_aura_obj.destruct() end
end

function onSave()
    local data = {}
    data.state = state;
    data.originalData = originalData ~= nil and originalData or state;
    return JSON.encode(data)
end

function onUpdate()
    for _, player in ipairs(Player.getPlayers()) do
        if IsPlayerSuscribed(player.color) then
            HUDLookAtPlayer(player);
        end
    end
end

function recoverState(save)
    if save.state ~= nil then
        state = save.state
    else
        state = {}
        originalData = save.originalData or {}
        state.health = originalData.health or { current = Shiphealth, max = Shiphealth }
        state.base = originalData.base or { size = ShipbaseSize, color = {r = 1, g = 1, b = 1} }
        state.imageScale = originalData.imageScale or 1.5
        state.sig = originalData.sig or 20
    end

    state.conditions = state.conditions or {}
    state.conditions.Mode = state.conditions.Mode or 0

    -- Initialize all conditions to 0 if nil
    local conditionNames = {
        "Navigation_Offline", "Orbital_Decay", "Fire", "Weapons_Offline",
        "Scanners_Offline", "Defence_Systems_Offline", "Spikes", "Aura",
        "Activated", "Mode", "Atmosphere", "Silent_Running", "Clockwise","CounterClockwise"
    }

    for _, condName in ipairs(conditionNames) do
        state.conditions[condName] = state.conditions[condName] or 0
    end

    -- Ensure state.base.color is properly set and valid
    state.base.color = state.base.color or {r = 1, g = 1, b = 1}
end

------ STATE ACTIONS ------------------------

function SetInitialState(newState) -- To be called from the reference card
    state.state = newState.state;
    state.health = newState.health;
    state.base = newState.base;
    state.imageScale = newState.imageScale;
    state.referenceCard = newState.referenceCard;
    state.sig = newState.sig;
    SignatureStorage = newState.sig; -- Set SignatureStorage to the initial sig value
    state.Shipcost = newState.shipcost;
    RecalculateSignature() -- Recalculate signature to account for any initial spikes
end

function ModifyHealth(params)
    state.health.current = math.max(0, math.min(state.health.max, state.health.current + params.amount));
    SyncHealth()
end

function ModifyAura(params)
    state.conditions.Aura = math.max(0, math.floor((state.conditions.Aura or 0) + params.amount))
    showAura()
    SyncCondition("Aura")
end

function ModifyBaseSignature(amount)
    SignatureStorage = math.max(0, SignatureStorage + amount)
    RecalculateSignature()
end

function RecalculateSignature()
    local baseSignature = cloaked == 1 and 0 or SignatureStorage
    local spikeBonus = (state.conditions.Spikes or 0) * 3
    local newSig = baseSignature + spikeBonus
    
    -- Ensure sig doesn't go below 0
    newSig = math.max(0, newSig)
    
    if newSig ~= state.sig then
        state.sig = newSig
        
        -- Turn off sig aura if it was shown
        TurnOffSigAura()
    end
end

function ShowSig()
    state.sigAuraShown = not state.sigAuraShown
    if state.sigAuraShown then
        state.conditions.SigAura = state.sig
        state.conditions.TargetSig = 1  -- Light up the button
        print("Showing Ship Signature and Spikes. Value:", state.sig," Inches")
    else
        state.conditions.SigAura = 0
        state.conditions.TargetSig = 0  -- Turn off the button
    end
    showSigAura()
    SyncCondition("SigAura")
    SyncCondition("TargetSig")
end

function TurnOffSigAura()
    if state.sigAuraShown then
        state.sigAuraShown = false
        state.conditions.SigAura = 0
        state.conditions.TargetSig = 0
        showSigAura()
        SyncCondition("SigAura")
        SyncCondition("TargetSig")
        print("Signature aura turned off due to Silent Running or Spike changes")
    end
end

function ModifyCondition(params)
    local previousValue = state.conditions[params.name] or 0  -- Default to 0 if nil
    if params.amount == 0 then -- toggle
        state.conditions[params.name] = math.max(0, 1 - previousValue)
    else
        if Conditions[params.name].loop ~= nil then
            state.conditions[params.name] = math.max(0, (previousValue + params.amount + Conditions[params.name].loop) % Conditions[params.name].loop)
        else
            state.conditions[params.name] = math.max(0, previousValue + params.amount)
        end
    end
    if params.name == 'Mode' then
        Sync()
    else
        print(self.getData().Nickname .. [[: ']] .. params.name .. [[' ]] .. previousValue .. [[->]] .. state.conditions[params.name])
        SyncCondition(params.name)
    end
end

function ModifyMoveRange(params)
    state.move.moveRange = math.max(0, state.move.moveRange + params.amount);
end

------ MODEL MANIPULATION -------------------

function AuraFollowObject(params)
    if ChildObjs.aura_obj ~= nil then
        ChildObjs.aura_obj.setVar('parent', params.obj);
    end
end

function AuraResetFollow()
    if ChildObjs.aura_obj ~= nil then
        ChildObjs.aura_obj.setVar('parent', self);
    end
end

function RefreshModelShape()
    local attachments = self.getAttachments()
    for key, value in pairs(attachments) do
        local modelElement = self.removeAttachment(0)
        if modelElement then
            modelElement.setCustomObject({
                image_scalar = tonumber(state.imageScale * 1)
            });
            self.addAttachment(modelElement)
        end
    end
    RefreshBaseColor()
end

function adjustTransparency(baseColor, newAlpha)
    if type(baseColor) == "table" and baseColor.r and baseColor.g and baseColor.b then
        self.setColorTint({
            r = baseColor.r,
            g = baseColor.g,
            b = baseColor.b,
            a = newAlpha / 255  -- Normalize alpha value
        })
    else
        print("Error: baseColor is not in the expected format or missing r, g, b")
    end
end

function RefreshBaseColor()
    -- Temporarily force specific values
    state.base.color = {r = 1, g = 1, b = 1}
    
    local baseColor = state.base.color

    if type(baseColor) == "table" and baseColor.r and baseColor.g and baseColor.b then
        if state.conditions.Activated == 0 then
            adjustTransparency(baseColor, 255)  -- Fully opaque
        else
            adjustTransparency(baseColor, 135)  -- Slight transparency
        end
    else
        print("Error: baseColor is not properly set in RefreshBaseColor")
    end
end

------ UI GENERATION ------------------------

function calculatePlayerRotation()
    for _, player in ipairs(Player.getPlayers()) do
        UIStatus[player.color].rotation = player.getPointerRotation() - self.getRotation().y + 180;
    end
end

function Sync()
    self.UI.setXml(ui())
end

function SyncCondition(name)
    for k, color in pairs({'Red', 'Blue', 'Grey', 'Black'}) do
        local conditionValue = state.conditions[name] or 0
        local conditionData = Conditions[name]
        if not conditionData then
            print("Error: No condition data found for " .. name)
            return
        end
        
        local isActive = conditionValue > 0
        local imageUrl = isActive and conditionData.active_url or conditionData.url
        local colorBlock
        if currentUIMode == 1 then  -- Subtle mode
            colorBlock = conditionData.color .. (isActive and 'FF' or '22')
        else
            colorBlock = conditionData.color .. "FF"  -- Always fully opaque for other modes
        end

        self.UI.setAttributes(color .. "_ConditionImage_" .. name, {
            color = colorBlock,
            image = imageUrl,
        })
        self.UI.setAttributes(color .. "_ConditionText_" .. name, {
            active = (conditionData.stacks and isActive) and 'true' or 'false',
            text = conditionValue
        })
    end

    if name == "Activated" then
        RefreshBaseColor()
    end
end

function SyncHealth()
    for k, color in pairs({'Red', 'Blue', 'Grey', 'Black'}) do
        self.UI.setAttributes(color .. "_HealthBar_Text", {
            text = state.health.current .. [[/]] .. state.health.max
        });
        self.UI.setAttributes(color .. "_HealthBar", {
            percentage = (state.health.current / state.health.max * 100)
        });
    end
end

function IsPlayerSuscribed(color)
    return UIStatus[color] ~= nil;
end

function HUDLookAtPlayer(player)
    local playerRotation = player.getPointerRotation();
    if playerRotation == nil then playerRotation = 0 end;
    local pointerRotation = playerRotation - self.getRotation().y + 180;
    pointerRotation = math.floor((pointerRotation + 15) / 30)
    if pointerRotation ~= UIStatus[player.color].rotation then
        self.UI.setAttribute(player.color .. '_PlayerHUDPivot', 'rotation', '0 0 ' .. -30 * pointerRotation)
        UIStatus[player.color].rotation = pointerRotation;
    end
end

function ui()
    local panelContent = ""
    for _, color in ipairs({'Blue', 'Red', 'Grey', 'Black'}) do
        local pivot = PlayerHUDPivot(color)
        if pivot then
            panelContent = panelContent .. pivot
        end
    end
    local result = [[
        <Panel color="#FFFFFFff" height="0" width="0" rectAlignment="MiddleCenter" childForceExpandWidth="true" >]] 
        .. panelContent .. 
        [[</Panel>
    ]]
    return result
end

function rebuildAssets()
    local assets = {};
    for conditionName, value in pairs(Conditions) do
        assets[#assets + 1] = { name = conditionName, url = value.url };
        if value.active_url then
            assets[#assets + 1] = { name = conditionName .. "_active", url = value.active_url };
        end
    end

    self.UI.setCustomAssets(assets)
end

function PlayerHUDPivot(color)
    if not UIStatus[color] then 
        return "" 
    end
    local rotation = UIStatus[color].rotation or 0
    local content = getUIContent(color)
    if not content then 
        return "" 
    end
    local result = string.format([[
        <Panel id='%s_PlayerHUDPivot' visibility='%s' height="260" width="100" position='0 0 -340' rotation='0 0 %s' rectAlignment="MiddleCenter" childForceExpandWidth="false">
        %s
        </Panel>
    ]], color, color, tostring(-rotation), content)
    return result
end

function getUIContent(color)
    if currentUIMode == 0 then
        return HighVisibilityUI(color, BigUI_Height)
    elseif currentUIMode == 1 then
        return SubtleUI(color, BigUI_Height)  -- Passing BigUI_Height here as well
    else
        return CompactUI(color, SmallUI_Height)
    end
end

local HiVis_BACKPLATE_WIDTH = 498 * UI_SCALE  -- Adjust this value to change the width
local HiVis_BACKPLATE_HEIGHT = 190 * UI_SCALE  -- Adjust this value to change the height

function HighVisibilityUI(color, height)
    if not state.health then return "" end
    local healthCurrent = state.health.current or 0
    local healthMax = state.health.max or 1
    local percentage = (healthCurrent / healthMax * 100) or 0
    local conditions = HUDConditions(color) or ""
    return string.format([[
        <Panel id='PlayerHUD_Container' active='true' height="%d" width="%d" rectAlignment="MiddleCenter" rotation='-35 0 0' position='0 50 %d' childForceExpandWidth="false">
            <Panel width="100%%" height="100%%" color="%s">
                <Panel height="180" width="128" rectAlignment="MiddleCenter">
                    %s
                    <ProgressBar width="200%%" height="%d" id="%s_HealthBar" color='#00000080' fillImageColor="#44AA22FF" percentage="%s" textColor="#00000000"/>  
                    <Text id='%s_HealthBar_Text' fontSize='%d' height="%d" onClick='UI_ModifyHealth' text='%s/%s' color='%s' fontStyle='Bold' outline='%s' outlineSize='%s' />
                </Panel>
            </Panel>
        </Panel>
    ]], HiVis_BACKPLATE_HEIGHT, HiVis_BACKPLATE_WIDTH, height, BACKGROUND_COLOR, conditions, 60 * UI_SCALE, color, percentage, color, 25 * UI_SCALE, 30 * UI_SCALE, healthCurrent, healthMax, TEXT_COLOR, OUTLINE_COLOR, OUTLINE_SIZE)
end

function SubtleUI(color, height)
    if not state.health then return "" end
    local healthCurrent = state.health.current or 0
    local healthMax = state.health.max or 1
    local percentage = (healthCurrent / healthMax * 100) or 0
    local conditions = HUDConditions(color) or ""
    return string.format([[
        <Panel id='PlayerHUD_Container' active='true' height="180" width="128" rectAlignment="MiddleCenter" rotation='-35 0 0' position='0 50 %d' childForceExpandWidth="false">%s
        <ProgressBar width="200%%" height="60" id="%s_HealthBar" color='#00000080' fillImageColor="#44AA22FF" percentage="%s" textColor="#00000000"/>  
        <Text id='%s_HealthBar_Text' fontSize='25' height="30" onClick='UI_ModifyHealth' text='%s/%s' color='#ffffff' fontStyle='Bold' outline='#000000' outlineSize='1 1' />
        </Panel>
    ]], height, conditions, color, percentage, color, healthCurrent, healthMax)
end

local Compact_BACKPLATE_WIDTH = 200 * UI_SCALE  -- Adjust this value to change the width
local Compact_BACKPLATE_HEIGHT = 180 * UI_SCALE  -- Adjust this value to change the height

function CompactUI(color, height)
    if not state.health then return "" end
    local healthCurrent = state.health.current or 0
    local healthMax = state.health.max or 1
    local percentage = (healthCurrent / healthMax * 100) or 0
    local conditions = CompactHUDConditions(color) or ""
    
    -- Define the amount to move the background up
    local backgroundOffsetY = 20 -- Adjust this value to move the background up or down

    return string.format([[
        <Panel id='PlayerHUD_Container' active='true' height="%d" width="%d" rectAlignment="MiddleCenter" rotation='-35 0 0' position='0 %d %d' childForceExpandWidth="false">

function HUDSingleCondition(color, name, x, y, size)
    if not color or not name or not x or not y or not size then
        return ""
    end
    local id = "ConditionFrame_" .. name
    local position = string.format("%s %s 0", ((x * (size + 4) * UI_SCALE) - (1.5 * size + 4) * UI_SCALE), y * ((size + 4) * UI_SCALE))
    return string.format([[
        <Panel id="%s" width="%d" height="%d" alignment='LowerLeft' position='%s' onClick='UI_Modify%s()'>
        %s
        </Panel>
    ]], id, size * UI_SCALE, size * UI_SCALE, position, name, HUDSingleConditionBody(color, name, size * UI_SCALE) or "")
end

function HUDSingleConditionBody(color, name, size)
    if not color or not name or not size or not state.conditions then
        return ""
    end
    local conditionValue = state.conditions[name] or 0
    local condition = Conditions[name]
    if not condition then
        return ""
    end
    
    local isActive = conditionValue > 0
    local imageUrl = isActive and condition.active_url or condition.url
    local colorBlock
    if currentUIMode == 1 then  -- Subtle mode
        colorBlock = condition.color .. (isActive and 'FF' or '22')  -- Fully opaque when active, partially transparent when inactive
    else
        colorBlock = condition.color .. "FF"  -- Always fully opaque for other modes
    end
    local fontSize = math.floor(size * 0.85)

    return string.format([[
        <Image id="%s_ConditionImage_%s" image="%s" color="%s" rectAlignment='MiddleCenter' width='%d' height='%d'/>
        <Text id="%s_ConditionText_%s" active='%s' fontSize='%d' text='%s' color='%s' fontStyle='Bold' rectAlignment='LowerRight' outline='%s' outlineSize='%s' />
    ]], color, name, imageUrl, colorBlock, size, size, color, name, tostring(condition.stacks and isActive), fontSize, conditionValue, TEXT_COLOR, OUTLINE_COLOR, OUTLINE_SIZE)
end

function showAura()
    local auraSize = state.conditions.Aura or 0

    -- Scale is directly the aura size (in inches)
    local scale = auraSize

    if ChildObjs.aura_obj then
        ChildObjs.aura_obj.setScale({scale, 1, scale})
        ChildObjs.aura_obj.setPosition(self.getPosition())
        ChildObjs.aura_obj.setRotation(self.getRotation())
    else
        local clr = self.getColorTint()
        ChildObjs.aura_obj = spawnObject({
            type = 'custom_model',
            position = self.getPosition(),
            rotation = self.getRotation(),
            scale = {scale, 1, scale},
            mass = 0,
            use_gravity = false,
            sound = false,
            snap_to_grid = false,
            callback_function = function(b)
                b.setColorTint(clr)
                b.setVar('parent', self)
                b.setLuaScript([[
                    function onUpdate()
                        if parent and parent.getPosition then
                            self.setPosition(parent.getPosition())
                            self.setRotation(parent.getRotation())
                        end
                    end
                ]])
                b.getComponent('MeshRenderer').set('receiveShadows', false)
            end
        })
        ChildObjs.aura_obj.setCustomObject({
            mesh = 'https://steamusercontent-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/2450611726223935325/77C02DD7AC66A61A2F30452D73585D02DFE0D72D/',
            collider = 'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/RobMayer/TTSLibrary/master/utility/null_COL.obj',
            material = 3,
            specularIntensity = 0,
            cast_shadows = false
        })
    end

    if auraSize == 0 and ChildObjs.aura_obj then
        ChildObjs.aura_obj.setScale({0, 0, 0})
    else
        ChildObjs.aura_obj.setScale({scale, 1, scale})
    end
end

function showSigAura()
    local auraSize = state.conditions.SigAura or 0

    -- Scale is directly the aura size (in inches)
    local scale = auraSize

    if ChildObjs.sig_aura_obj then
        if scale == 0 then
            -- Hide the aura object
            ChildObjs.sig_aura_obj.setScale({0, 0, 0})
        else
            -- Show and update the aura object
            ChildObjs.sig_aura_obj.setScale({scale, 1, scale})
            ChildObjs.sig_aura_obj.setPosition(self.getPosition())
            ChildObjs.sig_aura_obj.setRotation(self.getRotation())
        end
    else
        -- Only create the aura object if it should be visible
        if scale > 0 then
            local clr = {r=1, g=0, b=0}  -- Set color to red
            ChildObjs.sig_aura_obj = spawnObject({
                type = 'custom_model',
                position = self.getPosition(),
                rotation = self.getRotation(),
                scale = {scale, 1, scale},
                mass = 0,
                use_gravity = false,
                sound = false,
                snap_to_grid = false,
                callback_function = function(b)
                    b.setColorTint(clr)  -- Set the color to red
                    b.setVar('parent', self)
                    b.setLuaScript([[
                        function onUpdate()
                            if parent and parent.getPosition then
                                self.setPosition(parent.getPosition())
                                self.setRotation(parent.getRotation())
                            end
                        end
                    ]])
                    b.getComponent('MeshRenderer').set('receiveShadows', false)
                end
            })
            ChildObjs.sig_aura_obj.setCustomObject({
                mesh = 'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/RobMayer/TTSLibrary/master/components/arcs/round0.obj',
                collider = 'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/RobMayer/TTSLibrary/master/utility/null_COL.obj',
                material = 3,
                specularIntensity = 0,
                cast_shadows = false
            })
        end
    end

    if auraSize == 0 and ChildObjs.sig_aura_obj then
        ChildObjs.sig_aura_obj.setScale({0, 0, 0})
    elseif ChildObjs.sig_aura_obj then
        ChildObjs.sig_aura_obj.setScale({scale, 1, scale})
    end
end

function RefreshShip()
    -- Save current state
    local currentState = {
        conditions = state.conditions,
        health = state.health,
        base = state.base,
        imageScale = state.imageScale,
        sig = state.sig,
        sigAuraShown = state.sigAuraShown,
        -- Add any other state variables you need to preserve
    }

    -- Rebuild UI and assets
    rebuildAssets()

    -- Use Wait.frames to delay UI initialization
    Wait.frames(function()
        -- Restore saved state
        for key, value in pairs(currentState) do
            state[key] = value
        end

        -- Reinitialize UI and other visual elements
        self.UI.setXml(ui())
        Sync()  -- Ensure UI is fully updated
        RefreshModelShape()
        showAura()
        if state.sigAuraShown then
            showSigAura()
        end
        
        -- Recalculate any derived values
        RecalculateSignature()

        print(self.getName() .. " has been refreshed.")
    end, 2)  -- Wait for 2 frames before initializing UI
end
