ContainedObjects.LuaScript:
-- 40mm SHIP SCRIPT V3.1 10/20/2024

local BigUI_Height = -900
local SmallUI_Height = -880

RSS_Class = 'Model';

------ CLASS VARIABLES ----------------------

local ChildObjs = {
    aura_obj = nil,
    sig_aura_obj = nil
};

-- Declare global variables at the beginning
local Shiphealth = 20       -- health variable
local ShipbaseSize = 40     -- base size variable
local Shipcost = 195        -- cost variable

local Signature = 30        -- Ship Signature Variable
local SignatureStorage = 35  -- Used for keeping track of signature
local cloaked = 0           -- Tracker for Silent running

local MenuManager = nil
local MenuManagerGUID = "15fc7f"  -- Replace this with the actual GUID of your Move Manager

local originalData = nil;
local state = {
    conditions = {
        Navigation_Offline = 0, Orbital_Decay = 0, Fire = 0, Weapons_Offline = 0,
        Scanners_Offline = 0, Defence_Systems_Offline = 0, Spikes = 0, Aura = 0, Activated = 0, Mode = 0, Atmosphere = 0, Clockwise = 0, CounterClockwise = 0, Silent_Running = 0
    },
    tokens = {},
    health = { current = Shiphealth, max = Shiphealth },
    base = { size = ShipbaseSize, color = {r = 255, g = 255, b = 255} },
    imageScale = 1.5,
    moveHistory = {},
    sigAuraShown = false,
    sig = Signature,
    referenceCard = { GUID = '', obj = nil }
};

local UIStatus = {
    Blue = { rotation = -2 },
    Red = { rotation = -2 },
    Black = { rotation = -2 },
    Grey = { rotation = -2 }
};

-- New variable to track the current UI mode
local currentUIMode = 1  -- 0: High Visibility, 1: Subtle, 2: Compact

-- Add this at the top of your script
local UI_SCALE = 1.3  -- Adjust this value to scale all UI elements
local BACKGROUND_COLOR = "#000000CC"  -- More opaque background
local TEXT_COLOR = "#FFFFFFFF"  -- Bright white text
local OUTLINE_COLOR = "#000000"
local OUTLINE_SIZE = "2 2"  -- Thicker outline

------ LIFE CYCLE EVENTS --------------------

function onLoad(save)
    -- Decode save data
    local data = JSON.decode(save) or {}

    -- Restore state
    recoverState(data)

    -- Retrieve MenuManager
    MenuManager = getObjectFromGUID(MenuManagerGUID)

    -- Ensure Move Manager registration
    if MenuManager then
        MenuManager.call("RegisterToken", { obj = self, guid = self.getGUID() })
    else
        print("Error: Could not find Move Manager object.")
    end

    -- Initialize SignatureStorage with the value from the card
    SignatureStorage = state.sig or Signature

    -- Rebuild UI and assets
    rebuildAssets()
    self.UI.setXml(ui())

    -- Additional setup
    RefreshModelShape()
    showAura()
end

function onClick(player_color)
    -- Call StartControlledMove for both tokens
    MoveManager.call("StartControlledMove", {
        color = player_color,   -- The color of the player controlling the token
        obj = self              -- The token (self refers to this object)
    })
end

function onDestroy()
    if (ChildObjs.aura_obj ~= nil) then ChildObjs.aura_obj.destruct() end
    if (ChildObjs.sig_aura_obj ~= nil) then ChildObjs.sig_aura_obj.destruct() end
end

function onSave()
    local data = {}
    data.state = state;
    data.originalData = originalData ~= nil and originalData or state;
    return JSON.encode(data)
end

function onUpdate()
    for _, player in ipairs(Player.getPlayers()) do
        if IsPlayerSuscribed(player.color) then
            HUDLookAtPlayer(player);
        end
    end
end

function recoverState(save)
    if save.state ~= nil then
        state = save.state
    else
        state = {}
        originalData = save.originalData or {}
        state.health = originalData.health or { current = Shiphealth, max = Shiphealth }
        state.base = originalData.base or { size = ShipbaseSize, color = {r = 1, g = 1, b = 1} }
        state.imageScale = originalData.imageScale or 1.5
        state.sig = originalData.sig or 20
    end

    state.conditions = state.conditions or {}
    state.conditions.Mode = state.conditions.Mode or 0

    -- Initialize all conditions to 0 if nil
    local conditionNames = {
        "Navigation_Offline", "Orbital_Decay", "Fire", "Weapons_Offline",
        "Scanners_Offline", "Defence_Systems_Offline", "Spikes", "Aura",
        "Activated", "Mode", "Atmosphere", "Silent_Running", "Clockwise","CounterClockwise"
    }

    for _, condName in ipairs(conditionNames) do
        state.conditions[condName] = state.conditions[condName] or 0
    end

    -- Ensure state.base.color is properly set and valid
    state.base.color = state.base.color or {r = 1, g = 1, b = 1}
end

------ STATE ACTIONS ------------------------

function SetInitialState(newState) -- To be called from the reference card
    state.state = newState.state;
    state.health = newState.health;
    state.base = newState.base;
    state.imageScale = newState.imageScale;
    state.referenceCard = newState.referenceCard;
    state.sig = newState.sig;
    SignatureStorage = newState.sig; -- Set SignatureStorage to the initial sig value
    state.Shipcost = newState.shipcost;
    RecalculateSignature() -- Recalculate signature to account for any initial spikes
end

function ModifyHealth(params)
    state.health.current = math.max(0, math.min(state.health.max, state.health.current + params.amount));
    SyncHealth()
end

function ModifyAura(params)
    state.conditions.Aura = math.max(0, math.floor((state.conditions.Aura or 0) + params.amount))
    showAura()
    SyncCondition("Aura")
end

function ModifyBaseSignature(amount)
    SignatureStorage = math.max(0, SignatureStorage + amount)
    RecalculateSignature()
end

function RecalculateSignature()
    local baseSignature = cloaked == 1 and 0 or SignatureStorage
    local spikeBonus = (state.conditions.Spikes or 0) * 3
    local newSig = baseSignature + spikeBonus
    
    -- Ensure sig doesn't go below 0
    newSig = math.max(0, newSig)
    
    if newSig ~= state.sig then
        state.sig = newSig
        
        -- Turn off sig aura if it was shown
        TurnOffSigAura()
    end
end

function ShowSig()
    state.sigAuraShown = not state.sigAuraShown
    if state.sigAuraShown then
        state.conditions.SigAura = state.sig
        state.conditions.TargetSig = 1  -- Light up the button
        print("Showing Ship Signature and Spikes. Value:", state.sig," Inches")
    else
        state.conditions.SigAura = 0
        state.conditions.TargetSig = 0  -- Turn off the button
    end
    showSigAura()
    SyncCondition("SigAura")
    SyncCondition("TargetSig")
end

function TurnOffSigAura()
    if state.sigAuraShown then
        state.sigAuraShown = false
        state.conditions.SigAura = 0
        state.conditions.TargetSig = 0
        showSigAura()
        SyncCondition("SigAura")
        SyncCondition("TargetSig")
        print("Signature aura turned off due to Silent Running or Spike changes")
    end
end

function ModifyCondition(params)
    local previousValue = state.conditions[params.name] or 0  -- Default to 0 if nil
    if params.amount == 0 then -- toggle
        state.conditions[params.name] = math.max(0, 1 - previousValue)
    else
        if Conditions[params.name].loop ~= nil then
            state.conditions[params.name] = math.max(0, (previousValue + params.amount + Conditions[params.name].loop) % Conditions[params.name].loop)
        else
            state.conditions[params.name] = math.max(0, previousValue + params.amount)
        end
    end
    if params.name == 'Mode' then
        Sync()
    else
        print(self.getData().Nickname .. [[: ']] .. params.name .. [[' ]] .. previousValue .. [[->]] .. state.conditions[params.name])
        SyncCondition(params.name)
    end
end

function ModifyMoveRange(params)
    state.move.moveRange = math.max(0, state.move.moveRange + params.amount);
end

------ MODEL MANIPULATION -------------------

function AuraFollowObject(params)
    if ChildObjs.aura_obj ~= nil then
        ChildObjs.aura_obj.setVar('parent', params.obj);
    end
end

function AuraResetFollow()
    if ChildObjs.aura_obj ~= nil then
        ChildObjs.aura_obj.setVar('parent', self);
    end
end

function RefreshModelShape()
    local attachments = self.getAttachments()
    for key, value in pairs(attachments) do
        local modelElement = self.removeAttachment(0)
        if modelElement then
            modelElement.setCustomObject({
                image_scalar = tonumber(state.imageScale * 1)
            });
            self.addAttachment(modelElement)
        end
    end
    RefreshBaseColor()
end

function adjustTransparency(baseColor, newAlpha)
    if type(baseColor) == "table" and baseColor.r and baseColor.g and baseColor.b then
        self.setColorTint({
            r = baseColor.r,
            g = baseColor.g,
            b = baseColor.b,
            a = newAlpha / 255  -- Normalize alpha value
        })
    else
        print("Error: baseColor is not in the expected format or missing r, g, b")
    end
end

function RefreshBaseColor()
    -- Temporarily force specific values
    state.base.color = {r = 1, g = 1, b = 1}
    
    local baseColor = state.base.color

    if type(baseColor) == "table" and baseColor.r and baseColor.g and baseColor.b then
        if state.conditions.Activated == 0 then
            adjustTransparency(baseColor, 255)  -- Fully opaque
        else
            adjustTransparency(baseColor, 135)  -- Slight transparency
        end
    else
        print("Error: baseColor is not properly set in RefreshBaseColor")
    end
end

------ UI GENERATION ------------------------

function calculatePlayerRotation()
    for _, player in ipairs(Player.getPlayers()) do
        UIStatus[player.color].rotation = player.getPointerRotation() - self.getRotation().y + 180;
    end
end

function Sync()
    self.UI.setXml(ui())
end

function SyncCondition(name)
    for k, color in pairs({'Red', 'Blue', 'Grey', 'Black'}) do
        local conditionValue = state.conditions[name] or 0
        local conditionData = Conditions[name]
        if not conditionData then
            print("Error: No condition data found for " .. name)
            return
        end
        
        local isActive = conditionValue > 0
        local imageUrl = isActive and conditionData.active_url or conditionData.url
        local colorBlock
        if currentUIMode == 1 then  -- Subtle mode
            colorBlock = conditionData.color .. (isActive and 'FF' or '22')
        else
            colorBlock = conditionData.color .. "FF"  -- Always fully opaque for other modes
        end

        self.UI.setAttributes(color .. "_ConditionImage_" .. name, {
            color = colorBlock,
            image = imageUrl,
        })
        self.UI.setAttributes(color .. "_ConditionText_" .. name, {
            active = (conditionData.stacks and isActive) and 'true' or 'false',
            text = conditionValue
        })
    end

    if name == "Activated" then
        RefreshBaseColor()
    end
end

function SyncHealth()
    for k, color in pairs({'Red', 'Blue', 'Grey', 'Black'}) do
        self.UI.setAttributes(color .. "_HealthBar_Text", {
            text = state.health.current .. [[/]] .. state.health.max
        });
        self.UI.setAttributes(color .. "_HealthBar", {
            percentage = (state.health.current / state.health.max * 100)
        });
    end
end

function IsPlayerSuscribed(color)
    return UIStatus[color] ~= nil;
end

function HUDLookAtPlayer(player)
    local playerRotation = player.getPointerRotation();
    if playerRotation == nil then playerRotation = 0 end;
    local pointerRotation = playerRotation - self.getRotation().y + 180;
    pointerRotation = math.floor((pointerRotation + 15) / 30)
    if pointerRotation ~= UIStatus[player.color].rotation then
        self.UI.setAttribute(player.color .. '_PlayerHUDPivot', 'rotation', '0 0 ' .. -30 * pointerRotation)
        UIStatus[player.color].rotation = pointerRotation;
    end
end

function ui()
    local panelContent = ""
    for _, color in ipairs({'Blue', 'Red', 'Grey', 'Black'}) do
        local pivot = PlayerHUDPivot(color)
        if pivot then
            panelContent = panelContent .. pivot
        end
    end
    local result = [[
        <Panel color="#FFFFFFff" height="0" width="0" rectAlignment="MiddleCenter" childForceExpandWidth="true" >]] 
        .. panelContent .. 
        [[</Panel>
    ]]
    return result
end

function rebuildAssets()
    local assets = {};
    for conditionName, value in pairs(Conditions) do
        assets[#assets + 1] = { name = conditionName, url = value.url };
        if value.active_url then
            assets[#assets + 1] = { name = conditionName .. "_active", url = value.active_url };
        end
    end

    self.UI.setCustomAssets(assets)
end

function PlayerHUDPivot(color)
    if not UIStatus[color] then 
        return "" 
    end
    local rotation = UIStatus[color].rotation or 0
    local content = getUIContent(color)
    if not content then 
        return "" 
    end
    local result = string.format([[
        <Panel id='%s_PlayerHUDPivot' visibility='%s' height="260" width="100" position='0 0 -340' rotation='0 0 %s' rectAlignment="MiddleCenter" childForceExpandWidth="false">
        %s
        </Panel>
    ]], color, color, tostring(-rotation), content)
    return result
end

function getUIContent(color)
    if currentUIMode == 0 then
        return HighVisibilityUI(color, BigUI_Height)
    elseif currentUIMode == 1 then
        return SubtleUI(color, BigUI_Height)  -- Passing BigUI_Height here as well
    else
        return CompactUI(color, SmallUI_Height)
    end
end

local HiVis_BACKPLATE_WIDTH = 498 * UI_SCALE  -- Adjust this value to change the width
local HiVis_BACKPLATE_HEIGHT = 190 * UI_SCALE  -- Adjust this value to change the height

function HighVisibilityUI(color, height)
    if not state.health then return "" end
    local healthCurrent = state.health.current or 0
    local healthMax = state.health.max or 1
    local percentage = (healthCurrent / healthMax * 100) or 0
    local conditions = HUDConditions(color) or ""
    return string.format([[
        <Panel id='PlayerHUD_Container' active='true' height="%d" width="%d" rectAlignment="MiddleCenter" rotation='-35 0 0' position='0 50 %d' childForceExpandWidth="false">
            <Panel width="100%%" height="100%%" color="%s">
                <Panel height="180" width="128" rectAlignment="MiddleCenter">
                    %s
                    <ProgressBar width="200%%" height="%d" id="%s_HealthBar" color='#00000080' fillImageColor="#44AA22FF" percentage="%s" textColor="#00000000"/>  
                    <Text id='%s_HealthBar_Text' fontSize='%d' height="%d" onClick='UI_ModifyHealth' text='%s/%s' color='%s' fontStyle='Bold' outline='%s' outlineSize='%s' />
                </Panel>
            </Panel>
        </Panel>
    ]], HiVis_BACKPLATE_HEIGHT, HiVis_BACKPLATE_WIDTH, height, BACKGROUND_COLOR, conditions, 60 * UI_SCALE, color, percentage, color, 25 * UI_SCALE, 30 * UI_SCALE, healthCurrent, healthMax, TEXT_COLOR, OUTLINE_COLOR, OUTLINE_SIZE)
end

function SubtleUI(color, height)
    if not state.health then return "" end
    local healthCurrent = state.health.current or 0
    local healthMax = state.health.max or 1
    local percentage = (healthCurrent / healthMax * 100) or 0
    local conditions = HUDConditions(color) or ""
    return string.format([[
        <Panel id='PlayerHUD_Container' active='true' height="180" width="128" rectAlignment="MiddleCenter" rotation='-35 0 0' position='0 50 %d' childForceExpandWidth="false">%s
        <ProgressBar width="200%%" height="60" id="%s_HealthBar" color='#00000080' fillImageColor="#44AA22FF" percentage="%s" textColor="#00000000"/>  
        <Text id='%s_HealthBar_Text' fontSize='25' height="30" onClick='UI_ModifyHealth' text='%s/%s' color='#ffffff' fontStyle='Bold' outline='#000000' outlineSize='1 1' />
        </Panel>
    ]], height, conditions, color, percentage, color, healthCurrent, healthMax)
end

local Compact_BACKPLATE_WIDTH = 200 * UI_SCALE  -- Adjust this value to change the width
local Compact_BACKPLATE_HEIGHT = 180 * UI_SCALE  -- Adjust this value to change the height

function CompactUI(color, height)
    if not state.health then return "" end
    local healthCurrent = state.health.current or 0
    local healthMax = state.health.max or 1
    local percentage = (healthCurrent / healthMax * 100) or 0
    local conditions = CompactHUDConditions(color) or ""
    
    -- Define the amount to move the background up
    local backgroundOffsetY = 20 -- Adjust this value to move the background up or down

    return string.format([[
        <Panel id='PlayerHUD_Container' active='true' height="%d" width="%d" rectAlignment="MiddleCenter" rotation='-35 0 0' position='0 %d %d' childForceExpandWidth="false">
            <Panel width="100%%" height="100%%" color="%s">
                <Panel height="80" width="78" rectAlignment="MiddleCenter" position="0 -%d 0">
                    %s
                    <ProgressBar width="200%%" height="%d" id="%s_HealthBar" color='#00000080' fillImageColor="#44AA22FF" percentage="%s" textColor="#00000000"/>  
                    <Text id='%s_HealthBar_Text' fontSize='%d' height="%d" onClick='UI_ModifyHealth' text='%s/%s' color='%s' fontStyle='Bold' outline='%s' outlineSize='%s' />
                </Panel>
            </Panel>
        </Panel>
    ]], Compact_BACKPLATE_HEIGHT, Compact_BACKPLATE_WIDTH, 
    50 + backgroundOffsetY, height, 
    BACKGROUND_COLOR, 
    backgroundOffsetY, 
    conditions, 20 * UI_SCALE, color, percentage, color, 18 * UI_SCALE, 20 * UI_SCALE, 
    healthCurrent, healthMax, TEXT_COLOR, OUTLINE_COLOR, OUTLINE_SIZE)
end

function HUDConditions(color)
    if not color then return "" end
    local size = 60
    local conditions = {
        HUDSingleCondition(color, "Fire", 0, -1, size),
        HUDSingleCondition(color,"Atmosphere", -1 ,1,size),
        HUDSingleCondition(color, "Orbital_Decay", 1, -1, size),
        HUDSingleCondition(color, "Scanners_Offline", -1, -1, size),
        HUDSingleCondition(color, "Weapons_Offline", 4, -1, size),
        HUDSingleCondition(color, "Defence_Systems_Offline", 2, -1, size),
        HUDSingleCondition(color, "Navigation_Offline", 3, -1, size),
        HUDSingleCondition(color, "Spikes", -1, 0, size),
        HUDSingleCondition(color, "Aura", 4, 1, size),
        HUDSingleCondition(color, "Activated", 4, 0, size),
        HUDSingleCondition(color, "Mode", 3, 1, size),
        HUDSingleCondition(color, "Silent_Running", 0, 1, size),
        HUDSingleCondition(color, "Clockwise", 1, 1, size),
        HUDSingleCondition(color, "CounterClockwise", 2, 1, size),
        HUDSingleCondition(color, "TargetSig", -2, 0, size)
    }
    return "<Panel width=\"100%\" rectAlignment=\"MiddleLeft\" position='0 0 0' >" .. table.concat(conditions) .. "</Panel>"
end

function SubtleHUDConditions(color)
    if not color then return "" end
    local size = 60
    local conditions = {
        HUDSingleCondition(color, "Fire", 0, -1, size),
        HUDSingleCondition(color, "Orbital_Decay", 1, -1, size),
        HUDSingleCondition(color, "Scanners_Offline", -1, -1, size),
        HUDSingleCondition(color, "Weapons_Offline", 4, -1, size),
        HUDSingleCondition(color, "Defence_Systems_Offline", 2, -1, size),
        HUDSingleCondition(color, "Navigation_Offline", 3, -1, size),
        HUDSingleCondition(color, "Spikes", -1, 0, size),
        HUDSingleCondition(color, "Aura", 4, 1, size),
        HUDSingleCondition(color, "Activated", 4, 0, size),
        HUDSingleCondition(color, "Mode", 3, 1, size)
    }
    return "<Panel width=\"100%\" rectAlignment=\"MiddleLeft\" position='0 0 0' >" .. table.concat(conditions) .. "</Panel>"
end

function CompactHUDConditions(color)
    if not color then return "" end
    local size = 38
    local size2 = 30
    local conditions = {
        HUDSingleCondition(color, "Fire", 0.5, 2.5, size2),
        HUDSingleCondition(color,"Atmosphere", -0.5 ,2.5,size2),
        HUDSingleCondition(color, "Orbital_Decay", 1.5, 2.5, size2),

function HUDSingleCondition(color, name, x, y, size)
    if not color or not name or not x or not y or not size then
        return ""
    end
    local id = "ConditionFrame_" .. name
    local position = string.format("%s %s 0", ((x * (size + 4) * UI_SCALE) - (1.5 * size + 4) * UI_SCALE), y * ((size + 4) * UI_SCALE))
    return string.format([[
        <Panel id="%s" width="%d" height="%d" alignment='LowerLeft' position='%s' onClick='UI_Modify%s()'>
        %s
        </Panel>
    ]], id, size * UI_SCALE, size * UI_SCALE, position, name, HUDSingleConditionBody(color, name, size * UI_SCALE) or "")
end

function HUDSingleConditionBody(color, name, size)
    if not color or not name or not size or not state.conditions then
        return ""
    end
    local conditionValue = state.conditions[name] or 0
    local condition = Conditions[name]
    if not condition then
        return ""
    end
    
    local isActive = conditionValue > 0
    local imageUrl = isActive and condition.active_url or condition.url
    local colorBlock
    if currentUIMode == 1 then  -- Subtle mode
        colorBlock = condition.color .. (isActive and 'FF' or '22')  -- Fully opaque when active, partially transparent when inactive
    else
        colorBlock = condition.color .. "FF"  -- Always fully opaque for other modes
    end
    local fontSize = math.floor(size * 0.85)

    return string.format([[
        <Image id="%s_ConditionImage_%s" image="%s" color="%s" rectAlignment='MiddleCenter' width='%d' height='%d'/>
        <Text id="%s_ConditionText_%s" active='%s' fontSize='%d' text='%s' color='%s' fontStyle='Bold' rectAlignment='LowerRight' outline='%s' outlineSize='%s' />
    ]], color, name, imageUrl, colorBlock, size, size, color, name, tostring(condition.stacks and isActive), fontSize, conditionValue, TEXT_COLOR, OUTLINE_COLOR, OUTLINE_SIZE)
end

function showAura()
    local auraSize = state.conditions.Aura or 0

    -- Scale is directly the aura size (in inches)
    local scale = auraSize

    if ChildObjs.aura_obj then
        ChildObjs.aura_obj.setScale({scale, 1, scale})
        ChildObjs.aura_obj.setPosition(self.getPosition())
        ChildObjs.aura_obj.setRotation(self.getRotation())
    else
        local clr = self.getColorTint()
        ChildObjs.aura_obj = spawnObject({
            type = 'custom_model',
            position = self.getPosition(),
            rotation = self.getRotation(),
            scale = {scale, 1, scale},
            mass = 0,
            use_gravity = false,
            sound = false,
            snap_to_grid = false,
            callback_function = function(b)
                b.setColorTint(clr)
                b.setVar('parent', self)
                b.setLuaScript([[
                    function onUpdate()
                        if parent and parent.getPosition then
                            self.setPosition(parent.getPosition())
                            self.setRotation(parent.getRotation())
                        end
                    end
                ]])
                b.getComponent('MeshRenderer').set('receiveShadows', false)
            end
        })
        ChildObjs.aura_obj.setCustomObject({
            mesh = 'https://steamusercontent-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/2450611726223935325/77C02DD7AC66A61A2F30452D73585D02DFE0D72D/',
            collider = 'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/RobMayer/TTSLibrary/master/utility/null_COL.obj',
            material = 3,
            specularIntensity = 0,
            cast_shadows = false
        })
    end

    if auraSize == 0 and ChildObjs.aura_obj then
        ChildObjs.aura_obj.setScale({0, 0, 0})
    else
        ChildObjs.aura_obj.setScale({scale, 1, scale})
    end
end

function showSigAura()
    local auraSize = state.conditions.SigAura or 0

    -- Scale is directly the aura size (in inches)
    local scale = auraSize

    if ChildObjs.sig_aura_obj then
        if scale == 0 then
            -- Hide the aura object
            ChildObjs.sig_aura_obj.setScale({0, 0, 0})
        else
            -- Show and update the aura object
            ChildObjs.sig_aura_obj.setScale({scale, 1, scale})
            ChildObjs.sig_aura_obj.setPosition(self.getPosition())
            ChildObjs.sig_aura_obj.setRotation(self.getRotation())
        end
    else
        -- Only create the aura object if it should be visible
        if scale > 0 then
            local clr = {r=1, g=0, b=0}  -- Set color to red
            ChildObjs.sig_aura_obj = spawnObject({
                type = 'custom_model',
                position = self.getPosition(),
                rotation = self.getRotation(),
                scale = {scale, 1, scale},
                mass = 0,
                use_gravity = false,
                sound = false,
                snap_to_grid = false,
                callback_function = function(b)
                    b.setColorTint(clr)  -- Set the color to red
                    b.setVar('parent', self)
                    b.setLuaScript([[
                        function onUpdate()
                            if parent and parent.getPosition then
                                self.setPosition(parent.getPosition())
                                self.setRotation(parent.getRotation())
                            end
                        end
                    ]])
                    b.getComponent('MeshRenderer').set('receiveShadows', false)
                end
            })
            ChildObjs.sig_aura_obj.setCustomObject({
                mesh = 'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/RobMayer/TTSLibrary/master/components/arcs/round0.obj',
                collider = 'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/RobMayer/TTSLibrary/master/utility/null_COL.obj',
                material = 3,
                specularIntensity = 0,
                cast_shadows = false
            })
        end
    end

    if auraSize == 0 and ChildObjs.sig_aura_obj then
        ChildObjs.sig_aura_obj.setScale({0, 0, 0})
    elseif ChildObjs.sig_aura_obj then
        ChildObjs.sig_aura_obj.setScale({scale, 1, scale})
    end
end

function RefreshShip()
    -- Save current state
    local currentState = {
        conditions = state.conditions,
        health = state.health,
        base = state.base,
        imageScale = state.imageScale,
        sig = state.sig,
        sigAuraShown = state.sigAuraShown,
        -- Add any other state variables you need to preserve
    }

    -- Rebuild UI and assets
    rebuildAssets()

    -- Use Wait.frames to delay UI initialization
    Wait.frames(function()
        -- Restore saved state
        for key, value in pairs(currentState) do
            state[key] = value
        end

        -- Reinitialize UI and other visual elements
        self.UI.setXml(ui())
        Sync()  -- Ensure UI is fully updated
        RefreshModelShape()
        showAura()
        if state.sigAuraShown then
            showSigAura()
        end
        
        -- Recalculate any derived values
        RecalculateSignature()

        print(self.getName() .. " has been refreshed.")
    end, 2)  -- Wait for 2 frames before initializing UI
end

-- Initialize state table
local buttonStates = {
    crown = true,
    upper = true,
    lower = true
}

function onLoad(saved_data)
    -- Load saved state if it exists
    if saved_data ~= "" then
        buttonStates = JSON.decode(saved_data)
    end
    
    -- Create Crown button (at the top of token)
    self.createButton({
        click_function = "toggleCrown",
        function_owner = self,
        label = buttonStates.crown and "Crown Healthy" or "Crown Destroyed",
        position = {0, 0.2, -0.7},  -- Top of token
        width = 800,
        height = 200,
        font_size = 60,
        color = buttonStates.crown and {0, 1, 0} or {1, 0, 0},
    })
    
    -- Create Upper Tower button (in middle of token)
    self.createButton({
        click_function = "toggleUpper",
        function_owner = self,
        label = buttonStates.upper and "Upper Tower Healthy" or "Upper Tower Destroyed",
        position = {0, 0.2, 0},  -- Middle of token
        width = 800,
        height = 200,
        font_size = 60,
        color = buttonStates.upper and {0, 1, 0} or {1, 0, 0},
    })
    
    -- Create Lower Tower button (at bottom of token)
    self.createButton({
        click_function = "toggleLower",
        function_owner = self,
        label = buttonStates.lower and "Lower Tower Healthy" or "Lower Tower Destroyed",
        position = {0, 0.2, 0.7},  -- Bottom of token
        width = 800,
        height = 200,
        font_size = 60,
        color = buttonStates.lower and {0, 1, 0} or {1, 0, 0},
    })
end

-- Save function that gets called when the game state needs to be saved
function onSave()
    return JSON.encode(buttonStates)
end

-- Toggle functions for each button
function toggleCrown(obj, color, alt_click)
    buttonStates.crown = not buttonStates.crown
    local newLabel = buttonStates.crown and "Crown Healthy" or "Crown Destroyed"
    local newColor = buttonStates.crown and {0, 1, 0} or {1, 0, 0}
    
    self.editButton({
        index = 0,
        label = newLabel,
        color = newColor
    })
end

function toggleUpper(obj, color, alt_click)
    buttonStates.upper = not buttonStates.upper
    local newLabel = buttonStates.upper and "Upper Tower Healthy" or "Upper Tower Destroyed"
    local newColor = buttonStates.upper and {0, 1, 0} or {1, 0, 0}
    
    self.editButton({
        index = 1,
        label = newLabel,
        color = newColor
    })
end

function toggleLower(obj, color, alt_click)
    buttonStates.lower = not buttonStates.lower
    local newLabel = buttonStates.lower and "Lower Tower Healthy" or "Lower Tower Destroyed"
    local newColor = buttonStates.lower and {0, 1, 0} or {1, 0, 0}
    
    self.editButton({
        index = 2,
        label = newLabel,
        color = newColor
    })
end

-- SHIP CARD SCRIPT V4 08/04/2025

local mini = nil
local faction;
local baseScale=0.35; --REPLACE THIS SCALE
local cardFrontImage;
local cardBackImage;
local health=14; --REPLACE THIS HEALTH
local sig = 6; --REPLACE THIS SIG
points = 125;

local name='Centurion Grand Cruiser';

function onLoad(save)
    local data = JSON.decode(save) or {}
    mini = getObjectFromGUID(data.mini)
    baseScale = 0.35 --REPLACE THIS SCALE
    health = data.Health or 14 --REPLACE THIS HEALTH
	sig = 6; --REPLACE THIS SIG
	-- print("Onload triggered, Health is :", health)
    imageScale = data.imageScale or 1
    modelImage = 'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/TemporalDistoriton/DropfleetTTS/main/Neutral/Centurion%20Grand%20Cruiser_ModelImage.png' --REPLACE THIS MODEL IMAGE
	cardFrontImage = 'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/TemporalDistoriton/DropfleetTTS/main/Neutral/Centurion%20Grand%20Cruiser_CardFrontImage.png' --REPLACE THIS CARD IMAGE
	cardBackImage =  cardFrontImage
    name = 'Centurion Grand Cruiser'
    faction = data.faction or 'Neutral'
    -- playerColor = data.playerColor or 'White'
    factionColor = Color(1,1,1)
	-- print("-- Onload triggered, color is :", factionColor)
    rebuildUI()
end

local prototypes = {
    ["0.5"] = "44860d", -- Colossal
    ["0.4"] = "f00f62", -- Heavy
    ["0.35"] = "6ac644", -- Medium
    ["0.3"] = "c06744", -- Light
}

function destruct()
    if mini ~= nil then
mini.destruct()    
    end
end

function ui_createModel()
    -- Get the current position of the object and create a new model at that position
    --print("CREATING SHIP STAGE 1")
	createModel(self.getPosition())
end

function createModel(position)
    local pos = position:add(Vector(0, 2, 0))
    local objectData = self.getData()
    local modelPrototype = getObjectFromGUID(prototypes[tostring(baseScale)])
    if not modelPrototype then
        print("Error: Model prototype with the given GUID was not found.")
        print(modelPrototype)
        return
    end

    -- Clone the object without scripts
    local model = modelPrototype.clone({
        position = pos,
        snap_to_grid = false
        -- Do not set 'script = ""' to allow scripts to be copied
    })

    -- Wait for the object to be fully created
    Wait.frames(function()
        -- Set custom object properties
        model.setCustomObject({
            mesh = modelPrototype.getCustomObject().mesh,
            diffuse = modelImage,
            normal = modelPrototype.getCustomObject().normal,
            material = modelPrototype.getCustomObject().material,
            collider = modelPrototype.getCustomObject().collider,
            type = modelPrototype.type,
            image = modelImage,
            image_secondary = modelImage,
            image_scalar = imageScale,
            name = "Unnamed Model"
        })
        
        -- Set the Lua script
        local placeholderScript = modelPrototype.getLuaScript()
        model.setLuaScript(placeholderScript)
        
        -- Set script state
        local scriptState = {
            state = {
                health = {current = health, max = health},
                base = {
                    color = {r = factionColor.r, g = factionColor.g, b = factionColor.b, a = 1},
                    size = baseScale * 25
                },
                imageScale = imageScale,
                conditions = {},
                sig = sig
            },
            originalData = {
                health = {current = health, max = health},
                base = {
                    color = {r = factionColor.r, g = factionColor.g, b = factionColor.b, a = 1},
                    size = baseScale * 25
                },
                imageScale = imageScale,
                sig = sig
            },
            SHIPCardURL = cardFrontImage  -- Add this line to pass the card image URL
        }
        model.script_state = JSON.encode(scriptState)
        
        -- Apply changes and set other properties
        model.setScale({x = baseScale, y = baseScale, z = baseScale})
        model.setName(name or "Unnamed Model")
        model.setDescription(objectData.Description or "")
        model.setColorTint(factionColor)
        
        -- After the model is loaded, set the SHIPCardURL variable directly
        Wait.frames(function()
            if model ~= nil then
                model.call("SetShipCardURL", {url = cardFrontImage})
            end
        end, 5) -- Give it a few frames to fully initialize
        
        -- Reload the model to apply changes
        model.reload()

        mini = model
    end, 2)
end

	createModel(self.getPosition())

function createModel(position)
    local pos = position:add(Vector(0, 2, 0))
    local objectData = self.getData()
    local modelPrototype = getObjectFromGUID(prototypes[tostring(baseScale)])
    if not modelPrototype then
        print("Error: Model prototype with the given GUID was not found.")
        print(modelPrototype)
        return
    end

    -- Clone the object without scripts
    local model = modelPrototype.clone({
        position = pos,
        snap_to_grid = false
        -- Do not set 'script = ""' to allow scripts to be copied
    })

    -- Wait for the object to be fully created
    Wait.frames(function()
        -- Set custom object properties
        model.setCustomObject({
            mesh = modelPrototype.getCustomObject().mesh,
            diffuse = modelImage,
            normal = modelPrototype.getCustomObject().normal,
            material = modelPrototype.getCustomObject().material,
            collider = modelPrototype.getCustomObject().collider,
            type = modelPrototype.type,
            image = modelImage,
            image_secondary = modelImage,
            image_scalar = imageScale,
            name = "Unnamed Model"
        })
        
        -- Set the Lua script
        local placeholderScript = modelPrototype.getLuaScript()
        model.setLuaScript(placeholderScript)
        
        -- Set script state
        local scriptState = {
            state = {
                health = {current = health, max = health},
                base = {
                    color = {r = factionColor.r, g = factionColor.g, b = factionColor.b, a = 1},
                    size = baseScale * 25
                },
                imageScale = imageScale,
                conditions = {},
                sig = sig
            },
            originalData = {
                health = {current = health, max = health},
                base = {
                    color = {r = factionColor.r, g = factionColor.g, b = factionColor.b, a = 1},
                    size = baseScale * 25
                },
                imageScale = imageScale,
                sig = sig
            },
            SHIPCardURL = cardFrontImage  -- Add this line to pass the card image URL
        }
        model.script_state = JSON.encode(scriptState)
        
        -- Apply changes and set other properties
        model.setScale({x = baseScale, y = baseScale, z = baseScale})
        model.setName(name or "Unnamed Model")
        model.setDescription(objectData.Description or "")
        model.setColorTint(factionColor)
        
        -- After the model is loaded, set the SHIPCardURL variable directly
        Wait.frames(function()
            if model ~= nil then
                model.call("SetShipCardURL", {url = cardFrontImage})
            end
        end, 5) -- Give it a few frames to fully initialize
        
        -- Reload the model to apply changes
        model.reload()

        mini = model
    end, 2)
end

-- SHIP CARD SCRIPT V4 08/04/2025

local mini = nil
local faction;
local baseScale=0.35; --REPLACE THIS SCALE
local cardFrontImage;
local cardBackImage;
local health=; --REPLACE THIS HEALTH
local sig = 3; --REPLACE THIS SIG
points = 0;
local imageScale;
local modelImage='https://raw.githubusercontent.com/TemporalDistoriton/DropfleetTTS/main/Bioficers/Precedent%20One_ModelImage.png'; --REPLACE THIS MODEL IMAGE
local name='Precedent One';
local playerColor='Green';
local factionColor= Color(1,1,1);

function onLoad(save)
    local data = JSON.decode(save) or {}
    mini = getObjectFromGUID(data.mini)
    baseScale = 0.35 --REPLACE THIS SCALE
    health = data.Health or  --REPLACE THIS HEALTH
	sig = 3; --REPLACE THIS SIG
	-- print("Onload triggered, Health is :", health)
    imageScale = data.imageScale or 1
    modelImage = 'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/TemporalDistoriton/DropfleetTTS/main/Bioficers/Precedent%20One_ModelImage.png' --REPLACE THIS MODEL IMAGE
	cardFrontImage = 'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/TemporalDistoriton/DropfleetTTS/main/Bioficers/Precedent%20One_CardFrontImage.png' --REPLACE THIS CARD IMAGE
	cardBackImage =  cardFrontImage
    name = 'Precedent One'
    faction = data.faction or 'Bioficers'
    -- playerColor = data.playerColor or 'White'
    factionColor = Color(1,1,1)
	-- print("-- Onload triggered, color is :", factionColor)
    rebuildUI()
end

local prototypes = {
    ["0.5"] = "44860d", -- Colossal
    ["0.4"] = "f00f62", -- Heavy
    ["0.35"] = "6ac644", -- Medium
    ["0.3"] = "c06744", -- Light
}

function destruct()
    if mini ~= nil then
mini.destruct()    
    end
end

function ui_createModel()
    -- Get the current position of the object and create a new model at that position
    --print("CREATING SHIP STAGE 1")
	createModel(self.getPosition())
end

function createModel(position)
    local pos = position:add(Vector(0, 2, 0))
    local objectData = self.getData()
    local modelPrototype = getObjectFromGUID(prototypes[tostring(baseScale)])
    if not modelPrototype then
        print("Error: Model prototype with the given GUID was not found.")
        print(modelPrototype)
        return
    end

    -- Clone the object without scripts
    local model = modelPrototype.clone({
        position = pos,
        snap_to_grid = false
        -- Do not set 'script = ""' to allow scripts to be copied
    })

    -- Wait for the object to be fully created
    Wait.frames(function()
        -- Set custom object properties
        model.setCustomObject({
            mesh = modelPrototype.getCustomObject().mesh,
            diffuse = modelImage,
            normal = modelPrototype.getCustomObject().normal,
            material = modelPrototype.getCustomObject().material,
            collider = modelPrototype.getCustomObject().collider,
            type = modelPrototype.type,
            image = modelImage,
            image_secondary = modelImage,
            image_scalar = imageScale,
            name = "Unnamed Model"
        })
        
        -- Set the Lua script
        local placeholderScript = modelPrototype.getLuaScript()
        model.setLuaScript(placeholderScript)
        
        -- Set script state
        local scriptState = {
            state = {
                health = {current = health, max = health},
                base = {
                    color = {r = factionColor.r, g = factionColor.g, b = factionColor.b, a = 1},
                    size = baseScale * 25
                },
                imageScale = imageScale,
                conditions = {},
                sig = sig
            },
            originalData = {
                health = {current = health, max = health},
                base = {
                    color = {r = factionColor.r, g = factionColor.g, b = factionColor.b, a = 1},
                    size = baseScale * 25
                },
                imageScale = imageScale,
                sig = sig
            },
            SHIPCardURL = cardFrontImage  -- Add this line to pass the card image URL
        }
        model.script_state = JSON.encode(scriptState)
        
        -- Apply changes and set other properties
        model.setScale({x = baseScale, y = baseScale, z = baseScale})
        model.setName(name or "Unnamed Model")
        model.setDescription(objectData.Description or "")
        model.setColorTint(factionColor)
        
        -- After the model is loaded, set the SHIPCardURL variable directly
        Wait.frames(function()
            if model ~= nil then
                model.call("SetShipCardURL", {url = cardFrontImage})
            end
        end, 5) -- Give it a few frames to fully initialize
        
        -- Reload the model to apply changes
        model.reload()

        mini = model
    end, 2)
end

	
	


function ui_pingmini(player)
    if (mini ~= nil) then
        if (player.pingTable ~= nil) then
            player.pingTable(mini.getPosition())
        end
    end
end

function rebuildAssets()
    local root = 'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/RobMayer/TTSLibrary/master/ui/';
    local assets = {
        {name='ui_power', url=root..'power.png'},
        {name='ui_gear', url=root..'gear.png'},
        {name='ui_close', url=root..'close.png'},
        {name='ui_plus', url=root..'plus.png'},
        {name='ui_minus', url=root..'minus.png'},
        {name='ui_reload', url=root..'reload.png'},
        {name='ui_location', url=root..'location.png'},
        {name='ui_bars_new', url=root..'bars_new.png'},
        {name='ui_arrow_u', url=root..'arrow_u.png'},
        {name='ui_arrow_d', url=root..'arrow_d.png'},
        {name='ui_arrow_l', url=root..'arrow_l.png'},
        {name='ui_arrow_r', url=root..'arrow_r.png'},
    }

    assetBuffer = {}
    local bufLen = 0
    for idx,guid in pairs(mapI2G) do
        local mini = getObjectFromGUID(guid)
        if (mini ~= nil) then
            for i,marker in pairs(mini.call('getMarkers', {})) do
                if (assetBuffer[marker.url] == nil) then
                    bufLen = bufLen + 1
                    assetBuffer[marker.url] = self.guid..'_mk_'..bufLen
                    table.insert(assets, {name=self.guid..'_mk_'..bufLen, url=marker.url})
                end
            end
        end
    end
    self.UI.setCustomAssets(assets)
end

function rebuildUI()
    self.setCustomObject({
        image = cardFrontImage,
        image_secondary = cardBackImage,
    });

    local ui = {
        {tag='Defaults', children={
            {tag='Text', attributes={color='#cccccc', fontSize='18', alignment='MiddleLeft'}},
            {tag='InputField', attributes={fontSize='24', preferredHeight='40'}},
            {tag='ToggleButton', attributes={fontSize='18', preferredHeight='40', colors='#ffcc33|#ffffff|#808080|#606060', selectedBackgroundColor='#dddddd', deselectedBackgroundColor='#999999'}},
            {tag='Button', attributes={fontSize='12',textColor='#111111', preferredHeight='40', colors='#dddddd|#ffffff|#808080|#f6f6f6'}},
            {tag='Toggle', attributes={textColor='#cccccc'}},
        }},
        
     --   {tag='button', attributes={onClick='ui_pingmini', image='ui_location',  colors='#ccccccff|#ffffffff|#404040ff|#808080ff', width='20', height='20', position='-40 -110 -5', rotation='0 0 180' }},
        {tag='button', attributes={onClick='ui_createModel',text='Spawn Ship',  colors='#ccccccff|#ffffffff|#404040ff|#808080ff', width='120', height='20', position='0 110 -5', rotation='0 0 180' }} 
    }
    
    self.UI.setXmlTable(ui)
end

function onSave()
    miniguid = ''
    if mini ~= nil then
        miniguid = mini.getGUID()
    end
    local save = {
        mini = miniguid,
        baseScale = baseScale,
        health = health,
        imageScale = imageScale,
       -- modelImage = modelImage,
        name = name,
        playerColor = playerColor, 
        faction = faction,
        cardFrontImage = cardFrontImage,
        cardBackImage = cardBackImage,
    }
    return JSON.encode(save)
end

    --print("CREATING SHIP STAGE 1")
	createModel(self.getPosition())
end

function createModel(position)
    local pos = position:add(Vector(0, 2, 0))
    local objectData = self.getData()
    local modelPrototype = getObjectFromGUID(prototypes[tostring(baseScale)])
    if not modelPrototype then
        print("Error: Model prototype with the given GUID was not found.")
        print(modelPrototype)
        return
    end

    -- Clone the object without scripts
    local model = modelPrototype.clone({
        position = pos,
        snap_to_grid = false
        -- Do not set 'script = ""' to allow scripts to be copied
    })

    -- Wait for the object to be fully created
    Wait.frames(function()
        -- Set custom object properties
        model.setCustomObject({
            mesh = modelPrototype.getCustomObject().mesh,
            diffuse = modelImage,
            normal = modelPrototype.getCustomObject().normal,
            material = modelPrototype.getCustomObject().material,
            collider = modelPrototype.getCustomObject().collider,
            type = modelPrototype.type,
            image = modelImage,
            image_secondary = modelImage,
            image_scalar = imageScale,
            name = "Unnamed Model"
        })
        
        -- Set the Lua script
        local placeholderScript = modelPrototype.getLuaScript()
        model.setLuaScript(placeholderScript)
        
        -- Set script state
        local scriptState = {
            state = {
                health = {current = health, max = health},
                base = {
                    color = {r = factionColor.r, g = factionColor.g, b = factionColor.b, a = 1},
                    size = baseScale * 25
                },
                imageScale = imageScale,
                conditions = {},
                sig = sig
            },
            originalData = {
                health = {current = health, max = health},
                base = {
                    color = {r = factionColor.r, g = factionColor.g, b = factionColor.b, a = 1},
                    size = baseScale * 25
                },
                imageScale = imageScale,
                sig = sig
            },
            SHIPCardURL = cardFrontImage  -- Add this line to pass the card image URL
        }
        model.script_state = JSON.encode(scriptState)
        
        -- Apply changes and set other properties
        model.setScale({x = baseScale, y = baseScale, z = baseScale})
        model.setName(name or "Unnamed Model")
        model.setDescription(objectData.Description or "")
        model.setColorTint(factionColor)
        
        -- After the model is loaded, set the SHIPCardURL variable directly
        Wait.frames(function()
            if model ~= nil then
                model.call("SetShipCardURL", {url = cardFrontImage})
            end
        end, 5) -- Give it a few frames to fully initialize
        
        -- Reload the model to apply changes
        model.reload()

        mini = model
    end, 2)
end

	
	


function ui_pingmini(player)
    if (mini ~= nil) then
        if (player.pingTable ~= nil) then
            player.pingTable(mini.getPosition())
        end
    end
end

function rebuildAssets()
    local root = 'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/RobMayer/TTSLibrary/master/ui/';
    local assets = {
        {name='ui_power', url=root..'power.png'},
        {name='ui_gear', url=root..'gear.png'},
        {name='ui_close', url=root..'close.png'},
        {name='ui_plus', url=root..'plus.png'},
        {name='ui_minus', url=root..'minus.png'},
        {name='ui_reload', url=root..'reload.png'},
        {name='ui_location', url=root..'location.png'},
        {name='ui_bars_new', url=root..'bars_new.png'},
        {name='ui_arrow_u', url=root..'arrow_u.png'},
        {name='ui_arrow_d', url=root..'arrow_d.png'},
        {name='ui_arrow_l', url=root..'arrow_l.png'},
        {name='ui_arrow_r', url=root..'arrow_r.png'},
    }

    assetBuffer = {}
    local bufLen = 0
    for idx,guid in pairs(mapI2G) do
        local mini = getObjectFromGUID(guid)
        if (mini ~= nil) then
            for i,marker in pairs(mini.call('getMarkers', {})) do
                if (assetBuffer[marker.url] == nil) then
                    bufLen = bufLen + 1
                    assetBuffer[marker.url] = self.guid..'_mk_'..bufLen
                    table.insert(assets, {name=self.guid..'_mk_'..bufLen, url=marker.url})
                end
            end
        end
    end
    self.UI.setCustomAssets(assets)
end

function rebuildUI()
    self.setCustomObject({
        image = cardFrontImage,
        image_secondary = cardBackImage,
    });

    local ui = {
        {tag='Defaults', children={
            {tag='Text', attributes={color='#cccccc', fontSize='18', alignment='MiddleLeft'}},
            {tag='InputField', attributes={fontSize='24', preferredHeight='40'}},
            {tag='ToggleButton', attributes={fontSize='18', preferredHeight='40', colors='#ffcc33|#ffffff|#808080|#606060', selectedBackgroundColor='#dddddd', deselectedBackgroundColor='#999999'}},
            {tag='Button', attributes={fontSize='12',textColor='#111111', preferredHeight='40', colors='#dddddd|#ffffff|#808080|#f6f6f6'}},
            {tag='Toggle', attributes={textColor='#cccccc'}},
        }},
        
     --   {tag='button', attributes={onClick='ui_pingmini', image='ui_location',  colors='#ccccccff|#ffffffff|#404040ff|#808080ff', width='20', height='20', position='-40 -110 -5', rotation='0 0 180' }},
        {tag='button', attributes={onClick='ui_createModel',text='Spawn Ship',  colors='#ccccccff|#ffffffff|#404040ff|#808080ff', width='120', height='20', position='0 110 -5', rotation='0 0 180' }} 
    }
    
    self.UI.setXmlTable(ui)
end

function onSave()
    miniguid = ''
    if mini ~= nil then
        miniguid = mini.getGUID()
    end
    local save = {
        mini = miniguid,
        baseScale = baseScale,
        health = health,
        imageScale = imageScale,
       -- modelImage = modelImage,
        name = name,
        playerColor = playerColor, 
        faction = faction,
        cardFrontImage = cardFrontImage,
        cardBackImage = cardBackImage,
    }
    return JSON.encode(save)
end

function createModel(position)
    local pos = position:add(Vector(0, 2, 0))
    local objectData = self.getData()
    local modelPrototype = getObjectFromGUID(prototypes[tostring(baseScale)])
    if not modelPrototype then
        print("Error: Model prototype with the given GUID was not found.")
        print(modelPrototype)
        return
    end

    -- Clone the object without scripts
    local model = modelPrototype.clone({
        position = pos,
        snap_to_grid = false
        -- Do not set 'script = ""' to allow scripts to be copied
    })

    -- Wait for the object to be fully created
    Wait.frames(function()
        -- Set custom object properties
        model.setCustomObject({
            mesh = modelPrototype.getCustomObject().mesh,
            diffuse = modelImage,
            normal = modelPrototype.getCustomObject().normal,
            material = modelPrototype.getCustomObject().material,
            collider = modelPrototype.getCustomObject().collider,
            type = modelPrototype.type,
            image = modelImage,
            image_secondary = modelImage,
            image_scalar = imageScale,
            name = "Unnamed Model"
        })
        
        -- Set the Lua script
        local placeholderScript = modelPrototype.getLuaScript()
        model.setLuaScript(placeholderScript)
        
        -- Set script state
        local scriptState = {
            state = {
                health = {current = health, max = health},
                base = {
                    color = {r = factionColor.r, g = factionColor.g, b = factionColor.b, a = 1},
                    size = baseScale * 25

                conditions = {},
                sig = sig

                imageScale = imageScale,
                sig = sig

    --print("CREATING SHIP STAGE 1")
	createModel(self.getPosition())
end

function createModel(position)
    local pos = position:add(Vector(0, 2, 0))
    local objectData = self.getData()
    local modelPrototype = getObjectFromGUID(prototypes[tostring(baseScale)])
    if not modelPrototype then
        print("Error: Model prototype with the given GUID was not found.")
        print(modelPrototype)
        return
    end

    -- Clone the object without scripts
    local model = modelPrototype.clone({
        position = pos,
        snap_to_grid = false
        -- Do not set 'script = ""' to allow scripts to be copied
    })

    -- Wait for the object to be fully created
    Wait.frames(function()
        -- Set custom object properties
        model.setCustomObject({
            mesh = modelPrototype.getCustomObject().mesh,
            diffuse = modelImage,
            normal = modelPrototype.getCustomObject().normal,
            material = modelPrototype.getCustomObject().material,
            collider = modelPrototype.getCustomObject().collider,
            type = modelPrototype.type,
            image = modelImage,
            image_secondary = modelImage,
            image_scalar = imageScale,
            name = "Unnamed Model"
        })
        
        -- Set the Lua script
        local placeholderScript = modelPrototype.getLuaScript()
        model.setLuaScript(placeholderScript)
        
        -- Set script state
        local scriptState = {
            state = {
                health = {current = health, max = health},
                base = {
                    color = {r = factionColor.r, g = factionColor.g, b = factionColor.b, a = 1},
                    size = baseScale * 25
                },
                imageScale = imageScale,
                conditions = {},
                sig = sig
            },
            originalData = {
                health = {current = health, max = health},
                base = {
                    color = {r = factionColor.r, g = factionColor.g, b = factionColor.b, a = 1},
                    size = baseScale * 25
                },
                imageScale = imageScale,
                sig = sig
            },
            SHIPCardURL = cardFrontImage  -- Add this line to pass the card image URL
        }
        model.script_state = JSON.encode(scriptState)
        
        -- Apply changes and set other properties
        model.setScale({x = baseScale, y = baseScale, z = baseScale})
        model.setName(name or "Unnamed Model")
        model.setDescription(objectData.Description or "")
        model.setColorTint(factionColor)
        
        -- After the model is loaded, set the SHIPCardURL variable directly
        Wait.frames(function()
            if model ~= nil then
                model.call("SetShipCardURL", {url = cardFrontImage})
            end
        end, 5) -- Give it a few frames to fully initialize
        
        -- Reload the model to apply changes
        model.reload()

        mini = model
    end, 2)
end

	
	


function ui_pingmini(player)
    if (mini ~= nil) then
        if (player.pingTable ~= nil) then
            player.pingTable(mini.getPosition())
        end
    end
end

function rebuildAssets()
    local root = 'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/RobMayer/TTSLibrary/master/ui/';
    local assets = {
        {name='ui_power', url=root..'power.png'},
        {name='ui_gear', url=root..'gear.png'},
        {name='ui_close', url=root..'close.png'},
        {name='ui_plus', url=root..'plus.png'},
        {name='ui_minus', url=root..'minus.png'},
        {name='ui_reload', url=root..'reload.png'},
        {name='ui_location', url=root..'location.png'},
        {name='ui_bars_new', url=root..'bars_new.png'},
        {name='ui_arrow_u', url=root..'arrow_u.png'},
        {name='ui_arrow_d', url=root..'arrow_d.png'},
        {name='ui_arrow_l', url=root..'arrow_l.png'},
        {name='ui_arrow_r', url=root..'arrow_r.png'},
    }

    assetBuffer = {}
    local bufLen = 0
    for idx,guid in pairs(mapI2G) do
        local mini = getObjectFromGUID(guid)
        if (mini ~= nil) then
            for i,marker in pairs(mini.call('getMarkers', {})) do
                if (assetBuffer[marker.url] == nil) then
                    bufLen = bufLen + 1
                    assetBuffer[marker.url] = self.guid..'_mk_'..bufLen
                    table.insert(assets, {name=self.guid..'_mk_'..bufLen, url=marker.url})
                end
            end
        end
    end
    self.UI.setCustomAssets(assets)
end

function rebuildUI()
    self.setCustomObject({
        image = cardFrontImage,
        image_secondary = cardBackImage,
    });

    local ui = {
        {tag='Defaults', children={
            {tag='Text', attributes={color='#cccccc', fontSize='18', alignment='MiddleLeft'}},

    self.UI.setXmlTable(ui)

    local save = {

        baseScale = baseScale,

        name = name,
        playerColor = playerColor, 
        faction = faction,
        cardFrontImage = cardFrontImage,
        cardBackImage = cardBackImage,
    }
    return JSON.encode(save)
end

local mini = nil
local faction;
local baseScale=0.4; --REPLACE THIS SCALE
local cardFrontImage;
local cardBackImage;
local health=24; --REPLACE THIS HEALTH
local sig = 6; --REPLACE THIS SIG
points = 120;
local imageScale;
local modelImage='https://raw.githubusercontent.com/TemporalDistoriton/DropfleetTTS/main/Shaltari/Shuriken_ModelImage.png'; --REPLACE THIS MODEL IMAGE
local name='Shuriken';
local playerColor='Green';
local factionColor= Color(1,1,1);

function onLoad(save)
    local data = JSON.decode(save) or {}
    mini = getObjectFromGUID(data.mini)
    baseScale = 0.4 --REPLACE THIS SCALE
    health = data.Health or 24 --REPLACE THIS HEALTH
	sig = 6; --REPLACE THIS SIG
	-- print("Onload triggered, Health is :", health)
    imageScale = data.imageScale or 1
    modelImage = 'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/TemporalDistoriton/DropfleetTTS/main/Shaltari/Shuriken_ModelImage.png' --REPLACE THIS MODEL IMAGE
	cardFrontImage = 'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/TemporalDistoriton/DropfleetTTS/main/Shaltari/Shuriken_CardFrontImage.png' --REPLACE THIS CARD IMAGE
	cardBackImage =  cardFrontImage
    name = 'Shuriken'
    faction = data.faction or 'Shaltari'
    -- playerColor = data.playerColor or 'White'
    factionColor = Color(1,1,1)
	-- print("-- Onload triggered, color is :", factionColor)
    rebuildUI()
end

local prototypes = {
    ["0.5"] = "44860d", -- Colossal
    ["0.4"] = "c273ec", -- Heavy
    ["0.35"] = "6ac644", -- Medium
    ["0.3"] = "c06744", -- Light
}

function destruct()
    if mini ~= nil then
mini.destruct()    
    end
end

function ui_createModel()
    -- Get the current position of the object and create a new model at that position
    --print("CREATING SHIP STAGE 1")
	createModel(self.getPosition())
end

function createModel(position)
    local pos = position:add(Vector(0, 2, 0))
    local objectData = self.getData()
    local modelPrototype = getObjectFromGUID(prototypes[tostring(baseScale)])
    if not modelPrototype then
        print("Error: Model prototype with the given GUID was not found.")
        print(modelPrototype)
        return
    end

    -- Clone the object without scripts
    local model = modelPrototype.clone({
        position = pos,
        snap_to_grid = false
        -- Do not set 'script = ""' to allow scripts to be copied
    })

    -- Wait for the object to be fully created
    Wait.frames(function()
        -- Set custom object properties
        model.setCustomObject({
            mesh = modelPrototype.getCustomObject().mesh,
            diffuse = modelImage,
            normal = modelPrototype.getCustomObject().normal,
            material = modelPrototype.getCustomObject().material,
            collider = modelPrototype.getCustomObject().collider,
            type = modelPrototype.type,
            image = modelImage,
            image_secondary = modelImage,
            image_scalar = imageScale,
            name = "Unnamed Model"
        })
        
        -- Set the Lua script
        local placeholderScript = modelPrototype.getLuaScript()
        model.setLuaScript(placeholderScript)
        
        -- Set script state
        local scriptState = {
            state = {
                health = {current = health, max = health},
                base = {
                    color = {r = factionColor.r, g = factionColor.g, b = factionColor.b, a = 1},
                    size = baseScale * 25
                },
                imageScale = imageScale,
                conditions = {},
                sig = sig
            },
            originalData = {
                health = {current = health, max = health},
                base = {
                    color = {r = factionColor.r, g = factionColor.g, b = factionColor.b, a = 1},
                    size = baseScale * 25
                },
                imageScale = imageScale,
                sig = sig
            },
            SHIPCardURL = cardFrontImage  -- Add this line to pass the card image URL
        }
        model.script_state = JSON.encode(scriptState)
        
        -- Apply changes and set other properties
        model.setScale({x = baseScale, y = baseScale, z = baseScale})
        model.setName(name or "Unnamed Model")
        model.setDescription(objectData.Description or "")
        model.setColorTint(factionColor)
        
        -- After the model is loaded, set the SHIPCardURL variable directly
        Wait.frames(function()
            if model ~= nil then
                model.call("SetShipCardURL", {url = cardFrontImage})
            end
        end, 5) -- Give it a few frames to fully initialize
        
        -- Reload the model to apply changes
        model.reload()

        mini = model
    end, 2)
end

	
	


function ui_pingmini(player)
    if (mini ~= nil) then
        if (player.pingTable ~= nil) then
            player.pingTable(mini.getPosition())
        end
    end
end

function rebuildAssets()
    local root = 'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/RobMayer/TTSLibrary/master/ui/';
    local assets = {
        {name='ui_power', url=root..'power.png'},
        {name='ui_gear', url=root..'gear.png'},
        {name='ui_close', url=root..'close.png'},
        {name='ui_plus', url=root..'plus.png'},
        {name='ui_minus', url=root..'minus.png'},
        {name='ui_reload', url=root..'reload.png'},
        {name='ui_location', url=root..'location.png'},
        {name='ui_bars_new', url=root..'bars_new.png'},
        {name='ui_arrow_u', url=root..'arrow_u.png'},
        {name='ui_arrow_d', url=root..'arrow_d.png'},
        {name='ui_arrow_l', url=root..'arrow_l.png'},
        {name='ui_arrow_r', url=root..'arrow_r.png'},
    }

    assetBuffer = {}
    local bufLen = 0
    for idx,guid in pairs(mapI2G) do
        local mini = getObjectFromGUID(guid)
        if (mini ~= nil) then
            for i,marker in pairs(mini.call('getMarkers', {})) do
                if (assetBuffer[marker.url] == nil) then
                    bufLen = bufLen + 1
                    assetBuffer[marker.url] = self.guid..'_mk_'..bufLen
                    table.insert(assets, {name=self.guid..'_mk_'..bufLen, url=marker.url})
                end
            end
        end
    end
    self.UI.setCustomAssets(assets)
end

function rebuildUI()
    self.setCustomObject({
        image = cardFrontImage,
        image_secondary = cardBackImage,
    });

    local ui = {
        {tag='Defaults', children={
            {tag='Text', attributes={color='#cccccc', fontSize='18', alignment='MiddleLeft'}},
            {tag='InputField', attributes={fontSize='24', preferredHeight='40'}},
            {tag='ToggleButton', attributes={fontSize='18', preferredHeight='40', colors='#ffcc33|#ffffff|#808080|#606060', selectedBackgroundColor='#dddddd', deselectedBackgroundColor='#999999'}},
            {tag='Button', attributes={fontSize='12',textColor='#111111', preferredHeight='40', colors='#dddddd|#ffffff|#808080|#f6f6f6'}},
            {tag='Toggle', attributes={textColor='#cccccc'}},
        }},
        
     --   {tag='button', attributes={onClick='ui_pingmini', image='ui_location',  colors='#ccccccff|#ffffffff|#404040ff|#808080ff', width='20', height='20', position='-40 -110 -5', rotation='0 0 180' }},
        {tag='button', attributes={onClick='ui_createModel',text='Spawn Ship',  colors='#ccccccff|#ffffffff|#404040ff|#808080ff', width='120', height='20', position='0 110 -5', rotation='0 0 180' }} 
    }
    
    self.UI.setXmlTable(ui)
end

function onSave()
    miniguid = ''
    if mini ~= nil then
        miniguid = mini.getGUID()
    end
    local save = {
        mini = miniguid,
        baseScale = baseScale,
        health = health,
        imageScale = imageScale,
       -- modelImage = modelImage,
        name = name,
        playerColor = playerColor, 
        faction = faction,
        cardFrontImage = cardFrontImage,
        cardBackImage = cardBackImage,
    }
    return JSON.encode(save)
end

    --print("CREATING SHIP STAGE 1")
	createModel(self.getPosition())
end

function createModel(position)
    local pos = position:add(Vector(0, 2, 0))
    local objectData = self.getData()
    local modelPrototype = getObjectFromGUID(prototypes[tostring(baseScale)])
    if not modelPrototype then
        print("Error: Model prototype with the given GUID was not found.")
        print(modelPrototype)
        return
    end

    -- Clone the object without scripts
    local model = modelPrototype.clone({
        position = pos,
        snap_to_grid = false
        -- Do not set 'script = ""' to allow scripts to be copied
    })

    -- Wait for the object to be fully created
    Wait.frames(function()
        -- Set custom object properties
        model.setCustomObject({
            mesh = modelPrototype.getCustomObject().mesh,
            diffuse = modelImage,
            normal = modelPrototype.getCustomObject().normal,
            material = modelPrototype.getCustomObject().material,
            collider = modelPrototype.getCustomObject().collider,
            type = modelPrototype.type,
            image = modelImage,
            image_secondary = modelImage,
            image_scalar = imageScale,
            name = "Unnamed Model"
        })
        
        -- Set the Lua script
        local placeholderScript = modelPrototype.getLuaScript()
        model.setLuaScript(placeholderScript)
        
        -- Set script state
        local scriptState = {
            state = {
                health = {current = health, max = health},
                base = {
                    color = {r = factionColor.r, g = factionColor.g, b = factionColor.b, a = 1},
                    size = baseScale * 25
                },
                imageScale = imageScale,
                conditions = {},
                sig = sig
            },
            originalData = {
                health = {current = health, max = health},
                base = {
                    color = {r = factionColor.r, g = factionColor.g, b = factionColor.b, a = 1},
                    size = baseScale * 25
                },
                imageScale = imageScale,
                sig = sig
            },
            SHIPCardURL = cardFrontImage  -- Add this line to pass the card image URL
        }
        model.script_state = JSON.encode(scriptState)
        
        -- Apply changes and set other properties
        model.setScale({x = baseScale, y = baseScale, z = baseScale})
        model.setName(name or "Unnamed Model")
        model.setDescription(objectData.Description or "")
        model.setColorTint(factionColor)
        
        -- After the model is loaded, set the SHIPCardURL variable directly
        Wait.frames(function()
            if model ~= nil then
                model.call("SetShipCardURL", {url = cardFrontImage})
            end
        end, 5) -- Give it a few frames to fully initialize
        
        -- Reload the model to apply changes
        model.reload()

        mini = model
    end, 2)
end

	
	


function ui_pingmini(player)
    if (mini ~= nil) then
        if (player.pingTable ~= nil) then
            player.pingTable(mini.getPosition())
        end
    end
end

function rebuildAssets()
    local root = 'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/RobMayer/TTSLibrary/master/ui/';
    local assets = {
        {name='ui_power', url=root..'power.png'},
        {name='ui_gear', url=root..'gear.png'},
        {name='ui_close', url=root..'close.png'},
        {name='ui_plus', url=root..'plus.png'},
        {name='ui_minus', url=root..'minus.png'},
        {name='ui_reload', url=root..'reload.png'},
        {name='ui_location', url=root..'location.png'},
        {name='ui_bars_new', url=root..'bars_new.png'},
        {name='ui_arrow_u', url=root..'arrow_u.png'},
        {name='ui_arrow_d', url=root..'arrow_d.png'},
        {name='ui_arrow_l', url=root..'arrow_l.png'},
        {name='ui_arrow_r', url=root..'arrow_r.png'},
    }

    assetBuffer = {}
    local bufLen = 0
    for idx,guid in pairs(mapI2G) do
        local mini = getObjectFromGUID(guid)
        if (mini ~= nil) then
            for i,marker in pairs(mini.call('getMarkers', {})) do
                if (assetBuffer[marker.url] == nil) then
                    bufLen = bufLen + 1
                    assetBuffer[marker.url] = self.guid..'_mk_'..bufLen
                    table.insert(assets, {name=self.guid..'_mk_'..bufLen, url=marker.url})
                end
            end
        end
    end
    self.UI.setCustomAssets(assets)
end

function rebuildUI()
    self.setCustomObject({
        image = cardFrontImage,
        image_secondary = cardBackImage,
    });

    local ui = {
        {tag='Defaults', children={

    self.UI.setXmlTable(ui)

    miniguid = ''

    end
    local save = {

        baseScale = baseScale,
        health = health,

       -- modelImage = modelImage,
        name = name,
        playerColor = playerColor, 
        faction = faction,
        cardFrontImage = cardFrontImage,
        cardBackImage = cardBackImage,
    }
    return JSON.encode(save)
end

    name = 'Philonoe Torpedo Monitor'

    -- playerColor = data.playerColor or 'White'
    factionColor = Color(1,1,1)
	-- print("-- Onload triggered, color is :", factionColor)
    rebuildUI()
end

local prototypes = {
    ["0.5"] = "44860d", -- Colossal
    ["0.4"] = "f00f62", -- Heavy
    ["0.35"] = "6ac644", -- Medium
    ["0.3"] = "c06744", -- Light
}

function destruct()
    if mini ~= nil then
mini.destruct()    
    end
end

function ui_createModel()
    -- Get the current position of the object and create a new model at that position
    --print("CREATING SHIP STAGE 1")
	createModel(self.getPosition())
end

function createModel(position)
    local pos = position:add(Vector(0, 2, 0))
    local objectData = self.getData()
    local modelPrototype = getObjectFromGUID(prototypes[tostring(baseScale)])
    if not modelPrototype then
        print("Error: Model prototype with the given GUID was not found.")
        print(modelPrototype)
        return
    end

    -- Clone the object without scripts
    local model = modelPrototype.clone({
        position = pos,
        snap_to_grid = false
        -- Do not set 'script = ""' to allow scripts to be copied
    })

    -- Wait for the object to be fully created
    Wait.frames(function()
        -- Set custom object properties
        model.setCustomObject({
            mesh = modelPrototype.getCustomObject().mesh,
            diffuse = modelImage,
            normal = modelPrototype.getCustomObject().normal,
            material = modelPrototype.getCustomObject().material,
            collider = modelPrototype.getCustomObject().collider,
            type = modelPrototype.type,
            image = modelImage,
            image_secondary = modelImage,
            image_scalar = imageScale,
            name = "Unnamed Model"
        })
        
        -- Set the Lua script
        local placeholderScript = modelPrototype.getLuaScript()
        model.setLuaScript(placeholderScript)
        
        -- Set script state
        local scriptState = {
            state = {
                health = {current = health, max = health},
                base = {
                    color = {r = factionColor.r, g = factionColor.g, b = factionColor.b, a = 1},
                    size = baseScale * 25
                },
                imageScale = imageScale,
                conditions = {},
                sig = sig
            },
            originalData = {
                health = {current = health, max = health},
                base = {
                    color = {r = factionColor.r, g = factionColor.g, b = factionColor.b, a = 1},
                    size = baseScale * 25
                },
                imageScale = imageScale,
                sig = sig
            },
            SHIPCardURL = cardFrontImage  -- Add this line to pass the card image URL
        }
        model.script_state = JSON.encode(scriptState)
        
        -- Apply changes and set other properties
        model.setScale({x = baseScale, y = baseScale, z = baseScale})
        model.setName(name or "Unnamed Model")
        model.setDescription(objectData.Description or "")
        model.setColorTint(factionColor)
        
        -- After the model is loaded, set the SHIPCardURL variable directly
        Wait.frames(function()
            if model ~= nil then
                model.call("SetShipCardURL", {url = cardFrontImage})
            end
        end, 5) -- Give it a few frames to fully initialize
        
        -- Reload the model to apply changes
        model.reload()

        mini = model
    end, 2)
end

	
	


function ui_pingmini(player)
    if (mini ~= nil) then
        if (player.pingTable ~= nil) then
            player.pingTable(mini.getPosition())
        end
    end
end

function rebuildAssets()
    local root = 'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/RobMayer/TTSLibrary/master/ui/';
    local assets = {
        {name='ui_power', url=root..'power.png'},
        {name='ui_gear', url=root..'gear.png'},
        {name='ui_close', url=root..'close.png'},
        {name='ui_plus', url=root..'plus.png'},
        {name='ui_minus', url=root..'minus.png'},
        {name='ui_reload', url=root..'reload.png'},
        {name='ui_location', url=root..'location.png'},
        {name='ui_bars_new', url=root..'bars_new.png'},
        {name='ui_arrow_u', url=root..'arrow_u.png'},
        {name='ui_arrow_d', url=root..'arrow_d.png'},
        {name='ui_arrow_l', url=root..'arrow_l.png'},
        {name='ui_arrow_r', url=root..'arrow_r.png'},
    }

    assetBuffer = {}
    local bufLen = 0
    for idx,guid in pairs(mapI2G) do
        local mini = getObjectFromGUID(guid)
        if (mini ~= nil) then
            for i,marker in pairs(mini.call('getMarkers', {})) do
                if (assetBuffer[marker.url] == nil) then
                    bufLen = bufLen + 1
                    assetBuffer[marker.url] = self.guid..'_mk_'..bufLen
                    table.insert(assets, {name=self.guid..'_mk_'..bufLen, url=marker.url})
                end
            end
        end
    end
    self.UI.setCustomAssets(assets)
end

function rebuildUI()
    self.setCustomObject({
        image = cardFrontImage,
        image_secondary = cardBackImage,
    });

    local ui = {
        {tag='Defaults', children={
            {tag='Text', attributes={color='#cccccc', fontSize='18', alignment='MiddleLeft'}},
            {tag='InputField', attributes={fontSize='24', preferredHeight='40'}},
            {tag='ToggleButton', attributes={fontSize='18', preferredHeight='40', colors='#ffcc33|#ffffff|#808080|#606060', selectedBackgroundColor='#dddddd', deselectedBackgroundColor='#999999'}},
            {tag='Button', attributes={fontSize='12',textColor='#111111', preferredHeight='40', colors='#dddddd|#ffffff|#808080|#f6f6f6'}},
            {tag='Toggle', attributes={textColor='#cccccc'}},
        }},
        
     --   {tag='button', attributes={onClick='ui_pingmini', image='ui_location',  colors='#ccccccff|#ffffffff|#404040ff|#808080ff', width='20', height='20', position='-40 -110 -5', rotation='0 0 180' }},
        {tag='button', attributes={onClick='ui_createModel',text='Spawn Ship',  colors='#ccccccff|#ffffffff|#404040ff|#808080ff', width='120', height='20', position='0 110 -5', rotation='0 0 180' }} 
    }
    
    self.UI.setXmlTable(ui)
end

function onSave()
    miniguid = ''
    if mini ~= nil then
        miniguid = mini.getGUID()
    end
    local save = {
        mini = miniguid,
        baseScale = baseScale,
        health = health,
        imageScale = imageScale,
       -- modelImage = modelImage,
        name = name,
        playerColor = playerColor, 
        faction = faction,
        cardFrontImage = cardFrontImage,
        cardBackImage = cardBackImage,
    }
    return JSON.encode(save)
end
